name: Laboratorio de Procesamiento y Análisis de Imágenes Satelitales
summary: A laboratory run by the Bolivian Space Agency that built a satellite fire monitoring platform and says its GIS team uses machine learning and Google Earth Engine.

name: MapBiomas Bolivia
summary: Programme producing annual Bolivian land cover maps since 1985 from 30-metre Landsat imagery using machine learning, led by FAN, with 2025 alerts and burned area maps, and seven local institutions in its network up to 2026.

name: Mejora de las capacidades para el monitoreo forestal y la reducción de la deforestación en Bolivia
summary: Closed UNDP-run project, July 2023 to April 2026, which aimed to strengthen national forest monitoring, including a biomass density map, with USD 1,068,416 from Spanish and UK funders.

name: Ministerio de Planificación del Desarrollo y Medio Ambiente
summary: Bolivian ministry whose vice-minister and Director General of Biodiversity and Protected Areas are listed by the CBD as primary and secondary national focal points, and on which the forest directorate DGGDF depends.

name: Ministerio de Producción Sostenible, Medio Ambiente y Agua
summary: Bolivian ministry whose site names Óscar Mario Justiniano Pinto as minister and lists a Vice-Minister of Environment, Climate Change, Forest Development and Biodiversity.

name: Museo de Historia Natural Noel Kempff Mercado
summary: Santa Cruz natural history museum, part of a university faculty, holding over a million specimens, with a geography area doing GIS and remote sensing and a JRS-funded biodiversity data centre.

name: Museo Nacional de Historia Natural de Bolivia
summary: A decentralised Bolivian public institution for research, preservation and custody of natural and cultural heritage, which keeps national flora, fauna and fossil collections and is listed as a partner of Amazon.ia.

name: Observatorio de Frutos Amazónicos y Cambio Climático
summary: Portal run by ACEAA that gives access to its technical and scientific documents and real-time monitoring of fires in Pando.

name: Observatorio del Bosque Seco Chiquitano
summary: FCBC-run observatory whose 2019 technical report measured 3,893,787 hectares burned in the Bosque Modelo Chiquitano between 9 July and 10 October 2019 and says it developed a predictive model.

name: Productive Protected Landscapes biodiversity data mobilisation
summary: Reportedly EU-financed within GBIF’s Biodiversity Information for Development programme, planned for February 2026–December 2027 across Argentina, Bolivia and Paraguay, mobilising over 35,000 biodiversity records under planned Fundación ProYungas leadership.

name: Protección del Medio Ambiente Tarija
summary: A Bolivian NGO founded in 1990 and based in Tarija, whose 2021 report describes carnivore monitoring at 85 camera-trap stations, with Andean bears photographed at 85% of them across 900 square kilometres.

name: Servicio Nacional de Áreas Protegidas
summary: Bolivia's national protected-area service, created in 1997, which administers the 22 national protected areas (17% of the country) and issues compatible-use certificates for projects inside them.

name: Sistema de Alerta Temprana de Incendios Forestales
summary: Satellite fire hotspot monitoring system run by Santa Cruz's natural resources directorate, which a decree says trains municipal technicians, and which Tarija announced in August 2026 as implemented through a cooperation agreement.

name: Sistema de Información y Monitoreo de Bosques
summary: Official forest monitoring platform of Bolivia's forest directorate, offering deforestation alerts, automatic heat hotspot detection, burn scar maps from MODIS, VIIRS, Landsat 8 and Sentinel-2, and MapBiomas land-use maps.

name: Sistema de monitoreo y alerta temprana de riesgos de incendios forestales
summary: A Bolivian forest fire early-warning and monitoring system, run by Fundación Amigos de la Naturaleza, offering maps, near-real-time data, a mobile app and a burned-area tool, with a statistical model emphasising prevention.

name: Universidad Autónoma Gabriel René Moreno
summary: The largest higher education centre in Santa Cruz department, with over 100,000 students by its own account, listed as a Bolivian partner of RAINFOR.

name: Universidad Mayor de San Andrés
summary: Bolivian university that OpenAlex gives as the first author's institution on a 2024 remote-sensing paper about asaí, majo and cacao, and as host of the journal CIBUM SCIENTIA.

name: Uso de múltiples plataformas para la observación del delfín de río boliviano
summary: A project using several platforms to observe Bolivian river dolphins, which in 2022 compared three counting methods on the Ichilo river and had eight fishers record 1,051 dolphins over 115 transects.

name: WCS Bolivia
summary: Wildlife Conservation Society programme and listed Amazon.ia partner, reporting work in Greater Madidi and Llanos de Moxos in 2024 and 225 camera-trap stations in its 2025 report.

name: WWF Bolivia
summary: Established in Santa Cruz in 1993, this WWF office aims to study dolphins using four satellite trackers, describes a draft early warning protocol and partners with Faunagua.

name: #DeOlhoNosCorais
summary: Citizen science project of a Brazilian marine ecology laboratory, LECOM, in which people share coral reef photos on Instagram, and for which machine learning models were built to classify and segment corals.

name: Abandoned Cerrado farmland map
summary: Research by the University of Brasília and Embrapa mapping abandoned farmland in the Cerrado from satellite images with deep learning.

name: Abrace o Pantanal
summary: Project funded by JBS that equipped Instituto Homem Pantaneiro, SESC Pantanal and Ibama's Prevfogo with 11 monitoring cameras for continuous fire surveillance of the Pantanal.

name: Abundance
summary: Brazilian climate-tech platform that turns forests and carbon into verified digital assets using AI and blockchain, in the first cohort of Google's AI for Nature accelerator.

name: Agrotools
summary: Digital platform for agribusiness, founded in 2007, that monitors the social and environmental compliance of farms and supply chains. Its GeoID method covers more than 100 million hectares of the Amazon.

name: Agência Espacial Brasileira
summary: Brazil's federal space agency; its then president said in 2021 that the Amazonia-1 satellite would be used mainly to monitor deforestation in the Amazon.

name: Agência Estadual de Meio Ambiente de Pernambuco
summary: State environment agency that a 2012 decree made responsible for administering Parque Estadual Mata da Pimenteira, preparing its management plan and creating its management council.

name: Agência Nacional de Águas e Saneamento Básico
summary: Brazil's federal water agency, which publishes the HidroSat satellite hydrological monitoring system.

name: ALARMES
summary: Platform of the Environmental Satellite Applications Laboratory at the Federal University of Rio de Janeiro that gives near-real-time alerts of burned areas across Brazil, using deep learning.

name: Amazon Coast Watch: Empowering Communities for Climate Resilience and Species Conservation
summary: Tech4Nature project at the Soure Marine Extractive Reserve on Marajó Island, with a low-cost UFPA sensor for water and tide data and monitoring of mangroves and crabs. IUCN says it has opened work on AI tools to count crab burrows.

name: Amazonia-1
summary: Brazilian Earth observation satellite whose images were released by INPE and are used in DETER Cerrado.

name: Amazônia SAR
summary: Amazon Fund project of Censipam to set up deforestation detection with orbital radar images, as a complement to DETER.

name: Amazônia+10
summary: Initiative launched in Manaus in March 2022 to fund collaborative research on biodiversity, climate change, protection of people and the bioeconomy in the Amazon.

name: AmpliOmics Pesquisa e Desenvolvimento
summary: Brazilian company offering environmental DNA and metabarcoding to identify species without invasive collection.

name: An Online Database of the Immatures of Coleoptera Described from Brazil
summary: Database of described immature beetles from Brazil, compiled from published literature and published on GBIF by the Universidade de São Paulo under CC BY 4.0. No page says who maintains it.

name: ArcPlan
summary: Private cartography and geoprocessing company in São Paulo. It co-coordinates the Atlantic Forest and Pantanal in MapBiomas and supplies its technical coordinator.

name: ARTES
summary: Federal University of Amazonas project for an AI-controlled aerostat for large-scale environmental monitoring of the Amazon.

name: Aruanã.ai
summary: AI platform from Local DC that analyses images, sounds and environmental data to detect fire, deforestation, pollution and harm to wildlife.

name: Arvoreta
summary: Brazilian platform that combines professional forest inventory, applied AI and technical training, with an Android app.

name: Associação Ambientalista Copaíba
summary: Environmental association that, per a WWF-Brasil story, prepared a landowner's land, planted seedlings and monitored the growing forest, and carries out the Raízes do Mogi Guaçu spring and riparian restoration programme.

name: Associação Amigos do Meio Ambiente
summary: Association with which Rainforest Trust says a 116-acre reserve protecting Araucaria forest in the Santa Catarina Highlands was established; it plans to monitor the reserve with regional universities and federal agencies.

name: Associação Bebô Xikrin do Bacajá
summary: Indigenous organisation listed by an Amazon Fund project among five supported to run the financial administration of four territorial and environmental management plans.

name: Associação Caatinga
summary: Non-governmental, non-profit body founded in 1998, whose first project was to set up the Serra das Almas Natural Reserve, a private natural heritage reserve.

name: Associação da Comunidade Remanescente de Quilombo da Reserva Extrativista do Mandira
summary: Quilombo community association that, according to the Socioambiental record, was granted a concession of use over the Mandira extractive reserve by ICMBio.

name: Associação da Reserva Extrativista Marinha de Arraial do Cabo
summary: Association that, an environment agency ordinance records, presented a use plan for the Arraial do Cabo marine extractive reserve, with joint duties shared with Ibama under that plan.

name: Associação das Mulheres Indígenas em Mutirão
summary: Indigenous women's organisation listed by an Amazon Fund project among five supported to run the financial administration of four territorial and environmental management plans.

name: Associação de Coletores de Berbigão
summary: Association recorded by Socioambiental as grantee, from ICMBio, of a use agreement covering 1,444 hectares of the Pirajubaé marine extractive reserve.

name: Associação de Moradores e Produtores da Reserva Extrativista Chico Mendes em Assis Brasil
summary: Residents' and producers' association recorded by Socioambiental as holding a 50-year use agreement with ICMBio over 172,796 hectares of the Chico Mendes reserve.

name: Associação de Produtores Rurais Extrativistas da Resex Arapixi
summary: Association of rural extractive producers recorded by Socioambiental as concessionaire, from ICMBio, of 52,110 hectares of the Arapixi reserve.

name: Associação de Seringueiros do Rio Ouro Preto
summary: Rubber tappers' association named in an ICMBio ordinance, alongside ASAEX, as responsible for the reserve's management agreement.

name: Associação de Seringueiros e Agroextrativistas do Baixo Rio Ouro Preto
summary: Rubber tappers' and agroextractivists' association (ASAEX) named in an ICMBio ordinance, alongside ASROP, as responsible for the reserve's management agreement.

name: Associação de Trabalhadores Agroextrativistas do Médio Purus
summary: Agroextractivist workers' association recorded by Socioambiental as concessionaire, from ICMBio, of 340,517 hectares of the reserve.

name: Associação do Povo Indígena Jiahui
summary: Indigenous organisation listed among six supported by an Amazon Fund project that backed management plans for seven Indigenous lands and installed GIS toolkits and training for monitoring deforestation.

name: Associação do Povo Indígena Tenharin do Igarapé Preto
summary: Indigenous organisation listed among six supported by an Amazon Fund project that backed management plans for seven Indigenous lands and installed GIS toolkits and training for monitoring deforestation.

name: Associação do Povo Indígena Uru-eu-wau-wau/Jupaú
summary: Indigenous association that an IPÊ project in Rondônia aims to strengthen, as one of five Indigenous associations and one extractivist association, for sustainable development of their territories.

name: Associação do Sítio Anhanguera
summary: Association that, according to the city's conservation units page, manages RPPN Mutinga.

name: Associação dos Moradores da Reserva Extrativista Mapuá
summary: Residents' association recorded by Socioambiental as concessionaire, from ICMBio, of 94,463 hectares of the Mapuá reserve.

name: Associação dos Moradores da Reserva Extrativista Marinha de Cururupu
summary: Residents' association recorded by Socioambiental as concessionaire, from ICMBio, of 185,046 hectares of the Cururupu marine extractive reserve.

name: Associação dos Moradores da Reserva Extrativista Riozinho do Anfrísio
summary: Residents' association recorded by Socioambiental as holding a 50-year concession from ICMBio over 601,124 hectares, created on 28 March 2003, before the reserve itself.

name: Associação dos Moradores da Reserva Extrativista Terra Grande Pracuúba
summary: Residents' association recorded by Socioambiental as concessionaire, from ICMBio, of the reserve's 194,695 hectares for 50 years.

name: Associação dos Moradores das Comunidades de Itacuruçá e Pereirinha
summary: Residents' association (Amoip) that Mongabay reports signed an agreement in January 2023 with the São Paulo State Forest Foundation delegating five years of visitation management in the park's Perequê area to the Caiçaras.

name: Associação dos Produtores Agroextrativistas da Assembleia de Deus do Rio Ituxí
summary: Agroextractivist producers' association that Socioambiental records as granted a real right of use by ICMBio over 246,559 hectares at Lábrea for an indefinite term.

name: Associação dos Seringueiros do Vale do Guaporé
summary: Rubber tappers' association that an IPÊ project covering the Rio Cautário state extractive reserve aims to strengthen for sustainable development of its territory.

name: Associação dos Trabalhadores Rurais de Juruá
summary: Rural workers' association that, according to the Socioambiental record, holds a real right of use from ICMBio over 17,491.55 hectares.

name: Associação dos Usuários da Reserva Extrativista Marinha Araí Peroba
summary: Users' association of the Araí Peroba marine extractive reserve, listed by Socioambiental as ICMBio concessionaire of 11,479 hectares.

name: Associação dos Usuários da Reserva Extrativista Marinha Caeté-Taperaçu
summary: Users' association of the Caeté-Taperaçu marine extractive reserve, listed by Socioambiental as ICMBio concessionaire of 42,068 hectares for 50 years.

name: Associação dos Usuários da Reserva Extrativista Marinha de Maracanã
summary: Users' association of the Maracanã marine extractive reserve, listed by Socioambiental as ICMBio concessionaire of 30,018 hectares.

name: Associação dos Usuários da Reserva Extrativista Marinha de Soure
summary: Users' association of the Soure marine extractive reserve, listed by Socioambiental as ICMBio concessionaire of 27,463 hectares.

name: Associação dos Usuários da Reserva Extrativista Marinha de Tracuateua
summary: Users' association of the Tracuateua marine extractive reserve, listed by Socioambiental as ICMBio concessionaire of 27,153 hectares.

name: Associação dos Usuários da Reserva Extrativista Marinha de Viseu, Piriá e Gurupi
summary: Users' association listed by Socioambiental as ICMBio concessionaire of 74,081 hectares of the Gurupi-Piriá marine extractive reserve for 20 years.

name: Associação dos Usuários da Reserva Extrativista Mãe Grande de Curuçá
summary: Users' association of the Mãe Grande de Curuçá extractive reserve, listed by Socioambiental as ICMBio concessionaire of 37,062 hectares for 20 years.

name: Associação Floresta Protegida
summary: Kayapó-Mẽbêngôkre Indigenous organisation in southern Pará; a 2022 WWF-Brasil article says it supported three surveillance bases, and a project planned GPS units, a tablet and a laptop for monitoring.

name: Associação Indígena Karo Pajgap
summary: Indigenous association in Rondônia that an IPÊ project aims to strengthen, as one of five Indigenous and one extractivist associations, alongside territorial and environmental management plans.

name: Associação Indígena Ka’aiwar dos Guardiões da Floresta da Terra Indígena Arariboia
summary: Association that, according to Mongabay, the Guardians of the Forest set up to receive donations for protecting the Arariboia Indigenous Territory.

name: Associação Indígena Santo André
summary: Indigenous association in Rondônia that an IPÊ project aims to strengthen, as one of five Indigenous and one extractivist associations, alongside territorial and environmental management plans.

name: Associação Indígena Tato’a
summary: Indigenous organisation listed on an Amazon Fund project page as one of five supported to run the financial administration of four territorial and environmental management plans.

name: Associação Indígena Zavidjaj Djigúhr
summary: Indigenous association in Rondônia that an IPÊ project aims to strengthen, as one of five Indigenous and one extractivist associations, alongside territorial and environmental management plans.

name: Associação Instituto Bepotire Xikrin
summary: Indigenous organisation listed on an Amazon Fund project page as one of five supported to run the financial administration of four territorial and environmental management plans.

name: Associação Metareilá do Povo Indígena Suruí
summary: Suruí Indigenous association that an IPÊ project aims to strengthen, among five Indigenous and one extractivist associations, alongside territorial and environmental management plans in Rondônia.

name: Associação Mico-Leão-Dourado
summary: Association that manages Parque do Mico, a 151-hectare Atlantic Forest reserve at Silva Jardim recognised by ICMBio as a private natural heritage reserve in September 2024.

name: Associação Mãe das Associações da RESEX do Delta do Parnaíba
summary: Listed by Socioambiental as the ICMBio concessionaire of the Delta do Parnaíba extractive reserve.

name: Associação Mãe dos Extrativistas da Reserva Extrativista de Canavieira
summary: Extractivists' association that Socioambiental lists as holding an ICMBio real right of use over 96,972.20 hectares of the Canavieira reserve for 20 years.

name: Associação Plantas do Nordeste
summary: Association that co-coordinates the Caatinga biome in MapBiomas.

name: Associação Quilombo Kalunga
summary: Quilombo association for the 261,999-hectare Kalunga territory, home to about 1,600 families in 39 communities; its board built a geographic information system and database, with youth trained in Open Data Kit and ArcGIS.

name: Associação Terra Indígena do Xingu
summary: Organisation representing the sixteen peoples of the Xingu Indigenous Territory, reported by a 2018 ISA page, and in 2018 a partner in the AIC, which let communities carry out the territory's management plan through small projects.

name: Associação Wajãpi Terra, Ambiente e Cultura
summary: Wajãpi association created in 2010, party to a technical agreement with the Amapá state environment secretariat and listed by the Amazon Fund among five organisations supported on management plans.

name: Atcheza
summary: WhatsApp AI assistant for the artisanal fishers of Arraial do Cabo that answers on fishing rules, species closures and marine conditions.

name: Atlantic Forest Information System
summary: Online database built by IPÊ in 2011 and, per JRS's April 2022 page, still maintained by it; a follow-on grant aimed to add an API, and São Paulo State's native forest programme has incorporated it.

name: Atlantic Forest Research and Conservation Alliance
summary: Alliance founded by HUB through its Brazilian sister foundation, which operates a field station at the Alto da Figueira reserve in the Atlantic Forest.

name: Atlas dos Remanescentes Florestais da Mata Atlântica
summary: Satellite atlas of remaining Atlantic Forest published by INPE and Fundação SOS Mata Atlântica.

name: Ação Ecológica Guaporé
summary: Rondônia organisation that developed Ictio Áudio with the Federal University of Rondônia, an app using AI to transcribe fishers' spoken catch reports.

name: Banco Nacional de Desenvolvimento Econômico e Social
summary: Brazil's national development bank, which manages the Amazon Fund.

name: Benthos
summary: Maker of Atcheza, a WhatsApp AI assistant for the artisanal fishing community of Arraial do Cabo.

name: Biodiversidade em Paisagens Rurais
summary: Embrapa Pantanal project using environmental DNA and AI to map and monitor biodiversity in rural areas of the Pantanal.

name: Bioflore
summary: Brazilian technology company working on conservation, restoration and carbon credits, with digital platforms that use AI and remote sensing.

name: Biolink
summary: Platform from Instituto Tecnológico Vale that merges global biodiversity databases so analysts can produce species inventory reports for licensing. In 2023 its use was mainly within ITV and Vale.

name: Biological Dynamics of Forest Fragments Project
summary: Long-term forest fragment project credited as a data contributor to Forest Listeners, with David Luther named beside it.

name: Biomas
summary: Self-described ecological restoration business that plants native trees on degraded land and implements Project Muçununga with Carbon2Nature Brasil, restoring Atlantic Forest in southern Bahia.

name: Bionote
summary: Software platform for wildlife monitoring that sorts photos and videos with AI trained on Brazilian fauna.

name: BioTechQuilombo
summary: Project combining Quilombola knowledge with eDNA, led by ETH Zurich, the University of Manchester and IPAM with partner universities across the Amazon.

name: Bioverse
summary: São Paulo start-up that combines drone imaging and AI to identify and locate tree species for forest inventories, used by Natura in the Amazon.

name: Boi na Linha
summary: Programme and monitoring protocol for cattle suppliers, developed by Imaflora with the Federal Prosecution Office, setting common criteria for meatpackers.

name: BRA-Dataset
summary: Image set of 1,458 pictures of five Brazilian wild animals, made by researchers coordinated from ICMC-USP to train YOLO object detectors to monitor animals crossing roads.

name: Brasil MAIS
summary: Justice ministry programme, with Federal Police and SCCON Geospatial, that gives public agencies satellite alerts from automated change detection to act on deforestation and illegal mining.

name: Brazil Data Cube
summary: INPE project running since January 2019 that builds analysis-ready data cubes of medium-resolution satellite images for all of Brazil and generates land use and cover information from them with machine learning.

name: Brazil Flying Labs
summary: Brazilian Flying Labs group that built an AI forest fire assessment platform with Tech To The Rescue to evaluate wildfire impacts in protected areas in São Paulo state.

name: Brazilian Marine Biodiversity Database
summary: National open data infrastructure for marine datasets, including omics, microbiology, and benthic and fish surveys, hosted at the National Laboratory of Scientific Computing. Facts come from its GBIF record, because its own site timed out.

name: Brazilian Team
summary: Team of about 100 mostly Brazilian researchers, led from ESALQ/USP, that came third in XPRIZE Rainforest using drones, robots and AI to record tropical forest biodiversity.

name: Brazilian Zooarch Database
summary: Database of bony and cartilaginous fish remains from archaeological sites along the Brazilian coasts, compiled from published sources for the ERC-funded TRADITION project and published on GBIF by Univille.

name: brCarbon
summary: Brazilian climate-tech company that funds forest projects from the carbon market and monitors forest in three dimensions with drone-mounted lidar.

name: Cadastro Nacional de Unidades de Conservação da Natureza
summary: Official data platform on all conservation units in the SNUC, run by the environment and climate ministry, with georeferenced data downloadable as shapefile or KML.

name: Catálogo Taxonômico da Fauna do Brasil
summary: List of valid animal species found in Brazil, built by more than 500 zoologists and coordinated by the Sociedade Brasileira de Zoologia. The Rio de Janeiro Botanical Garden publishes it on GBIF under CC BY 4.0.

name: Center for Research on Biodiversity Dynamics and Climate Change
summary: FAPESP-funded research centre (grant 21/10639-5) at UNESP's Institute of Biosciences in Rio Claro, with a stated mission to establish an observatory of biodiversity and climate change research.

name: Centro Brasileiro de Estudos em Ecologia de Estradas
summary: Centre for road ecology coordinated by Alex Bager of the Federal University of Lavras.

name: Centro de Inteligência Territorial
summary: Centre at the Federal University of Minas Gerais that built the SeloVerde platform with the Pará government.

name: Centro de Referência em Informação Ambiental
summary: Non-profit civil association that has developed and maintained the speciesLink network of biological collection data since 2001.

name: Centro Estadual de Unidades de Conservação do Amazonas
summary: Amazonas state body that, according to a 2013 state audit court report, took over management of the state's conservation units in 2008 and was the unit audited.

name: Centro Gestor e Operacional do Sistema de Proteção da Amazônia
summary: Federal body providing environmental information for monitoring the Legal Amazon, including the SipamSAR radar deforestation alert system.

name: Centro Nacional de Pesquisa e Conservação de Aves Silvestres
summary: ICMBio's national centre for wild bird research and conservation, which coordinates the national bird ringing system, controls leg-flag codes for Brazil and Paraguay, and coordinates the Neotropical Waterbird Census in Brazil.

name: Centro Nacional de Pesquisa e Conservação de Mamíferos Aquáticos
summary: ICMBio's national centre for aquatic mammals, which in 2020 entered stranding and sighting records from Petrobras monitoring projects into SIMMAM and reported on marine manatee monitoring.

name: Centro Nacional de Pesquisa e Conservação de Mamíferos Carnívoros
summary: ICMBio’s centre established a biological sample bank in 2003; a 2023 report describes its biodiversity monitoring partnership and 62 camera traps installed in Montanhas do Tumucumaque National Park.

name: Centro Nacional de Pesquisa e Conservação de Primatas Brasileiros
summary: ICMBio national centre for Brazilian primates that supports monitoring protocols, validates primate and xenarthran data, has mapped threatened primate populations in north-east Brazil, and installed a camera trap at a wildlife crossing bridge.

name: Centro Nacional de Pesquisa e Conservação de Répteis e Anfíbios
summary: ICMBio national centre for reptiles and amphibians, listing monitoring of Hoge's side-necked turtle in Minas Gerais and of the Ranacephala hogei population on Paraíba do Sul river islands.

name: Centro Nacional de Pesquisa e Conservação de Tartarugas Marinhas e da Biodiversidade Marinha do Leste
summary: ICMBio’s sea turtle and eastern marine biodiversity centre launched BDC-Tamar in 2017, monitors fisheries interacting with sea turtles and contributes to Projeto Tamar alongside Fundação Pró-Tamar.

name: Centro Nacional de Prevenção e Combate aos Incêndios Florestais
summary: Ibama's national centre for preventing and fighting forest fires, for which a Fundo Amazônia project built a situation room for fire monitoring.

name: Ceres Seeding
summary: Brazilian company that, according to Google, develops technology and protocols for autonomous drones in ecological restoration. Its own site refused the fetcher.

name: Cerrado Knowledge Platform
summary: CEPF-funded platform with free modules and data sub-platforms of images, vectors and texts on the Cerrado hotspot, offering spatial analysis tools and reports.

name: China-Brazil Earth Resources Satellite
summary: Satellite programme of Brazil and China whose imagery feeds INPE's PRODES and DETER deforestation monitoring.

name: Clam Sustentabilidade
summary: Environmental services company in Belo Horizonte, with about a thousand staff and much of its work in mining, that partnered with NatureMetrics to widen environmental DNA monitoring in Brazil.

name: CO.BRA
summary: Research unit on computational bioacoustics at the Federal University of Mato Grosso, founded after a 2013 workshop, part of automated acoustic biodiversity monitoring in the Pantanal.

name: Computer vision detection of Brazilian roadkill-prone mammals
summary: University of São Paulo research, supported by FAPESP, that trained computer vision models to detect Brazilian mammals most prone to roadkill, tested with toll road operators.

name: Conecta - Partnerships for Responsible Agriculture
summary: Project described as combining satellite monitoring and blockchain to verify illegal deforestation in the Brazilian beef supply chain, working with producers in Pará State.

name: Conselho Nacional de Desenvolvimento Científico e Tecnológico
summary: Brazil's federal research funding council, which runs the SinBiose research programme on biodiversity synthesis.

name: Conservação Internacional Brasil
summary: Brazilian arm of Conservation International, working with the Japanese startup Sustainacraft on remote monitoring of restoration.

name: Coordenação das Organizações Indígenas da Amazônia Brasileira
summary: Coordinating body of Indigenous organisations in the Brazilian Amazon, partner on an AI and satellite platform to monitor Indigenous territories.

name: Courageous Land
summary: Company that regenerates degraded land in Brazil, using Google Cloud data and AI for geospatial diagnoses and drones and AI for field inventory.

name: Curupira
summary: Device built at the State University of Amazonas that listens for the sounds of deforestation, such as chainsaws, and sends alerts by radio; in testing when reported in 2023.

name: Dados de ocorrência de espécies do SISBio
summary: Species occurrence records that researchers report through ICMBio's SISBio research permit system, published on GBIF under CC BY 4.0.

name: DataGEO
summary: Environmental spatial data infrastructure of São Paulo state, with 1,691 public layers in September 2024.

name: Deforestation Prediction System
summary: AI model on TerraBrasilis that forecasts the areas at highest risk of deforestation and burning in the Amazon up to 15 days ahead, made by INPE, the environment ministry, Ibama and PUC-Rio.

name: Desafio IA para a Natureza e o Clima
summary: Open call by Instituto Clima e Sociedade, backed by Google.org, for digital and AI projects on regenerative agriculture, bioeconomy and biodiversity loss in Brazil.

name: DETER
summary: INPE's satellite alert system for deforestation, extended from 2023 to the Pantanal and non-forest areas of the Amazon.

name: DETER Não Floresta
summary: Daily satellite alert system from INPE that uses machine learning to detect loss of non-forest native vegetation, such as savanna and natural grassland, in the Amazon biome.

name: Digitais da Floresta
summary: Initiative from Google and TNC Brasil with the University of São Paulo and Imaflora that uses AI and stable isotopes to verify the origin of timber sold from the Amazon, with Google.org staff building an open data platform.

name: Earth System Science Laboratory, UNICAMP
summary: University of Campinas laboratory coordinated by David Lapola, developer of the Caetê forest model and of AI maps of phosphorus in Amazonian soil.

name: EcoLMM
summary: Federal University of Amazonas project for multimodal biodiversity monitoring using large language models on audio and visual data.

name: EcoStage
summary: Technology partner of MapBiomas.

name: Ecotrópica
summary: Organisation described in a 2004 O Eco column as an NGO owning 52,800 hectares of private natural heritage reserve in the Pantanal, among the largest and best managed.

name: Empresa Brasileira de Pesquisa Agropecuária
summary: Brazil's federal agricultural research corporation, partner with INPE on TerraClass land use mapping and, through Embrapa Acre, developer of the Netflora drone and AI forest inventory method.

name: Environmental DNA
summary: Partnership of the Vale Institute of Technology and ICMBio for genetic and genomic mapping of species in federal protected areas, with R$111 million over five years.

name: Escola Superior de Agricultura Luiz de Queiroz
summary: University of São Paulo college in Piracicaba whose professor coordinates the Brazilian Team, third in XPRIZE Rainforest.

name: Estudo de monitoramento da biodiversidade em Mato Grosso do Sul
summary: Suzano and IPÊ study combining genetic analysis, AI and acoustic recordings to map species and support ecological corridors in the Cerrado.

name: Federação das Organizações Indígenas do Médio Purus
summary: Indigenous federation listed on an Amazon Fund project page among six organisations supported to implement management plans for seven Indigenous lands, with GIS toolkits installed and training in deforestation monitoring.

name: Federação das Organizações Indígenas do Rio Negro
summary: Indigenous federation that, with Funai and ISA, coordinated a final meeting in November 2017 before producing territorial and environmental management plans for seven Rio Negro Indigenous lands.

name: Financiadora de Estudos e Projetos
summary: Brazilian public innovation funder whose 2026 call for an AI startup fund lists bioeconomy and decarbonisation among its themes.

name: Flora e Funga do Brasil
summary: Brazil's plant and fungus database, with the Reflora Virtual Herbarium, offered through web services by the Rio de Janeiro Botanical Garden.

name: Floreviewer
summary: Bioflore's platform for monitoring forest restoration and carbon stocks, used by IPÊ according to Bioflore's site.

name: Fonoteca Neotropical Jacques Vielliard
summary: Sound archive founded in 1978 at the zoology museum of the State University of Campinas, with recordings of all vertebrate groups and some invertebrates.

name: Forest Fire Assessment platform
summary: AI platform from Brazil Flying Labs and Tech To The Rescue, built on open-source tools, for assessing wildfire damage in São Paulo's forest reserves.

name: FORESTEYES
summary: Research group at the Federal University of Paraná, certified by CNPq since 2018, whose lines of work include integrating AI with forest measurement.

name: Fundação Biodiversitas
summary: Non-profit foundation with public-utility status, per its portfolio, which lists a Mata do Sossego RPPN management plan (2009 to 2010); Wikipedia says the Sossego Forest Biological Station is its property.

name: Fundação de Amparo à Pesquisa do Estado de São Paulo
summary: São Paulo state research funder, which funded e-sensing, the predecessor of the Brazil Data Cube, and committed R$100 million to Amazônia+10.

name: Fundação de Ciência, Aplicações e Tecnologia Espaciais
summary: Foundation that carries out the SIM-Biomas project and was a financial partner in the project behind the Brazil Data Cube.

name: Fundação de Parques Municipais e Zoobotânica
summary: Municipal body in Belo Horizonte responsible for conserving, administering and maintaining municipal parks and conservation units, covering 81 parks and over 10.7 million square metres of green areas.

name: Fundação Espírito-Santense de Tecnologia
summary: Foundation named as lead of the Terras do Brasil project under the AI for Nature and Climate Challenge.

name: Fundação Florestal
summary: São Paulo state foundation, under the state environment secretariat, that manages state protected areas and launched Monitora Bio SP.

name: Fundação Getulio Vargas
summary: Brazilian foundation that proposed an AI and satellite platform with COIAB to monitor Indigenous territories in the Amazon.

name: Fundação Grupo Boticário
summary: Brazilian foundation that developed the Natureza ON climate vulnerability platform with MapBiomas.

name: Fundação Municipal do Meio Ambiente de Florianópolis
summary: Municipal environment foundation in Florianópolis (Floram), which a news report says manages 11 of the city's municipal conservation units.

name: Fundação Nacional dos Povos Indígenas
summary: Brazilian public foundation linked to the Ministry of Indigenous Peoples, seated in Brasília, whose 2026 internal rules include protecting and conserving the environment in Indigenous lands among its competences.

name: Fundação Oswaldo Cruz
summary: Brazilian public health research foundation. Its Biodiversity and Wildlife Health Platform runs SISS-Geo, a mobile tool for participatory wildlife monitoring and disease alerts.

name: Fundação Projeto Tamar
summary: Foundation that, per its 2021/22 season notice, protects about 1,100 km of beaches in 23 localities across eight states, and holds over 40 years of data in its SITAMAR system.

name: Fundação Pró-Natureza
summary: Brazilian NGO (Funatura), described in a 2004 O Eco column as holding Cerrado private reserves, and named by Rainforest Trust as its partner in Brazil; current status unknown.

name: Fundação SOS Mata Atlântica
summary: Brazilian NGO that publishes the Atlas of Atlantic Forest Remnants with INPE.

name: Fundo Amazônia
summary: Brazilian fund managed by BNDES, in coordination with the environment ministry, that pays for monitoring and forest protection projects, including INPE's SIM-Biomas.

name: Fundo JBS pela Amazônia
summary: Fund that financed the Geoflora project behind Netflora's drone and AI inventories.

name: Fundo Vale
summary: Fund of the mining company Vale, which invests in the Brazilian bioeconomy and partnered with Microsoft and Imazon on the PrevisIA deforestation risk tool.

name: Genômica da Biodiversidade Brasileira
summary: Instituto Tecnológico Vale project sequencing the DNA of threatened, invasive and bioeconomically useful Brazilian species to give data for conservation.

name: GeoDatin
summary: Company working since 2018 on spatial data for companies, government and NGOs. It co-coordinates the Caatinga in MapBiomas and lists MapBiomas Água and MapBiomas Árida among its AI projects.

name: GeoKarten
summary: Co-coordinator of the Pampa biome in MapBiomas.

name: Green Bug
summary: Brazilian startup with acoustic monitoring of sounds on rural properties to measure biodiversity, selected for the Sustainable Soy Cerrado programme.

name: Greenpeace Brasil
summary: Brazilian office of Greenpeace, which developed the Papa Alpha remote monitoring system for mapping illegal mining in Indigenous lands.

name: Grupo de Geotecnologias em Ciência do Solo
summary: Soil science research group at the University of São Paulo's Esalq in Piracicaba, working on soil mapping and remote sensing, and coordinating the WorldSpecs soil spectroscopy project.

name: Grupo de Inteligência Ambiental, Instituto Tecnológico Vale
summary: Interdisciplinary research group at Instituto Tecnológico Vale that works on data science, land-use change and forest restoration.

name: HidroSat
summary: Satellite hydrological monitoring system of Brazil's National Water Agency.

name: Hutukara Associação Yanomami
summary: Yanomami organisation that works on territorial protection and has begun training young people to use drones and an early alert system.

name: IA para Monitoramento da Biodiversidade
summary: Kanindé project to build an AI index that detects early signs of forest degradation in the Amazon in under seven days.

name: IA-FogoBio
summary: Project coordinated by the Federal Institute of Amazonas to predict fire risk in the Amazon with AI, up to 14 days ahead, and measure the effects of fire on biodiversity.

name: IAguas
summary: Project of the startup VM9 and the Fluminense Federal University that uses computational models to predict water quality risk events in the Guandu river basin, with Finep funding.

name: IComp AI Research Group, Federal University of Amazonas
summary: Research group at the Federal University of Amazonas applying AI to biodiversity conservation and environmental monitoring in the Amazon, with work on camera traps, bioacoustics and multimodal models.

name: Ictio Áudio
summary: Offline voice tool for the Ictio platform in which AI transcribes fishers' spoken records for fisheries statistics in the Amazon basin.

name: Idarsa
summary: AI system in development to identify Amazonian fish species automatically at the fish passage system of the Belo Monte dam on the Xingu.

name: IDEFLOR-Bio
summary: State body whose founding law gives it the job of carrying out state conservation unit policy, including proposing units, and makes it responsible for monitoring them.

name: IESB
summary: NGO that a 2004 O Eco column named among those managing some of the largest and best-managed private natural heritage reserves, in Bahia; current status unknown.

name: INCT IAmazônia
summary: National Institute of Science and Technology on AI, IoT and communications for the Amazon, including environmental monitoring, hosted at the Federal University of Pará.

name: InfoAmazonia
summary: Non-profit news organisation based in Brazil that combines data, maps and geolocated reporting on the Amazon, and says it works to open databases on the region.

name: InstantDetect on Borarí land
summary: Eight InstantDetect AI cameras on access roads used by illegal loggers, sending alerts by satellite to the Indigenous Borarí people in the Brazilian Amazon.

name: Instituto Araguaia
summary: Brazilian NGO working in the Cantão region that has used drones to monitor the Araguaian river dolphin population.

name: Instituto Arapyaú
summary: Institute promoting fair, low-carbon development in Brazil, and a funder and institutional partner of MapBiomas.

name: Instituto Atlântico
summary: Developer of Idarsa, an AI system to identify Amazonian fish at Belo Monte.

name: Instituto Baleia Jubarte
summary: Brazilian humpback whale organisation that uses photo-identification, GPS records and AI assessment on a database of more than 8,000 individuals, and works with ports on reducing ship strikes.

name: Instituto Biosfera
summary: Listed on GlobalGiving as running a project in the Serra da Bocaina that monitors the Atlantic Forest with drones, camera traps and acoustic recorders.

name: Instituto Brasileiro de Geografia e Estatística
summary: Brazil's national statistics and mapping body; a 2021 presentation by its geosciences director covers its role in Earth observation for the Sustainable Development Goals, including land cover.

name: Instituto Brasileiro do Meio Ambiente e dos Recursos Naturais Renováveis
summary: Brazil's federal environmental enforcement agency, whose then president said in January 2025 that it was starting to use artificial intelligence to detect deforestation and infractions.

name: Instituto Centro de Vida
summary: Mato Grosso institute working on sustainable land use. It publishes the Monitor do Desmatamento for the Amazon and Cerrado and a Monitor das Queimadas tool, and is a technical partner of MapBiomas.

name: Instituto Chico Mendes de Conservação da Biodiversidade
summary: Brazil's federal protected-area agency, which runs the national biodiversity monitoring programme Monitora and the Salve platform on species extinction risk.

name: Instituto Clima e Sociedade
summary: Brazilian philanthropic organisation that ran the AI for Nature and Climate Challenge with Google.org support, choosing eight projects from 395 proposals.

name: Instituto de Conservação e Desenvolvimento Sustentável da Amazônia
summary: Amazon organisation that supports impact businesses through the AMAZ accelerator.

name: Instituto de Desenvolvimento Sustentável e Meio Ambiente do Rio Grande do Norte
summary: State environment agency of Rio Grande do Norte (Idema), through which the state government managed the Mata da Pipa state park, according to the park's 2014 management plan.

name: Instituto de Desenvolvimento Sustentável Mamirauá
summary: Research unit linked to the science ministry, in the Amazon, that developed the Providence system for AI-based, real-time biodiversity monitoring.

name: Instituto de Governança Territorial e Políticas Públicas
summary: Institute developing an AI platform for sustainable rural finance under the AI for Nature and Climate Challenge.

name: Instituto de Manejo e Certificação Florestal e Agrícola
summary: Brazilian non-profit founded in 1995 working on forest and farm supply chains and land use, which publishes data tools.

name: Instituto de Matemática Pura e Aplicada
summary: Brazilian mathematics institute that built, with Imazon, the AI model used to validate deforestation alerts.

name: Instituto de Meio Ambiente de Mato Grosso do Sul
summary: State environment institute of Mato Grosso do Sul, which launched the Mades deforestation and Maques fire alert systems.

name: Instituto de Pesquisa Ambiental da Amazônia
summary: Brazilian research organisation on the Amazon and Cerrado that launched the Cerrado deforestation alert system with MapBiomas and LAPIG.

name: Instituto de Pesquisas Ecológicas
summary: Brazilian research and conservation NGO working in the Atlantic Forest, Amazon, Pantanal and Cerrado. It is credited as a data contributor to Forest Listeners, Google's bioacoustic AI experiment.

name: Instituto de Pesquisas Jardim Botânico do Rio de Janeiro
summary: Federal research institute that has a laboratory coordination on the flora and fungi of Brazil and hosts the National Centre for Flora Conservation (CNCFlora).

name: Instituto de Tecnologia e Sociedade
summary: Brazilian institute that gave technical support to the selection for the AI for Nature and Climate Challenge.

name: Instituto do Homem e Meio Ambiente da Amazônia
summary: Brazilian non-profit research institute on Amazon conservation and development, which wrote the AI algorithm behind the PrevisIA deforestation risk platform.

name: Instituto do Meio Ambiente de Santa Catarina
summary: Santa Catarina state environment institute whose portaria sets up a technical commission to coordinate creation of the state conservation units it administers and to guide the creation of municipal ones.

name: Instituto do Meio Ambiente do Estado de Alagoas
summary: State environment agency of Alagoas (IMA), listed in the Socioambiental protected area record as managing body of the Morros do Craunã e do Padre wildlife refuge.

name: Instituto do Meio Ambiente e dos Recursos Hídricos do Distrito Federal
summary: Environment and water resources agency of the Federal District (Brasília Ambiental), whose Reviva Parques programme, set up by a 2021 decree and regulated in 2022, encourages partnerships to maintain conservation units.

name: Instituto do Meio Ambiente e Recursos Hídricos (Inema)
summary: Bahia state environment and water resources institute that, by a portaria, sets rules for research and teaching in the state conservation units it administers.

name: Instituto Estadual de Florestas
summary: Uses Programa Monitora at Rio Doce State Park, monitoring mammals, birds and butterflies annually and woody plants every five years; the 2026 campaigns ended on 13 May.

name: Instituto Estadual de Meio Ambiente (Iema)
summary: Espírito Santo state environment institute that delivers management plans for state conservation units, with recent plans covering the Goiapaba-Açu protection area and the Morro da Vargem area of relevant ecological interest.

name: Instituto Estadual do Ambiente do Rio de Janeiro
summary: State environment agency of Rio de Janeiro (INEA), which the 2013 state decree creating the Mendanha state park says will administer that park.

name: Instituto Federal de Rondônia
summary: Federal institute in Rondônia that is a partner in Kanindé's AI biodiversity monitoring project.

name: Instituto Federal do Amazonas
summary: Federal education and science institute in Amazonas that coordinates the IA-FogoBio project.

name: Instituto Homem Pantaneiro
summary: Pantanal organisation that uses the Pantera AI camera system to detect fire, working from Corumbá.

name: Instituto Humanize
summary: Institute behind the Observatório da Biodiversidade, which runs a project opening records of wild cats in Brazil, and a named funder of MapBiomas.

name: Instituto Internacional de Educação do Brasil
summary: Brazilian institute updating a Brazil-nut bioeconomy data system with AI under the AI for Nature and Climate Challenge.

name: Instituto Mar Urbano
summary: Ocean NGO founded by Ricardo Gomes that joined NatureMetrics and OceanPact on an eDNA sailing expedition along the Brazilian coast.

name: Instituto Marcos Daniel
summary: Private non-profit set up in 2004 for research and conservation, according to World Land Trust, which created the Kaetés Reserve in 2021, protecting one of two known cherry-throated tanager sites.

name: Instituto Nacional de Pesquisas da Amazônia
summary: National Amazon research institute. It is a named partner in Amazon.ia and the Brazilian Team of XPRIZE Rainforest, and a data contributor to Google's Forest Listeners bioacoustic experiment.

name: Instituto Nacional de Pesquisas Espaciais
summary: Brazil's federal space research institute, under the science ministry, which runs the official deforestation monitoring systems PRODES and DETER and the Brazil Data Cube.

name: Instituto Natureza do Tocantins
summary: State authority in Palmas created by state law 858/1996 (Naturatins), whose 2022 ordinance covers management and handling of the conservation units of the Cantão mosaic.

name: Instituto Oceanográfico da Universidade de São Paulo
summary: University of São Paulo institute that developed an AI algorithm to identify six dolphin species of the South-West Atlantic from their whistles.

name: Instituto Relva
summary: Independent institution that grew from Serrapilheira's ecology pilot, producing science for public policy and developing an online geospatial platform on the value of ecosystem services.

name: Instituto Serrapilheira
summary: Brazilian science funder that lists a 2024 grant of R$100,000 to the Brazilian Team.

name: Instituto Sociedade, População e Natureza
summary: Partners in Tamo de Olho deforestation monitoring and was selected by UNDP in 1994 to coordinate its Small Grants Programme in Brazil, focused on the Cerrado.

name: Instituto Socioambiental
summary: Brazilian civil society organisation working with Indigenous peoples, whose 2024 report describes the Sirad-X and Sirad-I systems monitoring deforestation in the Xingu basin and on lands of isolated Indigenous peoples.

name: Instituto SOS Pantanal
summary: Organisation founded in 2009 that works on fire prevention, restoration and water security in the Pantanal, and co-coordinates the biome in MapBiomas.

name: Instituto Tecnológico Vale
summary: Research institute of the mining company Vale that partners with ICMBio on Environmental DNA, a project for the genetic mapping of Brazilian species.

name: Instituto Terra
summary: Non-governmental restoration organisation in Aimorés, Minas Gerais, which replants native forest in its own RPPN and, per its 2025 annual report, dedicates 2,346 hectares to restoration and conservation.

name: Instituto Uiraçu
summary: Organisation that says it maintains and monitors Atlantic Forest conservation units, works on creating and managing protected areas in the Serra Bonita region, and is Rainforest Trust's local partner there.

name: Instituto Água e Terra
summary: Paraná state body cataloguing 73 conservation units, of which 24 were open to visitors at the time of the release.

name: Inteligência Artificial para o Monitoramento da Biodiversidade Florestal em Biomas Brasileiros
summary: FGV research project that uses satellite and drone imagery with a weakly labelled learning method, LLP-Co, to monitor deforestation in the Amazon and study its biodiversity.

name: Inventário Florestal Nacional
summary: Brazil's national forest monitoring programme of systematic field data collection, set in law in 2012 and coordinated by the Brazilian Forest Service.

name: IÊ: Integrando Dados da Bioeconomia da Castanha-do-Brasil
summary: Project by the Instituto Internacional de Educação do Brasil to update a system with AI that forecasts Brazil-nut prices and analyses production regions.

name: JBS
summary: Conglomerate that sponsored the equipment for Abrace Pantanal, the AI fire detection project in the Pantanal.

name: Kanindé Associação de Defesa Etnoambiental
summary: Civil society organisation founded in 1992 in Porto Velho, Rondônia, working with Indigenous peoples and building an AI index for early signs of forest degradation.

name: Laboratório de Aplicações de Satélites Ambientais
summary: Laboratory at the Federal University of Rio de Janeiro that runs the ALARMES burned-area platform.

name: Laboratório de Processamento de Imagens e Geoprocessamento
summary: Federal University of Goiás laboratory that maps Brazilian pasture and is building Pasto Legal, an AI agent for pasture maps, forage forecasts and climate alerts.

name: Laboratório de Silvicultura Tropical
summary: Forest restoration laboratory at Esalq, University of São Paulo, whose projects use drones, remote sensing and deep learning to monitor restored forests.

name: Laboratório Nacional de Computação Científica
summary: National scientific computing laboratory that partnered with Fiocruz on the Saúde Silvestre e Inclusão Digital project, which won the II Prêmio Nacional de Biodiversidade in 2017.

name: Land Innovation Fund
summary: Fund that runs the Sustainable Soy Cerrado programme with AgTech Garage and finances startups in biodiversity and vegetation monitoring in Brazil.

name: Local DC
summary: Brazilian technology and digital infrastructure company based in Sorocaba that developed Aruanã.ai, an AI platform for environmental monitoring.

name: Mades and Maques
summary: Mato Grosso do Sul's deforestation and fire alert monitors, which use satellite images and automation to speed detection.

name: Mamirauá Declaration
summary: Commitment on biodiversity monitoring in the Amazon, led by Instituto Mamirauá and the Universitat Politècnica de Catalunya and presented at COP30 in Belém, with about thirty signatories.

name: MapBiomas Alerta
summary: System that validates and refines deforestation alerts with high-resolution satellite images for all Brazilian biomes and publishes reports on each event openly and free of charge.

name: MapBiomas Brasil land cover and land use collection
summary: Annual maps of native vegetation, farming, urban areas and other classes for Brazil, made mainly with random forests, with U-Net convolutional networks for some classes such as aquaculture and mining.

name: MapBiomas Fogo
summary: Maps of burned areas in Brazil's biomes from January 1985, made from Landsat imagery with a deep neural network on Google Earth Engine.

name: MapBiomas Monitor da Recuperação
summary: MapBiomas platform that overlays Brazil's datasets on recovery commitments with its land cover maps, to view and monitor areas with a commitment or obligation to recover native vegetation.

name: MapBiomas Água
summary: Maps of surface water in Brazil and derived products from 1985, which GeoDatin describes as made with artificial intelligence techniques.

name: MapBiomas Árida
summary: Deforestation alert system for drylands that GeoDatin lists among its projects and describes as using artificial intelligence algorithms.

name: Mappia-TAC
summary: Platform developed by CT-Modelagem at the Federal University of Minas Gerais that automates checks of cattle suppliers against rural registry, animal transit and deforestation data for the beef conduct agreement.

name: Marfrig
summary: Meatpacker whose Verde Mais plan includes a risk map crossing satellite maps and data to monitor indirect cattle suppliers.

name: MetaGen
summary: Belo Horizonte company applying environmental genomics, including eDNA and metabarcoding, to biodiversity monitoring.

name: Minerva Foods
summary: Meatpacker with a geospatial monitoring system for supplier farms in South America, audited annually, and the SMGeo Prospec app for producers.

name: Ministério da Ciência, Tecnologia e Inovação
summary: Brazil's federal science ministry, which conducts SiBBr, oversees INPE and publishes the Brazilian AI plan.

name: Ministério da Justiça e Segurança Pública
summary: Brazilian justice ministry that runs the Brasil Mais satellite imagery and alert programme.

name: Ministério do Desenvolvimento Agrário e Agricultura Familiar
summary: Federal ministry that signed agreements with 14 states to unify land data for the Terras do Brasil platform.

name: Ministério do Meio Ambiente e Mudança do Clima
summary: Brazil's federal environment ministry, which coordinated the national biodiversity strategy and action plan (EPANB 2025-2030) aligned with the Kunming-Montreal Global Biodiversity Framework.

name: Monitora Bio SP
summary: São Paulo state digital platform launched in 2026 by the Fundação Florestal to centralise biodiversity and management data for all state protected areas, with over 30,000 species records.

name: MonitoraBIOSP
summary: São Paulo state fauna monitoring programme, started in 2020, with 1,200 camera traps across 47 conservation units.

name: Monitoramento Ambiental por Imagens de Satélite
summary: São Paulo state tool that uses satellite images and geospatial data analysis to find vegetation change and direct enforcement.

name: Monitoramento remoto da restauração
summary: CI-Brasil and Sustainacraft project combining satellite images with field data to estimate biomass, biodiversity and carbon in restored areas of the Amazon, Atlantic Forest and Cerrado.

name: Monitoring biodiversity in Brazil's Atlantic Forest using RFCx bio-acoustic technology
summary: WeForest project at Pontal in the Atlantic Forest in which Rainforest Connection builds machine learning acoustic models for 40 species of interest.

name: Morfo
summary: Franco-Brazilian start-up that restores forest with seed-dropping drones in Brazil.

name: Mē Hoprê Catêjê (Guerreiras Krahô)
summary: Group that Mongabay says is responsible for surveillance in the Kraolândia Indigenous Land, walking the whole territory on patrols for 15 days each month.

name: Natura
summary: Brazilian cosmetics company that used Bioverse's drone and AI system to inventory six species across 40,000 hectares of Amazon forest for its supply chains.

name: Natureza ON
summary: Platform developed by MapBiomas and Fundação Grupo Boticário that maps climate vulnerability across Brazil and points to nature-based solutions.

name: Netflora
summary: Embrapa Acre method that combines drones and AI for forest inventories, which identified 604 Brazil nut trees in a flight of just over two hours.

name: Niceplanet Geotecnologia
summary: Geotechnology company that built, with the certifier SBcert, a geospatial cattle tracing system and partnered with Minerva on the SMGeo Prospec app.

name: NONATObase
summary: Database of polychaete worms of the Southwestern Atlantic, from 5°N to 80°S, built by the NONATO network of South American researchers and published on GBIF by the Universidade Federal de Santa Catarina.

name: Norte Energia
summary: Concessionaire of the Belo Monte dam, whose research programme supports the Idarsa fish identification AI.

name: Novaterra
summary: Rio de Janeiro company working with Another Earth, an Austrian synthetic Earth observation data firm, on environmental and energy projects in Brazil.

name: OBIS Brazil
summary: Brazil's national node of the Ocean Biodiversity Information System, operated by the SiBBr team. GBIF lists the Brazilian node under an older name, Tropical and Subtropical Western South Atlantic OBIS.

name: Observatório da Restauração e Reflorestamento
summary: Restoration data initiative whose launch is recorded in the Atlantic Forest Restoration Pact's 2023-2026 report, with attribute tables aligned to the Pact's area records.

name: Observatório do Clima
summary: Network of about 170 Brazilian civil society organisations. Its SEEG emissions estimation system is the origin of MapBiomas.

name: OceanPact
summary: Brazilian maritime services company partnering with NatureMetrics on eDNA, including a sailing expedition from Rio de Janeiro to Belém ahead of COP30.

name: Olho no Verde
summary: Rio de Janeiro state programme that monitors Atlantic Forest cover by satellite and sends alerts to field inspectors.

name: Onçafari
summary: Brazilian conservation organisation working in four biomes, mainly on jaguars and maned wolves. It published its first fauna monitoring datasets in SiBBr in 2026 and supports the AI fire detection project in the Pantanal.

name: Open Data Bio
summary: Biodiversity and ecology data repository at INPA's web address, with open public data available as JSON.

name: Organização das Associações da Resex Tapajós-Arapiuns
summary: Association body (Tapajoara) that the Socioambiental record lists as holding a 50-year concession from ICMBio for the Tapajós-Arapiuns reserve in Santarém and Aveiro.

name: Organização do Povo Indígena Parintintin do Amazonas
summary: Indigenous organisation listed among six supported by an Amazon Fund project that backed management plans for seven Indigenous lands in the Purus and Madeira basins and installed GIS toolkits for monitoring deforestation.

name: Organização dos Povos Indígenas Apurinã e Jamamadi
summary: Indigenous organisation listed among six supported by an Amazon Fund project that backed management plans for seven Indigenous lands in the Purus and Madeira basins and installed GIS toolkits for monitoring deforestation.

name: Organização dos Povos Indígenas Apurinã e Jamamadi de Boca do Acre/Amazonas
summary: Indigenous organisation listed among six supported by an Amazon Fund project that backed management plans for seven Indigenous lands in the Purus and Madeira basins and installed GIS toolkits for monitoring deforestation.

name: Organização dos Povos Indígenas do Rio Juruá
summary: Indigenous organisation headquartered in Cruzeiro do Sul, Acre, representing 14 peoples across 13 lands totalling 640,000 hectares, with an Amazon Fund project that built a Looker Studio management dashboard using data from 13 communities.

name: Pacto pela Restauração da Mata Atlântica
summary: Coalition of 372 members for restoring the Atlantic Forest, which registers restoration areas and works with the Observatório da Restauração.

name: Painel Alertas+
summary: ISA platform launched in 2021 that cross-references fire, deforestation and mining data for the Legal Amazon and protected areas.

name: Painel Aracuã
summary: Dashboard system conceived by Synergia Socioambiental, partner of SOS Pantanal, that monitors fire outbreaks in the Pantanal.

name: Pantera
summary: Umgrauemeio's wildfire intelligence platform, which uses cameras and AI to spot smoke in real time; its Pantanal cameras are run under the Abrace o Pantanal project.

name: Papa Alpha
summary: Greenpeace Brasil's remote monitoring system, which maps illegal mining in Indigenous lands from radar and optical alerts.

name: Participatory monitoring of traditional territories, digital platform
summary: Project led by the University of Leicester with the Federal University of Pará and others to build an AI digital toolkit for Amazonian communities to monitor socio-biodiversity.

name: PastoLegal
summary: Free AI agent from LAPIG/UFG, made with Solved and iCS and offered through WhatsApp, giving pasture maps, forage forecasts and climate alerts to producers in the Amazon and Cerrado.

name: Plano Brasileiro de Inteligência Artificial
summary: Brazil's national AI plan, which includes an impact action against biopiracy aimed at reducing animal trafficking and illegal trade in biodiversity products.

name: Plataforma Inteligente para Financiamento Rural Sustentável
summary: iGPP platform that will combine environmental and financial data to judge whether rural properties are eligible for credit.

name: PlenaMata
summary: Platform launched in 2021 by Natura, MapBiomas, InfoAmazonia and Hacklab to show Amazon deforestation with daily updates. Its site's certificate failed when read.

name: Polícia Federal
summary: Brazil's federal police, which uses satellite alerts through the Brasil MAIS programme against deforestation and illegal mining.

name: Política Nacional de Monitoramento e Restauração Ecológica Inteligente
summary: Bill in the Brazilian Senate, tabled in March 2026 by Senator Jader Barbalho, that would set rules for autonomous technologies such as AI and drones in biodiversity conservation.

name: Pontifícia Universidade Católica do Rio de Janeiro
summary: Rio university whose electrical engineering department built an AI model to help protect at-risk deep ocean ecosystems on the Brazilian coast.

name: Preserve Muriqui
summary: Institute that a March 2022 Mongabay article said managed the Feliciano Miguel Abdala private reserve in Caratinga, Minas Gerais, and whose 2006 to 2007 report records Conservation International Brasil funding.

name: PrevisIA
summary: Platform using AI to indicate areas at risk of deforestation in the Amazon, from Imazon, Microsoft and Fundo Vale.

name: PRODES
summary: INPE's satellite system that produces Brazil's annual deforestation figures, published through TerraBrasilis.

name: Programa BiomasBR
summary: INPE programme that coordinates Brazil's satellite monitoring of its biomes, including the DETER alert systems.

name: Programa BIOTA-FAPESP
summary: FAPESP programme launched in 1999 to know, map and analyse the biodiversity of São Paulo state and inform conservation policy.

name: Programa de Formação em Ecologia Quantitativa
summary: Free training programme from Instituto Serrapilheira for researchers who want to work in ecology with quantitative tools from computing and mathematics.

name: Programa de Pesquisa em Biodiversidade
summary: Programme created in 2004 to intensify biodiversity studies in Brazil and decentralise scientific production, listed as a network at GBIF.

name: Programa de Pesquisa em Biodiversidade do Pantanal
summary: Pantanal biodiversity research programme, partner with the Federal University of Mato Grosso do Sul and Cornell on AI acoustic monitoring funded by the Bezos Earth Fund.

name: Programa de Pesquisas Ecológicas de Longa Duração
summary: CNPq-coordinated network of ecological research sites running since 1999, with 55 sites approved under the 2024 call and about 60 million reais of federal funding from 1999 to 2025.

name: Programa Monitora
summary: ICMBio's national long-term biodiversity monitoring programme for federal protected areas, set up by normative instruction in 2017 and reformulated in 2022.

name: Programa SisMOM
summary: INPE programme for a monitoring system of Brazilian waters using satellites, moored buoys, model forecasts and AI, focused on detecting oil slicks and vessels.

name: Providence
summary: AI sensor system for monitoring Amazon biodiversity in real time, developed by Instituto Mamirauá with the Polytechnic University of Catalonia and a finalist team in XPRIZE Rainforest.

name: Quiron
summary: Start-up created in Lages, Santa Catarina, in 2018, that monitors forest threats remotely. Its own algorithms find pest and disease attacks in planted forests and areas at higher risk of fire ignition.

name: re.green
summary: Rio de Janeiro restoration company founded in 2021 that combines AI, drones and satellite images with ecological and financial data to find degraded land to restore, and won the 2025 Earthshot Prize.

name: ReefSYN
summary: Ecological synthesis group formed in 2019 under the SinBiose Institute of Brazil's research council, which gathers long-term data on reefs along the Brazilian coast and oceanic islands.

name: Repositório de Dados do PPBio
summary: Open-access virtual repository of the Brazilian Biodiversity Research Programme, holding survey metadata, environmental variables and species records.

name: Reserva Ecológica de Guapiaçu
summary: NGO (REGUA) that Rainforest Trust says has bought land for a 22,466-acre reserve in the Guapiaçu Valley, and which a 2019 report said had reforested 60 hectares with 120,000 native seedlings.

name: Reserva Natural Vale
summary: Private forest conservation area described in Vale's 2022 activity report, which lists it as the site of a 2022 family picnic with 442 participants.

name: SAD Cerrado
summary: Monthly deforestation alert system for all native vegetation in the Cerrado, using advanced detection algorithms, from IPAM with MapBiomas and LAPIG.

name: Salve
summary: ICMBio's online platform holding extinction-risk assessments for nearly 15,000 Brazilian species.

name: SAVE Brasil
summary: Organisation whose shorebird programme promoted an online meeting of ISS Brasil volunteers on 30 August 2023, as reported in Manomet's December 2023 bulletin.

name: SCCON Geospatial
summary: Brazilian geospatial company whose platform provides automated change detection for the Brasil MAIS programme.

name: ScoreCAR
summary: API from Imaflora and Agrotools that scores the reliability of records in Brazil's rural environmental registry using AI and machine learning.

name: Secretaria de Estado de Meio Ambiente de Mato Grosso
summary: Mato Grosso's state environment department, which runs a vegetation cover monitoring platform with public deforestation alerts.

name: Secretaria de Estado de Meio Ambiente do Acre
summary: State environment secretariat of Acre (SEMA-AC), listed in the Socioambiental protected area record as managing body of the APA do Lago do Amapá.

name: Secretaria de Estado de Meio Ambiente e Desenvolvimento Sustentável de Goiás (Semad)
summary: Goiás state environment secretariat that approved three new management plans for state conservation units in 2025, covering the Telma Ortegal and Araguaia state parks and the Águas de São João area.

name: Secretaria de Estado de Meio Ambiente e dos Recursos Naturais do Maranhão
summary: State environment secretariat of Maranhão, which Funbio's September 2019 terms of reference describe as managing the Parcel de Manuel Luís state marine park, a full-protection unit.

name: Secretaria de Estado de Meio Ambiente e Sustentabilidade do Pará
summary: Environment secretariat of Pará state, which publishes the SeloVerde platform.

name: Secretaria de Estado do Desenvolvimento Ambiental
summary: A state environment body that, according to the Socioambiental protected area record, manages the Guajará-Mirim state park through its conservation units coordination.

name: Secretaria de Estado do Meio Ambiente do Amapá
summary: A state environment secretariat listed in the Socioambiental protected area record as the managing body of the Floresta Estadual do Amapá.

name: Secretaria de Estado do Meio Ambiente do Amazonas
summary: A state environment secretariat listed in the Socioambiental protected area record as the managing body of the Maués state forest.

name: Secretaria de Meio Ambiente e Recursos Hídricos
summary: An environment and water resources secretariat listed in the Socioambiental protected area record as the managing body of the Serra de Santo Antônio state park.

name: Secretaria de Meio Ambiente, Infraestrutura e Logística de São Paulo
summary: São Paulo state environment department, which runs the DataGEO data infrastructure and the Mais satellite monitoring tool.

name: Secretaria do Meio Ambiente (SEMACE)
summary: An environment secretariat in Ceará listed in the Socioambiental protected area record as the managing body of the APA da Bica do Ipu.

name: Secretaria do Meio Ambiente e Infraestrutura do Rio Grande do Sul
summary: A state environment and infrastructure secretariat; the state government reported in December 2024 that it was modernising conservation unit infrastructure, and in June 2026 that the state had 25 such units.

name: Secretaria Municipal de Meio Ambiente, Urbanismo e Sustentabilidade de Porto Alegre
summary: A municipal secretariat that, according to a city news item dated 22 August 2025, administers Porto Alegre's four municipal conservation units.

name: Secretaria Municipal do Meio Ambiente de Curitiba
summary: A municipal environment secretariat that Curitiba Law 15744, dated 27 October 2020, makes manager of the municipal conservation unit system, responsible for setting up and administering units.

name: Secretaria Municipal do Verde e do Meio Ambiente de São Paulo
summary: A municipal environment secretariat; a city page dated 23 October 2026 says ten of the city's twelve conservation units are under municipal management.

name: SeloVerde
summary: Public online system from the Pará state government, built with the Territorial Intelligence Centre at the Federal University of Minas Gerais, for rural property traceability and monitoring of deforestation.

name: Serviço Florestal Brasileiro
summary: Federal forest service that coordinates the National Forest Inventory and whose data feed the National Forest Information System.

name: Siapesq
summary: Brazilian startup that began with an AI system for fisheries management and was contracted by the state of Rio de Janeiro to build BlueVision Tool for coastal monitoring.

name: SIM-Biomas
summary: Amazon Fund project of R$147.6 million to build a new generation of AI-based monitoring of native vegetation across Brazil's biomes, carried out by Funcate with technical execution by INPE.

name: SinBiose
summary: CNPq research programme for synthesis of existing knowledge on biodiversity and ecosystem services.

name: SIPAM Mar
summary: Brazilian web system from Censipam and the Federal University of Bahia that uses radar images and neural algorithms to detect oil slicks at sea.

name: SipamSAR
summary: Censipam's integrated deforestation alert system, due to be expanded by the Amazônia SAR project by December 2027.

name: Sirad-X
summary: Monitoring of deforestation and degradation in the Xingu basin in Mato Grosso and Pará, used by the Rede Xingu+ network.

name: Sistema de Alerta de Desmatamento
summary: Imazon's monthly alerts on deforestation and forest degradation in the Brazilian Amazon, moved to Google Earth Engine in 2012.

name: Sistema de Alertas de Desmatamento da Mata Atlântica
summary: Deforestation alert system for Brazil's Atlantic Forest, built on Sentinel imagery and AI, to support enforcement bodies and buyers with zero-deforestation policies.

name: Sistema de Apoio ao Monitoramento de Mamíferos Marinhos
summary: System giving access to marine mammal monitoring information, built by Universidade do Vale do Itajaí, whose data are described as a valuable collection.

name: Sistema de Informação em Saúde Silvestre
summary: Fiocruz's digital tool for participatory wildlife monitoring, which logs georeferenced observations on phones and generates disease alerts, with open data for reuse.

name: Sistema de Informação sobre a Biodiversidade Brasileira
summary: Brazil's online platform, conducted by the science ministry, that gathers biodiversity and ecosystem data from different sources and makes it available for reuse.

name: Sistema de Inteligência do Fogo em Áreas Úmidas
summary: Platform of map layers on vegetation type, biomass, forecast fire danger and property fire history, which Imasul announced in November 2023 it had available to assess burning and fire management licence requests.

name: Sistema de Observação e Monitoramento da Amazônia Indígena
summary: Open virtual library of geographic and scientific data for monitoring and managing Indigenous territories in the Brazilian Amazon, developed by IPAM with Indigenous organisations and in existence since 2014.

name: Sistema Integrado de Monitoramento e Alertas de Desmatamento
summary: Satellite deforestation alert system developed in Santa Catarina and adapted by Mato Grosso do Sul through the Codesul states.

name: Sistema Inteligente para Monitoramento Florestal de Terras Indígenas Amazônicas
summary: Fundação Getulio Vargas project with COIAB to build a platform using satellites and AI to monitor Indigenous territories, identify environmental crimes and support restoration.

name: Sistema Nacional de Anilhamento de Aves Silvestres
summary: National bird ringing system, run by CEMAVE, that coordinates ringer registration, authorisations, ring distribution and processing of ringing and recovery data, with recoveries used to monitor lifespan, migration and population change.

name: Sistema Nacional de Informações Florestais
summary: National system that registers, processes and shares data and knowledge on Brazil's forests, fed by the National Forest Inventory.

name: Sistema Urubu
summary: Citizen science platform and app that gathers reports of wildlife killed on Brazilian roads, run through the Centro Brasileiro de Estudos em Ecologia de Estradas at UFLA.

name: SITAMAR
summary: Sea turtle database of Projeto Tamar, with more than 30 years of data and recapture records.

name: SMGeo Prospec
summary: Mobile app from Minerva Foods and Niceplanet that gives producers the geospatial checks the industry uses on its own supply chain.

name: Snapshot Brasil
summary: National standardised mammal monitoring network with camera traps, coordinated from São Paulo State University, that shares open data.

name: Sociedade de Pesquisa em Vida Selvagem e Educação Ambiental
summary: Conservation organisation, SPVS, which says its main work is in the Grande Reserva Mata Atlântica, and which announced in November 2026 that the Complexo Pequeno Príncipe had bought five thousand biodiversity credits.

name: Solved
summary: Company based in the Brazilian Amazon that makes software, hardware and computing routines for remote sensing and spatial analysis. It co-coordinates coastal zone and mining mapping in MapBiomas and partners on PastoLegal.

name: speciesLink
summary: Public e-infrastructure sharing biological collection records, developed and maintained by CRIA since 2001.

name: Standardized datasets of Brazilian reef diversity in space and time
summary: Compilation of standardised reef datasets on GBIF. Its first part holds fish counts and size estimates from 4,570 transects at 137 localities from 0° to 27°S, under a CC BY 4.0 licence.

name: Sucellus Tech
summary: Geospatial intelligence company using drones and satellites with machine learning to find anomalies on the ground. Its nature use is thin and needs a second look.

name: Superintendência de Administração do Meio Ambiente do Estado da Paraíba
summary: A state environment agency listed in the Socioambiental protected area record as the management agency of the Mata do Pau Ferro state park.

name: Superintendência de Meio Ambiente e Recursos Hídricos
summary: An environment and water resources superintendency listed in the Socioambiental protected area record as the management agency of the Grota do Angico natural monument.

name: Suzano
summary: Pulp producer that runs a biodiversity monitoring study with IPÊ in Mato Grosso do Sul using sound recorders, environmental DNA and AI.

name: Syncorp
