summary: Dataset run and built by CONAF, started in 1993 as a national survey of land use and plant formations, with recent updates using higher-resolution satellite imagery.

name: Centinelas Comunitarios
summary: Programme that supports community participatory monitoring.

name: Centro Ballena Azul
summary: A non-governmental organisation that describes itself as using applied science and satellite monitoring, and which generates high-resolution geospatial modelling of overlap with shipping.

name: Centro de Ecología Aplicada y Sustentabilidad
summary: A research centre run by Pontificia Universidad Católica de Chile, with a stated mission since 2014 of applied environmental research, and an affiliated author on a 2024 machine-learning fish paper.

name: Centro de Información de Recursos Naturales
summary: An organisation that provides information on Chile's natural resources and satellite and aerial imagery analysis, uses Sentinel-2, and in October 2026 was reported to be working on forest change detection.

name: Centro de Investigación en Ecosistemas de la Patagonia
summary: A research centre in Coyhaique offering an open-data geoportal for Chile's southern macrozone, with affiliated authors on a 2021 paper on forest degradation using machine learning.

name: Centro de Modelamiento Matemático
summary: A University of Chile mathematical modelling centre that presented a Magallanes wetland monitoring system with GIZ, hosted the regional Copernicus centre (reported November 2024), and has authors on a 2021 blue whale call detection paper.

name: Centro de Observación de la Tierra Hémera
summary: A remote sensing centre created in 2017 to promote knowledge and transfer, which says its work supports agriculture, forestry, mining, tourism, energy and fisheries.

name: Centro Nacional de Inteligencia Artificial
summary: A Chilean AI research centre that partners with CONAF and the French non-profit Pyronear, and began collaborating with Pyronear on smoke detection in April 2023.

name: Chatbot de Inteligencia Artificial para Fiscalización Pesquera
summary: A pilot AI assistant for fisheries inspectors, run by Fundación Mar Futura in coordination with Sernapesca.

name: Cienciambiental Consultores S.A.
summary: A consultancy in Ñuñoa, Santiago, that says it produces data through satellite remote sensing and professional scientific equipment.

name: CLSoilMaps
summary: Recorded by OpenAlex in a 2023 publication, this dataset covers gridded physical and hydraulic soil properties for Chile.

name: Codelco
summary: Presented results of a biodiversity pilot combining satellite technology, AI and applied science, and says it has had a Nature and Biodiversity Strategy since 2025.

name: Codelco and Lemu biodiversity pilot
summary: A closed biodiversity pilot under a 2025 Codelco and Lemu agreement, worked on a reserve and the Campiche wetland, and identified more than 65 species at Roblería de Loncha.

name: Compañía Minera del Pacífico
summary: A mining company that had two AI-driven hydroacoustic buoys installed in Chungungo within its Puerto Cruz Grande project, in partnership with Acústica Marina.

name: Comunidad Agrícola Los Choros
summary: An agricultural community that administers the roughly 1,129-hectare Humedal La Boca nature sanctuary in La Higuera commune under a sanctuary declaration, supervised by the State.

name: Comunidad Atacameña de Coyo
summary: An Atacameño community that co-administers the roughly 1,298.61-hectare Laguna Tebenquiche nature sanctuary, north of the Salar de Atacama, with the Solor community, under a sanctuary declaration.

name: Comunidad Atacameña de Solor
summary: An Atacameño community that co-administers the roughly 1,298.61-hectare Laguna Tebenquiche nature sanctuary, north of the Salar de Atacama, with the Coyo community, under a sanctuary declaration.

name: Comunidad Campo Jahuel
summary: A community assigned administration of the roughly 6,741-hectare El Zaino - Laguna El Copín nature sanctuary in Santa María commune by decree, under Ministry of the Environment supervision.

name: Comunidad Indígena Altué
summary: A Chilean Indigenous community designated by a December 2019 maritime destination decree to administer a 260.48-hectare coastal marine space for Indigenous peoples.

name: Comunidad Indígena Huicha Pucatué
summary: A Chilean Indigenous community designated by a January 2020 maritime destination decree to administer the 174.33-hectare Pucatué coastal marine space for Indigenous peoples.

name: Comunidad Indígena Ma’u Henua
summary: An Indigenous community granted a renewable 50-year concession by the Chilean State in November 2017 to administer, care for and preserve Rapa Nui National Park.

name: CONAF and CENIA AI wildfire detection cameras
summary: An active CONAF and CENIA wildfire camera project with four installations reported in Magallanes in March 2026 and agreements reported in La Araucanía in June 2026.

name: Conexión Kimal Lo Aguirre S.A.
summary: A company that, with Lemu, announced in April 2025 the start of satellite monitoring of its project's area of influence, as reported by Portal Minero.

name: COPAS Coastal
summary: A research organisation that in July 2023 described Susannah Buchan as a researcher at COPAS Coastal and CEAZA.

name: Corporación Bosques de Zapallar
summary: A corporation that administers the roughly 17.02-hectare Cerro de la Cruz nature sanctuary in Zapallar commune under a sanctuary declaration, supervised by the State.

name: Corporación Centro de Conservación y Manejo Bahía Lomas
summary: A corporation that administers the roughly 58,946-hectare Bahía Lomas nature sanctuary in the commune of Primavera, Magallanes, under a sanctuary declaration.

name: Corporación de Fomento de la Producción
summary: A funding body that, according to Acústica Marina's January 2025 announcement, awarded it the Innova High Technology Fund for marine conservation, and which also funds Ecolidar.

name: Corporación Nacional Forestal
summary: A private-law forest and protected-areas administrator under the agriculture ministry, undergoing transformation into a public service, which has trialled AI photo sorting and uses wildfire cameras and Sentinel-2 imagery.

name: Corporación para el Desarrollo del Turismo y Conservación del Patrimonio de la Región de Tarapacá
summary: A corporation, known as Cordetur, that administers the roughly 29.4-hectare Oasis de Niebla Punta Gruesa nature sanctuary under a sanctuary declaration.

name: Costa Humboldt
summary: An organisation that says it was founded in 2012, improves marine ecosystem health and has an open database of over 4 million biodiversity records.

name: Data Cube Chile
summary: Active alliance of three bodies building on the Open Data Cube for satellite monitoring of Chilean land and sea, with a prototype funded by Australia's foreign affairs department and the Data Observatory.

name: Data Observatory
summary: Described variously as a public-private-academia collaboration led by the science and economy ministries, a public-private academic foundation (OECD.AI), and a public-private non-profit (science ministry).

name: Deep-Hub
summary: Closed project, led by Guillermo Cabrera-Vives and built by Universidad de Concepción, which a December 2023 report described as monitoring forest land with satellite imagery to identify trees, crowns, soils and possible anomalies.

name: Dirección General de Aguas
summary: Active national water body whose hydrometric network has 4,397 stations, including water quality and lake monitoring.

name: Drovid
summary: Chilean start-up that WIPO says develops AI-enabled drones with monitoring technology and identifies wildfire risk factors in real time.

name: Ecogen
summary: Concepción-based company that says it uses environmental DNA to identify species and sustainability indicators, and which Ladera Sur reports was founded in 2019 by two marine biologists and does monitoring for CONAF.

name: EcoLidar
summary: Closed project run by Agroplan and funded by Corfo, which used LiDAR-equipped drones to build three-dimensional models and presented results at a seminar in early November 2025.

name: Ecometric
summary: An active organisation mentioned by the Biobío regional development committee in connection with FAUNOline, an online bird-monitoring system.

name: Estación Costera de Investigaciones Marinas
summary: Marine research station at Las Cruces, with over 40 years of work, holding series from meteorology, radar, seawater sensors, historical samples and subtidal monitoring, and listed as an LTSER Chile site.

name: Estación Patagonia de Investigaciones Interdisciplinarias UC
summary: Research station run by Pontificia Universidad Católica de Chile, whose news page lists students building a bird song identification model and which says its GeoPortal will show dynamic maps of monitored variables.

name: Estudio de monitoreo de largo plazo de roedores y otros animales en el Parque Nacional Fray Jorge
summary: Long-term study of rodents and other animals in Fray Jorge National Park, marked in August 2019 as thirty years old and led by Julio Gutiérrez.

name: FAUNOline
summary: Project of unknown status, built by Ecometric, that combines computer vision and three-dimensional tracking.

name: FlameSense
summary: An active company using AI to detect, alert on and identify fire causes, with interconnected pods installed in forests or land, according to UC.

name: Fondo de Investigación del Bosque Nativo
summary: An active fund for researchers on native forest ecosystems whose applications closed on 6 March 2026.

name: Fortalecimiento del Monitoreo y Conservación del Huemul en el Parque Nacional Patagonia
summary: Project of unknown status, partnered with the National Geographic Society, whose tool Rewilding Chile reported in September 2023 had been made available for huemul monitoring by Rewilding Chile and CONAF in Patagonia National Park.

name: Fraunhofer Chile
summary: Active organisation whose offer sheet on environmental DNA comes from its Centre for Systems Biotechnology.

name: Fuerza Aérea de Chile
summary: Air force that in September 2026 was preparing to launch two microsatellites under the Sistema Nacional Satelital, and whose image processing system was administered at its aerial photogrammetry service in January 2023.

name: Fundación Acantilados de Maitencillo
summary: Organisation that says it keeps constant track of biodiversity to produce conservation data, listing a Humboldt booby census and behavioural study and native carnivore monitoring, and is funded by Guanay.

name: Fundación Capital Azul
summary: An organisation associated with community-led Marine Refuges since 2016, which Mar Futura says it works with on acoustic monitoring alongside installed cameras.

name: Fundación Conservación Marina
summary: An organisation reporting that the Zarapitón de Invierno citizen science bird-monitoring day took place on 15 August 2026 in coastal wetlands of southern Chile.

name: Fundación Cosmos
summary: A foundation assigned by decree to administer the roughly 60.3-hectare Humedal Río Maipo nature sanctuary, and required to report annually on its management.

name: Fundación Educacional Origen
summary: A foundation assigned by decree to administer the roughly 202-hectare Los Maitenes del Río Claro nature sanctuary, under Ministry of the Environment supervision.

name: Fundación Huilo Huilo
summary: Foundation whose 2022–23 report describes a wildlife monitoring system with 28 camera traps and a puma project, funded in 2022, using 10 GPS collars.

name: Fundación Kennedy
summary: A foundation that administers the roughly 2.2-hectare Aguada La Chimba nature sanctuary in northern Antofagasta under a sanctuary declaration, supervised by the Ministry of the Environment.

name: Fundación Kreen
summary: Organisation whose director was reported by Universidad Alberto Hurtado in October 2026 as saying AI had cut photo and recording classification from six or seven months to a week.

name: Fundación Mar Adentro
summary: Organisation that Round River says funds interdisciplinary conservation and socio-ecological art-science initiatives across Chile, with a researcher shown checking a camera trap by Smart Forests.

name: Fundación Mar Futura
summary: Organisation that says it empowers coastal communities to monitor marine areas with low-cost technology.

name: Fundación MERI
summary: Organisation that is part of Filantropía Cortés Solari, according to its site, and has done scientific research for conservation since 2012.

name: Fundación Parque Katalapi
summary: A foundation that administers Parque Katalapi, a roughly 25-hectare nature sanctuary, under a sanctuary declaration, supervised by the Ministry of the Environment.

name: Fundación Parque Tantauco
summary: Organisation whose monitoring programme supports the management plan for the park's 110,000 hectares.

name: Fundación Punta de Lobos
summary: The foundation protects Punta de Lobos coastal park near Pichilemu and says it has restored soil, removed invasive species and replanted what originally grew there.

name: Fundación Rewilding Chile
summary: Renamed in 2021, it calls itself Tompkins Conservation’s Chilean legacy, installs camera traps for huemul conservation and reported AI camera traps in Patagonia National Park in September 2023.

name: Fundación San Carlos de Maipo
summary: A foundation that administers the roughly 274-hectare Laguna de Batuco nature sanctuary in the Metropolitan Region under a sanctuary declaration, supervised by the Ministry of the Environment.

name: Fundación San Ignacio del Huinay
summary: Foundation created in 1998 that says it has monitored the Comau fjord for over two decades and runs the POETA programme.

name: Fundación Sudamérica Diversa
summary: Organisation with a Rufford project approved in September 2025 that plans long-term herbivore monitoring and GPS-collar analysis of taruka deer; a February 2026 update reports 22 of 33 camera traps installed.

name: Fundación Tierra Austral
summary: A foundation that, under a 2024 conservation easement for Parque Valle Los Ulmos, co-holds protection duties with Ranita de Darwin and is to protect evergreen forests and study restoration.

name: GAIA German-Chilean biodiversity exchange
summary: Being developed by Pontificia Universidad Católica de Valparaíso, it aimed in August 2024 to provide biodiversity warnings, monitor condors and pumas, and combat illegal fishing through albatross tagging.

name: GBIF Chile
summary: National programme, run by the environment ministry, that aggregates biodiversity data from several sources and makes it freely available online; Chile signed the GBIF memorandum in 2009 and the node was established in 2012.

name: GEF Corredores Biológicos de Montaña
summary: Closed project, ID 5135, of the environment ministry and UN Environment Programme, dated 2016 to 2022.

name: Guardianes del Bosque
summary: Project described at its August 2021 launch as an audio monitoring system identifying sounds of nature, with five recorders installed in December 2020 in Nahuelbuta able to monitor 3,000 hectares, according to that report.

name: Guardians of the Forest
summary: Project in which five solar-powered Guardians were installed in December 2020, and which Huawei reported in August 2021 sent audio to Huawei Cloud for AI analysis.

name: Guardián de la Fauna
summary: Programme that is an Android and iPhone app with an encyclopaedia filled with community photographs, helping identify species while the team reviews each photograph.

name: HMM-DNN system for low-frequency ocean acoustic signals
summary: Model combining a hidden Markov model with a deep neural network, reported in July 2023 using data from a CTBTO-managed hydroacoustic station with six hydrophones off the Juan Fernández archipelago.

name: HNH Energy avian radar study
summary: Project in which Robin Radar reported in December 2023 that its MAX radar, deployed in April 2023 before wind park construction, was the first full 3D avian radar system on Chilean soil.

name: Identificación temprana y cuantificación de daños en brotes de Ormiscodes amphimone en bosques de Nothofagus glauca con sensores remotos en drones
summary: Closed native forest fund project on early detection of Ormiscodes amphimone damage in Nothofagus glauca using drone sensors, reported to have produced LiDAR and satellite models, vegetation indices and a 98-page guide.

name: IFOP fish image identification system
summary: Project run by the Instituto de Fomento Pesquero which, IFOP reported in December 2020, had passed its pilot phase and was expected to enter a trial period in 2021.

name: Ilustre Municipalidad de Caldera
summary: A municipality that presented the application for, and administers, the roughly 115.2-hectare Humedal Desembocadura Río Copiapó nature sanctuary in Caldera commune under a sanctuary declaration.

name: Ilustre Municipalidad de Castro
summary: A municipality that prepared the application for, and administers, the roughly 149-hectare Humedal Costero de Putemún nature sanctuary in Castro commune under a sanctuary declaration.

name: Ilustre Municipalidad de Chonchi
summary: A municipality that presented the application for, and administers, the roughly 3,030.6-hectare Lagos Huillinco y Cucao nature sanctuary in Chonchi commune under a sanctuary declaration.

name: Ilustre Municipalidad de Coelemu
summary: Municipal body that co-administers, with the municipality of Trehuaco, the roughly 926.7-hectare Humedal Desembocadura del río Itata nature sanctuary under a sanctuary declaration.

name: Ilustre Municipalidad de Concepción
summary: Municipal body that co-manages the roughly 2,174.5-hectare Humedal Desembocadura Río Biobío nature sanctuary, jointly with the municipalities of Hualpén and San Pedro de la Paz, under a sanctuary declaration.

name: Ilustre Municipalidad de Hualpén
summary: Municipal body that co-manages the roughly 2,174.5-hectare Humedal Desembocadura Río Biobío nature sanctuary, jointly with the municipalities of Concepción and San Pedro de la Paz, under a sanctuary declaration.

name: Ilustre Municipalidad de Pelluhue
summary: Municipal body that co-administers the roughly 241.5-hectare Arcos de Calán nature sanctuary in Pelluhue commune, together with a company, Sociedad Agrícola Las Mercedes Ltda., under a sanctuary declaration.

name: Ilustre Municipalidad de San Pedro de la Paz
summary: Municipal body that co-manages the Humedal Desembocadura Río Biobío sanctuary and administers the roughly 312-hectare Laguna Grande - Humedal Los Batros sanctuary, which it proposed, under sanctuary declarations.

name: Ilustre Municipalidad de Trehuaco
summary: Municipal body that co-administers, with the municipality of Coelemu, the roughly 926.7-hectare Humedal Desembocadura del río Itata nature sanctuary under a sanctuary declaration.

name: Ilustre Municipalidad de Vichuquén
summary: Municipal body that in February 2024 issued a decree declaring the Humedal Conexión Lago Vichuquén - Llico, about 108 hectares, a municipal reserve, and says it will implement protection measures.

name: Ilustre Municipalidad de Villa Alegre
summary: Municipal body that in December 2025 issued a decree declaring the roughly 622-hectare Villa Alegre portion of the Gúmera-Quilipín ridge a municipal nature reserve.

name: Ilustre Municipalidad de Yerbas Buenas
summary: Municipal body that in October 2025 issued a decree declaring the roughly 928-hectare Yerbas Buenas portion of the Gúmera-Quilipín ridge, in Linares province, Maule Region, a municipal nature reserve.

name: INACH chinstrap penguin camera-trap AI monitoring
summary: Active project run by the Instituto Antártico Chileno and led by Magdalena Marquez Diaz, using camera traps and neural networks so an AI algorithm can count adults and chicks autonomously.

name: Infraestructura de Datos Espaciales para la Evaluación de la Salud del Océano en Chile
summary: Project proposing in April 2024 to integrate ocean data for Chile's sea through a spatial database, a map server interoperating with open information sources and web applications.

name: Iniciativa Conservación de Especies Amenazadas
summary: Initiative run by Chile's environment ministry and FAO, funded by the Global Environment Facility, which a March 2025 FAO article says arranged a donation of seven camera traps for huemul monitoring.

name: Inria Chile
summary: Described as Inria's centre in Chile and run by Inria; it won US$2.5 million from the Google.org Impact Challenge: AI for Science, the only Latin American institution among the winners.

name: Instituto Antártico Chileno
summary: Institute with eight camera traps at Antarctic Peninsula penguin colonies under its Marine Protected Areas programme; Cooperativa Ciencia reports a project of the institute using AI to monitor chinstrap penguin colonies.

name: Instituto de Biodiversidad de Ecosistemas Antárticos y Subantárticos
summary: Institute that runs and builds its research data portal, which it says was created to gather, organise and share the scientific data the institute generates.

name: Instituto de Ecología y Biodiversidad
summary: Institute that El Mostrador says marks 20 years as a centre of excellence in 2026; it gave technical support to UNDP and the ministry on the seventh national report.

name: Instituto de Fomento Pesquero
summary: Non-profit corporation that runs the Sistema Integrado de Observación Marina; in December 2020 it reported its AI pilot classified over 80% of commercially important fish images entered.

name: Instituto Forestal
summary: State technological research institute under the Ministry of Agriculture, one of three bodies that carry out SIMEF, which it lists among its projects.

name: Instituto Geográfico Militar de Chile
summary: State service responsible for geography and mapping the national territory; its director's paper to a UN cartographic conference calls it the official body on national cartography.

name: Instituto Milenio en Socio-Ecología Costera
summary: Institute named as a partner by Mar Futura, with no other facts given.

name: Instituto Sistemas Complejos de Ingeniería
summary: Institute that won the 2026 FONDEF technological research competition with a wildfire management project.

name: Karukinka subantarctic forest monitoring
summary: Active project run by WCS Chile, which reported in June 2026 a scientific monitoring campaign in Karukinka focused on subantarctic Nothofagus forests.

name: KOPAs
summary: Project led by Alejandro Maass, in partnership with Tara Ocean Foundation, whose method uses machine learning and AI to analyse different types of data, according to a project member.

name: Laboratorio de Ecología y Bioacústica, Universidad Católica del Maule
summary: Laboratory in Talca that says its research contributes to developing acoustic monitoring as a conservation tool, and partners with Corporación Nacional Forestal.

name: Laboratorio de Fauna Silvestre, Universidad Austral de Chile
summary: Wildlife laboratory run by Universidad Austral de Chile and running Snapshot Chile; in March 2026 CONAF named it co-ordinator of the project, a role added in 2025.

name: Laboratorio de Geoinformación y Percepción Remota, PUCV
summary: Geoinformation and remote sensing laboratory run by PUCV, whose researchers made four phenological monitoring platforms available to CONAF.

name: Laboratorio de Invasiones Biológicas
summary: Laboratory run by Universidad de Concepción whose site lists a database of exotic species of Chile, a catalogue of naturalised plants and an application called Invasive CL.

name: Lemu
summary: Chilean nature intelligence start-up, as Reporte Minero describes it, that calls itself Latin America's leading Nature Tech company and said it raised $8 million in a Series A round in 2023.

name: Lemu Nge
summary: Satellite mission built and run by Lemu, described by the company as launched in 2024 and the first designed explicitly to monitor biodiversity.

name: Live Andes
summary: Proposed platform led by Cristian Bonacic, to be developed by UC, with twelve months planned to validate AI recognition, building on the Live Andes 1.0 citizen science platform.

name: MapBiomas Chile
summary: Active satellite mapping project led by Jaime Hernández, partnering with WWF Chile and two universities, using Landsat imagery and AI classifiers run on Google Earth Engine.

name: Mapping and Modelling the Habitat of the Endangered Jubaea chilensis Palm
summary: Project led by the University of Chile, awarded within ESA's Network of Resources programme, with its status unknown.

name: Marine otter eDNA survey in central Chile
summary: Project awarded $5,370 on 16 February 2026, funded by the Mohamed bin Zayed Species Conservation Fund, planning passive eDNA coastal sampling and a species-specific qPCR assay for the marine otter.

name: Midda
summary: Organisation that developed a platform with the JRI research centre.

name: Ministerio de Bienes Nacionales
summary: National ministry that in November 2026 signed a protocol with the environment ministry, SBAP and Fundación Rewilding Chile to advance a land donation for the proposed Cabo Froward National Park.

name: Ministerio del Medio Ambiente de Chile
summary: Chile's environment ministry, which runs GBIF Chile and SIMBIO; in March 2026 it reported that the Council of Ministers approved the National Biodiversity Strategy 2025-2030 and its action plan.

name: Modelo de Detección de Embarcaciones mediante IA
summary: Active project in which a hydrophone network with AI detects boats near marine refuges, built by Fundación Mar Futura in partnership with Fundación Capital Azul.

name: MOFOMO
summary: Proposed open multimodal foundation world model for ocean observations, led by Inria Chile and Nayat Sanchez-Pi, funded by Google.org, planning two early warning services over 36 months.

name: Monitoreo Acústico Pasivo in Parque Nacional Radal Siete Tazas
summary: Pilot passive acoustic monitoring run by CONAF with a Universidad Católica del Maule bioacoustics laboratory, using AudioMoth; in April 2023 CONAF reported 15 devices installed to record for 35 days.

name: Monitoreo de pingüino barbijo con inteligencia artificial
summary: Active project run by the Instituto Antártico Chileno and led by Magdalena Marquez Diaz, with eight active camera traps recording all year and a neural network vision system making automatic counts.

name: Municipalidad de Arauco
summary: Municipal body that administers the roughly 204.3-hectare Humedal Arauco - Desembocadura Río Carampangue nature sanctuary in Arauco commune under a sanctuary declaration.

name: Museo Nacional de Historia Natural
summary: According to the culture ministry, the museum’s collections were included in Zenodo and it presented Wikitaxa, a platform seeking to register specialists in Chilean fauna groups.

name: Nawi
summary: Santiago start-up founded in 2016, according to Descubre VC.

name: NIRnativa
summary: Project built by CONAF and led by agronomist Katherine Castro as of May 2026, combining near-infrared spectroscopy with AI models to select seeds early.

name: Nviro
summary: Organisation that says it integrates field records, machine learning and remote sensing to measure biodiversity.

name: Núcleo Milenio para la Ecología y Conservación de los Ecosistemas de Arrecifes Mesofóticos Templados
summary: Millennium nucleus, active since 2019 and led by Alejandro Pérez Matus, studying temperate mesophotic reefs in Chile with rebreather diving, ARMS and baited remote underwater cameras.

name: OCEAN-IA
summary: Project being developed by PUCV, led by Dante Queirolo with Instituto de Fomento Pesquero, aiming to record underwater species and classify and count them using trained AI algorithms.

name: OcéanIA
summary: A programme to develop AI and mathematical modelling tools for understanding the oceans, led by Inria Chile, now closed after five years and succeeded by MOFOMO.

name: ONG AMA Torres del Paine
summary: Non-governmental organisation, begun in 2004 as Agrupación Medio Ambiental AMA, that administers the management plan for the privately owned Reserva Cerro Paine and has done trail, reforestation and nursery work.

name: ONG AYNI
summary: Non-governmental organisation that administers the roughly 170.8-hectare Humedal de Cutipay nature sanctuary under a sanctuary declaration and prepared the sanctuary application.

name: ONG Ranita de Darwin
summary: An active organisation that has kept a long-term monitoring programme since 2014.

name: PIMHU
summary: A project, built by MIDDA, that gets key information on the conservation state of wetlands remotely from low-cost monitoring stations; its status is unknown.

name: Plansat
summary: Project led by Carmen Gloria Ossa and funded by the national research agency, which in July 2024 proposed a geospatial platform on wildfire history and forest recovery in Ñuble using satellite data.

name: Plataforma de Fotomonitoreo
summary: A dataset run by CONAF that offered open access at its May 2024 launch to over a million records from 2,000 cameras in 35 protected areas.

name: Plataforma de Políticas de la Biodiversidad
summary: An active programme whose user guide describes an information and document management platform with a living encyclopaedia of natural and planning elements, each placed on a map.

name: Plataforma para Diseñar Áreas Marinas Protegidas Costeras
summary: A completed project, run by Fundación Mar Futura, that sought to accelerate community marine protected areas in Latin America and the Caribbean through an AI platform for evidence-based decisions.

name: Plataformas de Monitoreo Fenológico
summary: A project of unknown status, used by CONAF, whose work covers four national parks.

name: Pontificia Universidad Católica de Chile
summary: A university whose academics are reported to be working on an AI platform for analysing camera-trap images of Chilean wildlife, and which CONAF names among Snapshot Chile's promoters.

name: Pontificia Universidad Católica de Valparaíso
summary: A university whose computer engineering and biology researchers were reported in September 2024 to be developing an AI early-warning system for biodiversity monitoring.

name: PREDIMAR
summary: An active project, built by Bioceanor and the Superintendencia del Medio Ambiente, deploying AI dissolved oxygen forecasts for salmon farming areas in Chilean fjords, currently in two areas around Puerto Montt.

name: PrioRest
summary: Active project led and built by Susana Paula, whose January 2026 proof of concept maps restoration interventions from fire details but cannot yet be applied nationwide.

name: Programa Austral Patagonia
summary: A team of the Universidad Austral de Chile, which runs it, that donated 60 camera traps to CONAF in March 2023 and says it helped design the camera-trap monitoring system.

name: Programa de fotomonitoreo de CONAF
summary: A CONAF camera-trap programme that reported over a million records from 2,000 cameras in 35 protected areas in May 2024, has trialled AI image sorting, and is to pass gradually to SBAP.

name: Programa de monitoreo de Parque Tantauco
summary: An active monitoring programme in which rangers install and check camera traps to identify flagship and invasive species.

name: Programa de Monitoreo y Evaluación de Ecosistemas Acuáticos de Chile
summary: An active programme the environment ministry has run each year since 2021, with the Elqui river wetland among its sites.

name: Programa de Observación de los Ecosistemas Terrestres y Acuáticos de la Patagonia
summary: Programme created in 2018 and run by Fundación San Ignacio del Huinay, which uses it to monitor essential climate and environmental variables in Patagonia.

name: Programa Nacional de Fotomonitoreo
summary: CONAF runs a programme with reportedly about 2,000 cameras in 35 protected areas and 617,000 new GBIF records; in December 2023, it reported university collaboration on AI image analysis.

name: Prototipo de evaluación multiescala para la toma de decisiones interdisciplinarias post-incendios forestales
summary: Universidad de O'Higgins project, funded by the national research agency, which in December 2024 was using satellite images to assess wildfire effects on vegetation, soil and regrowth.

name: Proyecto GEF Gobernanza Marino Costera
summary: A project of unknown status, led by the environment ministry and run by FAO, in which a high-range underwater ROV was handed over in January 2025 to support SERNAPESCA inspections.

name: Proyecto GEF Humedales Costeros
summary: A five-year project (2019 to 2024), run and led by the environment ministry and funded by the Global Environment Facility, that inaugurated sensors at the Cáhuil wetland and launched Elqui monitoring with 13 proposed sites.

name: RCT Drones
summary: An active start-up supported by the 3IE institute, working on drones with thermal sensors and computer vision.

name: Red Chilena de Sitios de Estudios Socio-Ecológicos de Largo Plazo
summary: Non-profit network of long-term socio-ecological study sites across Chile, funded mainly through the Instituto de Ecología y Biodiversidad, with 11 verified sites on DEIMS and a 2019 meeting at Fray Jorge.

name: Red de Observadores de Aves y Vida Silvestre de Chile
summary: An active organisation that has coordinated the Neotropical Waterbird Census in Chile since 2009, with counts twice a year in February and July, and partners with BirdLife International.

name: Registros de biodiversidad del Sistema de Seguimiento Ambiental
summary: A dataset run by the Superintendencia del Medio Ambiente, which made more than 12 million biodiversity records public on the SNIFA open data portal.

name: Reserva Costera Valdiviana camera-trap monitoring
summary: An active project whose May 2024 report describes annual camera-trap records from the reserve and national park for 2016 to 2022, with ranger co-design of monitoring beginning in 2010.

name: Reserva Natural Aldunate
summary: An active project protecting 1,800 hectares in the Aysén region of Patagonia, which says its monitoring combines field work with satellite technology and uses Lemu.

name: SAMSARA, Sistema de Alerta y Monitoreo Satelital de Áreas de Relevancia Ambiental
summary: A closed FONDEF project run by UAI, the environment regulator and Data Observatory, with UAI researchers developing automatic satellite monitoring of sclerophyllous forest and scrub.

name: Servicio Aerofotogramétrico
summary: Organisation offering geospatial services based on aerial and satellite technologies, including obtaining optical and radar satellite images for territorial monitoring.

name: Servicio de Biodiversidad y Áreas Protegidas
summary: A public body created by Law 21.600 of 2023 to conserve biodiversity, administer protected areas and make official biodiversity data available from 2 February 2026.

name: Servicio Hidrográfico y Oceanográfico de la Armada de Chile
summary: State hydrography service, according to the 2019-2022 budget office record, which lists nautical charting and publishing navigation charts of national waters among its tasks.

name: Servicio Nacional de Pesca y Acuicultura
summary: Government fisheries regulator that agreed in 2019 to make vessel tracking data public on Global Fishing Watch and fined 21 vessels after an analysis of apparent closed-season fishing.

name: Silent Vectors
summary: Active project run by Fundación Kreen that combines AI and bioacoustics to develop bird monitoring and early warning.

name: SIMBIO
summary: Environment ministry initiative giving free access to information on national biological diversity, funded by the Chile-Mexico Joint Cooperation Fund, with modules including protected areas, wetlands and a geoportal.

name: SIMEF, Sistema Integrado de Monitoreo de Ecosistemas Forestales Nativos
summary: National native forest monitoring programme, promoted by the agriculture ministry and run by INFOR, CONAF and CIREN; a project in 2015 to 2019, permanent since 2020.

name: Sistema de Información en Biodiversidad de Aysén
summary: Biodiversity information system for Aysén, described in a January 2017 GBIF Chile release as the country's first, funded by the regional government and run by Universidad de Magallanes.

name: Sistema de Monitoreo de Humedales y Turberas de Magallanes
summary: Wetland and peatland monitoring system for Magallanes, built by the Centro de Modelamiento Matemático and GIZ, combining Sentinel imagery with field data and offering yearly maps of 13 surface types.

name: Sistema Integrado de Observación Marina
summary: Programme aggregating oceanographic, meteorological, satellite and research cruise data; IFOP says it is a foundation for a future digital twin and now works as an observation and data platform.

name: Sistema inteligente basado en gemelos digitales multimodales para incendios forestales
summary: Proposed forest fire project, led by Carla Vairetti, that will combine AI, advanced simulation and multimodal digital twins.

name: Sistema Nacional Satelital
summary: Programme run by the Chilean Air Force; in September 2026 its commander said two microsatellites were fully integrated in Chile and nearing launch.

name: Snapshot Chile
summary: Standardised, collaborative camera-trap monitoring initiative for mammals, planned nationwide, run by CONAF and the UACh wildlife laboratory, and integrated into Snapshot Global.

name: Strengthening Huemul Monitoring and Conservation in Patagonia National Park
summary: An active project in which AI identifies and classifies animals, people and vehicles; a September 2023 Rewilding Chile article reported alerts reaching programmed e-mail addresses in under two minutes.

name: Subsecretaría de Pesca y Acuicultura
summary: Regulates and administers fishing and aquaculture, according to its GBIF record; Global Fishing Watch says it supports the body in drafting a new national fishing law.

name: Superintendencia del Medio Ambiente
summary: Environment regulator whose enforcement coverage SAMSARA was designed to improve; BiOceanOr says it partnered with the regulator in 2023 to pilot a predictive risk tool.

name: TANU
summary: AI system for detection, classification, counting and identification of bird species.

name: Tecnología de Datos para Combatir la Pesca Ilegal en Chile
summary: Project run by Fundación Mar Futura that plans to use AI and electronic monitoring data to develop risk maps, alerts and compliance strategies for industrial and artisanal fleets.

name: The Blue BOAT Initiative
summary: Joint project of the ministry and Fundación MERI, run and built by both, to set up a whale-presence early-warning buoy system with AI; its first buoy was reported destroyed in March 2023.

name: Universidad Adolfo Ibáñez
summary: A founding Data Observatory member since 2019, whose researchers carried out SAMSARA and whose students, CONAF reported in December 2023, were developing AI to detect empty camera-trap photographs.

name: Universidad Austral de Chile
summary: University whose work includes a Fondecyt project reported in May 2023 to have increased image processing speed tenfold, camera-trap image classification, a bioacoustics thesis using a deep neural network, and the CONAF-commissioned SAT project.

name: Universidad Católica del Maule
summary: University whose Talca bioacoustics laboratory aims to support acoustic monitoring for conservation, and whose researcher is the investigator on a drone-based hualo forest damage project.

name: Universidad de Concepción
summary: A university with authors listed in OpenAlex on papers about deep learning in silviculture and wildfire susceptibility, and Hidden Markov Models for blue whale call detection.

name: Universidad de Magallanes
summary: University that, according to GBIF Chile in June 2020, had published a dataset of Parochlus steinenii occurrence records.

name: Universidad de O'Higgins
summary: University that Revista Ecociencias reported in December 2024 as leading a project on post-wildfire recovery and prevention.

name: Universidad de Santiago de Chile
summary: University whose authors, including the first author, appear in OpenAlex on a 2026 paper using interpretable machine learning on jack mackerel and euphausiid aggregation off Chile.

name: Universidad de Talca
summary: University with an address in Talca, listed in OpenAlex with a first author on a 2021 paper assessing forest degradation using multivariate and machine-learning methods.

name: Universidad de Valparaíso
summary: Chilean university that won funding in July 2024 for a project aimed at contributing to wildfire prevention and soil recovery in Ñuble.

name: Universidad del Bío-Bío
summary: University whose students proposed a labelling model for invasive species, trained on more than 40,000 CONAF photographs.

name: Universidad del Bío-Bío invasive species camera-trap AI
summary: Project in which, as of November 2022, researchers were developing an AI solution to identify and classify exotic species in camera traps in state protected areas, partnering with CONAF.

name: University of Chile
summary: University that, with the EU, launched CopernicusLAC Chile in March 2023, and whose authors appear in OpenAlex on papers on blue whale call detection and rainforest disturbance mapping.

name: WCS Chile
summary: Custodian of Parque Karukinka since 2004, reporting species censuses and monitoring in the far south in January 2024, and saying Karukinka’s research team uses apps, drones and camera traps.

name: Wildfire: watch and fight
summary: Funded project, one of 12 awarded in the post-fire recovery call, proposing AI and computer vision on watchtowers, with deep learning spread prediction and real-time alerts to a CONAF-managed platform.

name: Wildlife Chile
summary: Organisation that says it has brought multispectral image analysis and AI to Chile.

name: WWF Chile
summary: NGO that reported in July 2020 that, under an agreement with Sernapesca, it had donated the electronic fishing logbook tool.

name: Ética en los Bosques
summary: Active organisation that the SMA and Huawei reported in August 2021 as Rainforest Connection's partner in Chile, analysing the Guardianes del Bosque recordings.

name: Acoustic Monitoring in the Yoko Landscape to Determine Chimpanzee Status
summary: Closed project that in May 2023 proposed acoustic recorders and reconnaissance walks to assess chimpanzee status and threats in the Yoko Council Forest, with a final evaluation report listed for February 2025.

name: Action for Sustainable Development
summary: Cameroonian civil society organisation that describes itself, on the Global Forest Watch blog, as using GFW tools for satellite monitoring of forest cover change in protected areas.

name: African Conservation and Development Foundation
summary: Organisation working in Cameroon, the Central African Republic and Guinea, which describes nine community-managed conservation areas of about 30,633 hectares in the northern Dja landscape, where new community wildlife monitoring is reported.

name: African Marine Mammal Conservation Organization
summary: Cameroonian organisation whose authors compared three methods for detecting manatees in Lake Ossa in a 2023 paper, recommending passive acoustics, and which was implementation partner in a 2019 to 2020 Salvinia control project.

name: Assessment of status and existing threats to leopard populations in Tchabal Mbabo
summary: Closed 2020 to 2022 project, run by Cameroon Wildlife Conservation Society with IUCN SOS funding, where camera traps captured over 3,500 images of other mammals in 18 months, though none of leopards.

name: Atlas Forestier Interactif du Cameroun
summary: Interactive forest atlas of Cameroon, built by MINFOF and WRI, with a protected-area layer updated as official documents appear and data licensed CC-BY 4.0.

name: AWF ecological monitoring programme, Faro landscape
summary: Ongoing AWF ecological monitoring programme partnering with MINFOF in Faro, whose EU-funded count recorded 1,017 hippos across 26 pools from 25 May to 3 June 2026.

name: AWF wildlife monitoring support in the Dja Faunal Reserve
summary: Wildlife monitoring support in the Dja Faunal Reserve, run by the African Wildlife Foundation, which says it installed camera traps and acoustic sensors and that its Conservation Geography team maps poaching hotspots for park staff.

name: Biodiversité-Environnement et Développement Durable
summary: A local NGO that describes itself as dedicated to biodiversity conservation and sustainable use of natural resources, and which IUCN Save Our Species says implemented the 2019 to 2021 Mpem-Djim lion project.

name: Bouba Ndjidda National Park lion GPS collar monitoring
summary: Active monitoring: MINFOF and WCS collared seven Bouba Ndjidda lions in 2024, reaching ten; that August, WCS reported satellite locations four times daily to prioritise patrols.

name: Boumba Bek National Park
summary: National park established in 2005, where a 2023 report described eco-guards, local people and a WWF employee monitoring wildlife through constant presence and camera traps.

name: Cameroon Biodiversity Protection Program
summary: Active programme working on Nigeria-Cameroon chimpanzees at Mbam and Djerem National Park, partnered with CAMBIO since 2016, whose 2024 report records 980 chimpanzee nests and a decade of monitoring data at Gangah.

name: Cameroon forest reference level (2026 submission)
summary: Cameroon's first forest reference level submitted to the UNFCCC, built on 29,409 points collected in Collect Earth Online in 2024 by MINEPDED and ONACC interpreter teams.

name: Cameroon National Herbarium
summary: Plant collection in Yaoundé that publishes two GBIF datasets, including Cameroon's freshwater plants, and whose collection is described as representing vascular plant diversity across ten major land ecosystems.

name: Cameroon Wildlife Conservation Society
summary: Organisation named in the IUCN Save Our Species country brief as implementation partner of the Tchabal Mbabo leopard assessment.

name: Campo Ma'an National Park wildlife monitoring (FEDEC and AWF)
summary: Wildlife monitoring in Campo Ma'an National Park, run by AWF and funded by FEDEC, which says AWF implements five programmes there; AWF reports early camera-trap results showing many juvenile gorillas.

name: Cartography of cocoa in Cameroon and characterization of its impact on forests
summary: FAO-built project using artificial intelligence and satellite data to map cocoa production areas and assess effects on forests, as part of the EU-funded Sustainable Cocoa Programme.

name: Catholic University of Cameroon, Bamenda
summary: University in Bamenda that JRS lists, with ANI Foundation, as grantee of the Gashaka Gumti/Tchabal Mbabo transboundary research project.

name: Centre pour l'Environnement et le Développement
summary: Yaoundé organisation founded in 1994, working on environmental justice and forest community rights in Central Africa, whose site lists maps including a Dir district deforestation map for January 2023 to June 2025.

name: Cocoa Deforestation Monitor
summary: Platform run by Green Development Advocates, which Global Forest Watch names as the tool to use with GNW data when investigating deforestation alerts around the Dja Reserve.

name: Cocoa deforestation risk around the Dja Biosphere Reserve (GNW Small Grants Fund 2026)
summary: Proposed project in which Global Forest Watch says GDA will focus on the Dja Biosphere Reserve to cut cocoa-linked deforestation, training cooperative managers and rangers to geolocate plantations, funded by Global Nature Watch.

name: Combining Camera Trapping and Local Hunters' Monitoring Approaches to Assess Status of the African Wild Dog in a Key Ecological Area (Adamawa, Cameroon)
summary: A project page dated 14 January 2025 that aims to find African wild dogs by combining more camera traps with hunter-accompanying assistants, following a first project whose camera-trap survey recorded no evidence of them.

name: Community-led Conservation in Mbang, Cameroon
summary: Rainforest Connection project aiming to use remote acoustic monitoring against illegal logging and poaching near Mbang, where over three weeks the system reportedly identified 366 trucks, 38 motorcycles and 38 cars by sound.

name: Community-led forest surveillance in the Ebo Forest (GFW Small Grants Fund 2025)
summary: Project of unknown status, listed by Global Forest Watch as a 2025 Cameroon grantee for community-led forest surveillance in the Ebo Forest, funded through Global Nature Watch.

name: Congo Basin Institute
summary: Research institute launched in 2015 by Smith and IITA at IITA in Yaoundé, with a GIS and remote-sensing laboratory and a molecular genetics laboratory, partnered with UCLA.

name: Crusaders for Environmental Protection and Ozone Watch
summary: Registered non-profit, non-governmental organisation headquartered in Bamenda that says its ecological monitoring around Kagwene Gorilla Sanctuary has used transects, nest and feeding-sign records, community observations and camera trapping.

name: Ebo Forest Research Project
summary: A research project in Ebo Forest, run by San Diego Zoo Wildlife Alliance and led by Ekwoge Abwe, which monitored mammals from research stations and, per a May 2020 article, installed 12 trail cameras in 2010.

name: Empowering Communities for Pangolin Conservation: Innovative Monitoring Techniques and Sustainable Practices
summary: Rufford-listed project, dated 20 August 2024 with an August 2025 progress report, that seeks to compare arboreal and log-based camera trap deployments to improve pangolin detection data in Cameroon.

name: Enhancing Pangolins’ Conservation in the Southern Cameroon Plateau: Population Status, and Community-Based Actions to Mitigating Threats
summary: A closed pangolin project that planned to test two camera-trap placement strategies, noting that standardised black-bellied pangolin monitoring methods are lacking, with a final evaluation report of June 2025.

name: Establishing Research and Cross Boundary Partnerships in the Gashaka Gumti/Tchabal Mbabo Transboundary Protected Area Complex
summary: Project with a $250,000 JRS grant for 2025 to 2028 to ANI Foundation and the Catholic University of Cameroon, Bamenda, planning biodiversity baseline surveys in two parks.

name: Fondation Camerounaise de la Terre Vivante
summary: Cameroonian organisation listed by TRAFFIC as a partner NGO, whose account describes independent forest monitoring around Dja with SAILD from June 2017 to March 2018.

name: Fondation pour l'Environnement et le Développement au Cameroun
summary: Foundation giving long-term financial support to conservation and development; its 2024 report records 100 camera traps in Campo-Ma'an National Park and COTCO as 83% of its funding.

name: Forêts et Développement Rural
summary: Organisation whose December 2018 briefing describes SNOIE, and whose affiliation is listed for two creators of a 2024 deforestation drivers dataset.

name: Foundation for Restoration and Environmental Conservation
summary: Cameroonian non-profit conservation association that trains community members in SMART tools for biomonitoring and studied pangolins using camera traps in Deng-Deng National Park from 2018.

name: Ganga Research Station
summary: A research station established in January 2016 in Mbam and Djerem National Park, built by Ekwoge Abwe, where rotating local teams run monthly transect surveys and monitor termite mounds and feeding sites.

name: GBIF Cameroon
summary: Cameroon's associate participant node in GBIF, with an address in Yaoundé, which is also registered as a data publisher with two published datasets.

name: Geotech4Nature
summary: Closed programme: Afrik.com reports that GIZ's BSB Yamoussa project and the Tridom COMIFAC project organised its first conference in Douala on AI and drones for protected areas, aiming to set up a Central African network.

name: Green Development Advocates
summary: Cameroonian civil society organisation, created in 2009 and legalised in 2011, based in Yaoundé, which Global Forest Watch says will combine GNW data with its Cocoa Deforestation Monitor around the Dja Reserve.

name: Hippopotamus survey in Benoue National Park (Rufford grant)
summary: Closed Rufford Foundation-funded survey in Benoue National Park whose final report says the team completed it and has a hippopotamus population dataset to be kept at BEDD, though only a partial aerial drone survey was done.

name: Increase Knowledge, Awareness and Data Accessibility for Bee and Dipteran Pollinators, their Forage Plant Species to Support Conservation of Plant-Pollinator Interactions in Cameroon
summary: Active project with $304,195 JRS funding for July 2023 to January 2027, aiming to build citizen science capacity using iNaturalist across protected areas in Cameroon’s five agroecological zones.

name: Independent Forest Monitoring by Communities and CSOs through Mobile Technologies
summary: Closed project, run from June 2017 to March 2018 by FCTV and SAILD, that aimed to set up real-time deforestation monitoring around the Dja reserve using Forest Watcher and GFW's GLAD alerts.

name: INFORBIO
summary: WWF-run project, funded by the International Climate Initiative, linking deforestation monitoring, biodiversity and public health; in Lobéké, community missions from November 2024 to December 2025 mapped over 175 km of elephant trails.

name: Innovative Conservation Technologies to Assess Habitat Use and Threats to Chimpanzees in Ecotone Landscape, Cameroon
summary: Project aiming to use passive acoustic monitoring for continuous data on chimpanzee habitat use and human disturbance, with planned training for rangers, managers and wildlife school lecturers.

name: Insect Pollinator Collection Records from Four Protected Areas in Cameroon
summary: Active GBIF dataset of insect pollinator records from four Cameroonian protected areas, sampled April to December 2024 and November 2025 to January 2026, published by the University of Maroua.

name: Institut de Recherche Agricole pour le Développement
summary: Agricultural research organisation in Yaoundé, which OpenAlex shows as an affiliation of Shun Hongo, first author of a 2024 paper confirming mandrills in southeast Cameroon using camera traps and indigenous knowledge.

name: Institut National de Cartographie
summary: Yaoundé-based organisation whose mission, according to OceanExpert, is mapping, remote sensing and geographical work across Cameroon, and whose topographic base maps underlie protected-area boundaries in the forest atlas map service.

name: International Waterbird Census in Cameroon
summary: Cameroon's participation in the International Waterbird Census, covered by a 2023 flyway report chapter summarising the January 2023 coastal count, with a 2025 annual report mentioning counts in Douala-Edéa.

name: Korup Rainforest Conservation Society
summary: Registered Cameroonian non-profit running community-based wildlife monitoring with camera traps, acoustic recorders and transects, with its agreement with PSMNR-SWR around Korup National Park renewed in May 2025.

name: Labelled dataset to classify direct deforestation drivers in Cameroon
summary: Open Zenodo dataset, version 1.00 published 15 February 2024, holding images and forest loss data used to train and test a model classifying direct deforestation drivers in Cameroon.

name: Mbam et Djerem National Park wildlife monitoring (FEDEC and WCS)
summary: Wildlife monitoring in Mbam et Djerem National Park, run by WCS and funded by FEDEC, including research on key species dynamics and a listed final report on great ape and human impact monitoring.

name: Ministère de l'Environnement, de la Protection de la Nature et du Développement Durable
summary: Cameroonian government ministry whose secretary general opened the pre-validation workshop at Mbankomo for the third national biodiversity strategy and action plan, work Cameroon Tribune reports is continuing.

name: Ministère des Forêts et de la Faune
summary: Cameroon's forests and wildlife ministry, which builds the interactive forest atlas, partners with the African Wildlife Foundation on ecological monitoring training and equipment, and has regulatory authority in parks such as Faro.

name: Mount Cameroon National Park
summary: Park of 58,178 ha created by decree in December 2009, whose research and monitoring programme introduced camera trapping and detected the drill, which other survey methods had not recorded recently.

name: Pan African Institute for Development West Africa
summary: Cameroon-based institute that OpenAlex shows as the affiliation of Valentine Asong Tellen, first author of a 2019 paper assessing land-use and land-cover dynamics in North West Cameroon using NDVI.

name: Pan-African University
summary: University whose Department of Electrical Engineering in Kenya is the affiliation of Michael Mutwiri, first author of a 2022 paper, according to OpenAlex, on wildlife detection using image analysis on a wireless sensor node.

name: Participatory monitoring of forest cover in and around the Mengamé Gorilla Sanctuary
summary: Project of unknown status, run by ASD with a 2023 GFW Small Grants Fund grant, with an August 2024 post reporting the sanctuary lost nearly 25 hectares of forest from 2021 to 2023.

name: Passive Acoustic Monitoring of Orthoptera (Insects) for conservation in Mpem & Djim National Park
summary: Proposed project, on a page dated 12 September 2025, to record Orthoptera calls with autonomous recording units in Mpem and Djim National Park and build acoustic libraries for long-term biodiversity assessment.

name: Programme for the Sustainable Management of Natural Resources in the South West Region of Cameroon
summary: KfW co-financed the programme from 2006; it helped initiate Mount Cameroon National Park and renewed a community wildlife monitoring agreement around Korup in May 2025.

name: RASTOMA: Réseau des Acteurs et professionnels de la Sauvegarde des Tortues Marines en Afrique Centrale
summary: Sea turtle conservation network in Yaoundé, created in 2012 across six Central African countries, which publishes eight GBIF datasets including Cameroonian coast turtle data under CC BY 4.0, and showed a maintenance notice on 8 November 2026.

name: Safeguarding the heart of Kordofan giraffe territory in the North of Cameroon
summary: Closed 2021 to 2023 project in northern Cameroon, run by Bristol Zoological Society with IUCN SOS funding, using law enforcement and monitoring, where the IUCN brief says SMART improved patrol efficiency.

name: Sapelli community monitoring with the Baka around Lobéké National Park
summary: Project run by UCL's Extreme Citizen Science group, whose app maps resources and reports poaching; Mongabay reports 24 people around Lobéké have received training since 2021.

name: Saving African Golden Cat: Involving Local Community and Efficiency of Camera-Trapping in Boumba-Bek National Park
summary: A project page dated 4 February 2026 that plans systematic camera-trap surveys, habitat assessments and species distribution modelling to assess golden cat distribution, occupancy and habitat preferences in Boumba-Bek National Park.

name: Saving the lions of Mpem-Djim National Park in Cameroon
summary: A closed 2019 to 2021 lion project in Mpem-Djim National Park under IUCN Save Our Species, run by Biodiversité-Environnement et Développement Durable, aiming to map lion movements, build a geo-tagged photo database and establish prey abundance.

name: Sekakoh Organization
summary: Organisation that the Global Rewilding Alliance says uses trained teams and community monitors for patrols and camera trapping, and installs forest-watch apps and equips ten monitors in the Ebo landscape.

name: Service de Conservation du Parc National de Lobéké
summary: Park conservation service monitoring elephants, great apes and ungulates with camera traps, transects and drones, also conducting acoustic monitoring and using EarthRanger for real-time data.

name: Siren
summary: Application built by AMMCO for volunteer fishers to report opportunistic observations of aquatic animals, with reports checked and validated by an expert.

name: Supporting Biomonitoring and Anthropogenic Threat Suppression for Long-Term Protection of Pangolins in the Deng-Deng National Park
summary: A closed pangolin biomonitoring project in Deng-Deng National Park that planned to train six local field guides in SMART surveillance and to use camera traps across seasons, with a final evaluation report of July 2024.

name: Système Informatique de Gestion des Informations Forestières de deuxième génération
summary: Built by MINFOF, this forest information system launched on 1 April 2021, became mandatory on 1 January 2022 and uses barcodes; MINFOF says it verifies timber legality.

name: Système Normalisé d'Observation Indépendante Externe
summary: Built by Forêts et Développement Rural, this programme was reportedly ISO 9001:2015 certified since April 2018, with 49 civil society staff trained in its procedures by December 2018.

name: University of Bamenda
summary: A university where JRS says a January 2025 workshop trained participants in iNaturalist and DNA barcoding, and which JRS names as a planned partner of the Gashaka Gumti/Tchabal Mbabo project.

name: University of Douala
summary: A university linked through OpenAlex to 2022 and 2026 papers on Sentinel-2 vegetation classification, Sentinel-1 and Sentinel-2 fusion for land cover in Far North Cameroon, and bats around Campo-Ma'an National Park.

name: University of Maroua
summary: A public university in Maroua that publishes GBIF datasets on insect pollinators from four Cameroonian protected areas and on bird diversity in the Kalfou forest reserve, and appears on a 2018 bat acoustics paper.

name: Université d'Ébolowa
summary: A university whose Department of Environmental Sciences appears among the first author's affiliations on a 2026 paper on bat diversity and distribution around Campo-Ma'an National Park, with an initial acoustic database, per OpenAlex.

name: Université de Dschang
summary: A university whose Department of Soil Science is the first listed affiliation of the first author of a 2023 paper mapping shifting agricultural landscape mosaics in southern Cameroon with Sentinel-2 and Landsat-8, per OpenAlex.

name: Université de Yaoundé I
summary: A university linked through OpenAlex to papers from 2020 to 2026 on land cover machine learning, lidar biomass prediction, African manatee acoustic detection and coral reef fish indicator species.

name: WCS Cameroon Programme
summary: WCS's Cameroon programme, run by the Wildlife Conservation Society, which reports monitoring gorillas with camera traps and foot patrols at Kagwene Gorilla Sanctuary and lists a final Mbam et Djerem great ape monitoring report.

name: Aboutbirds
summary: Bird identification service from images and sound, covering birds worldwide.

name: Academy of Forest Inventory and Planning
summary: Beijing body under China's forestry authority whose authors reviewed the national forest inventory. Its name in that paper dates from the former State Forestry Administration.

name: AI big data real-time wildlife monitoring platform, Harbin
summary: Platform announced in Harbin in 2019 to track Siberian tigers, leopards and their prey with AI and individual recognition models, co-developed by the Feline Research Center, Harbin Institute of Technology and HIT Big Data Group.

name: Amur Tiger Re-identification in the Wild
summary: Benchmark dataset for re-identifying individual Amur tigers from video, from authors at Shanghai Jiao Tong University, Ant Group and Intel.

name: Aquatic mammal real-time monitoring system for inland and coastal waters
summary: A real-time monitoring system for Yangtze finless porpoises and Chinese white dolphins built by the Institute of Hydrobiology's cetacean team with reserves and developers.

name: Bayuelin Nature Conservation Centre
summary: Organisation named as the managing body of the Bayuelin public-interest protected area, which is governed by a management committee formed by the community.

name: Beijing Dingxing Technology
summary: A Beijing company selling a bird voice-print monitoring system that captures and analyses birdsong with AI.

name: Beijing Forest Ecosystem Field Scientific Observation and Research Station
summary: A forest field observation and research station whose own site describes observation plots, facilities or monitoring data, and which is listed on the Chinese Ecosystem Research Network resource service contact page.

name: Beijing Forestry University
summary: Beijing university with a Research Center for Biodiversity Intelligent Monitoring. Its School of Technology publishes on machine learning for bird sound recognition and soundscape analysis.

name: Beijing Institute of Genomics, Chinese Academy of Sciences (China National Center for Bioinformation)
summary: Chinese Academy of Sciences institute whose National Genomics Data Center hosts open genomic resources, including the first dataset of the Protist 10,000 Genomes Project.

name: Beijing Lianxing Shidai Technology
summary: Beijing company that publishes and operates the Flower Partner plant identification app.

name: Beijing Municipal Bureau of Landscape and Forestry
summary: A city agency that has built a sensor management platform to gather and analyse data from infrared cameras and video for wildlife protection.

name: Beijing Normal University
summary: University in Beijing, listed on CORDIS as a partner in BioClima, the EU-China project merging AI with ground and remote sensing data for biodiversity and climate monitoring.

name: Beijing Qingyuan Ecological Environment Co.
summary: A Beijing company selling sound monitoring devices for birds, frogs and mammals, and an AI tool for identifying camera-trap images.

name: Beijing Songshan National Nature Reserve Management Office
summary: Office responsible for protecting wildlife and plant resources and organising patrols, surveys, monitoring, fire prevention and pest control in the 6,212.96-hectare Songshan reserve, which has over 90 per cent forest cover.

name: Belt and Road Biodiversity Data Platform
summary: A biodiversity data platform built jointly by five Chinese Academy of Sciences institutes.

name: BIA biodiversity impact assessment tool
summary: Online tool from Shan Shui Conservation Center for querying the biodiversity impact of development, which its annual report says had 4,327 users and 6,294 queries.

name: Big Data and AI Biodiversity Conservation Research Center
summary: Research centre of the Institute of Botany, set up in February 2024, that builds big data platforms and develops AI for biodiversity conservation.

name: Biodiversity Committee of the Chinese Academy of Sciences
summary: Chinese Academy of Sciences committee that releases the Catalogue of Life China annual checklist.

name: Biodiversity Data Processing Platform
summary: An online platform for cleaning, correcting, converting and merging biodiversity data. It lists Catalogue of Life China among its download resources.

name: BioGrid
summary: A species observation app from the South China National Botanical Garden, released in May 2024, holding more than 17,000 species and 490,000 distribution records with expert and public users.

name: BioONE
summary: A biodiversity and ecological security big data platform with a stated 2.77 billion records, supported by the Chinese Academy of Sciences' Big Earth Data science programme.

name: BIRD1445
summary: A large multimodal bird dataset for ecological monitoring, published in the Journal of Electronics and Information Technology in 2026.

name: Birdsdata
summary: A company that monitors birds and other species with field devices and AI detection algorithms, and has built smart management systems for wetland reserves.

name: Bot.CLIP-100K
summary: Global plant species identification model in the BotAI platform, which covers 100,000 species with a stated top-5 accuracy of 91.2% at species level.

name: BotAI
summary: Plant diversity agent platform from the Plant Science Data Center and the Zidong Taichu large model centre, which turns natural language questions into reproducible analysis workflows.

name: Bringing the Yangtze Sturgeon Home
summary: A project led by the Chongqing centre of the Alxa SEE association that aims to restore wild Yangtze sturgeon, described in its title as using AI.

name: BS-Mamba
summary: Binary segmentation neural network that detects black-soil areas, an extreme form of degraded grassland, on the Qinghai-Tibetan Plateau, trained on an expert-annotated dataset.

name: Camera-trapping Platform for Felid Species in China
summary: Camera trap monitoring platform established in 2007 to assess China's 12 native cat species, with 28 sites in 10 provinces by December 2019.

name: CameraData
summary: Online system developed by the Institute of Zoology to store and analyse wildlife images from camera traps, with more than 8 million images from more than 50 nature reserves.

name: CASEarth
summary: Chinese Academy of Sciences programme on big Earth data, which supports the Digital Belt and Road Program and drafted Chinese government reports on big Earth data for the Sustainable Development Goals.

name: Catalogue of Life China
summary: Annual checklist of species in China, free to download and released each year by the Biodiversity Committee of the Chinese Academy of Sciences.

name: Chang Guang Satellite Technology
summary: Company in Jilin Province that operates the Jilin-1 commercial Earth observation constellation, including a satellite built to serve the forestry and grassland system.

name: Changdao National Marine Park Management Centre
summary: Centre responsible for protecting, managing and researching the national marine park, aquatic germplasm reserves, the Changshanwei geological relic marine reserve and the Miaodao seal reserve.

name: Chasing the Yangtze Finless Porpoise
summary: Project launched in 2023 with Chinese National Geographic Channel, which Lenovo supported with AI PCs and smart devices for research and frontline conservation.

name: Chengdu Nanyi Ecological Environment Technology
summary: Chengdu company offering biodiversity monitoring and assessment built on environmental DNA, along with morphology, remote sensing and infrared cameras. It exhibited an automatic eDNA sampler in 2023.

name: Chengdu Research Base of Giant Panda Breeding
summary: Giant panda breeding and research base in Chengdu. Its researchers built AI to identify individual pandas from a database of images and video, and it hosted the 2025 annual meeting of the China Breeding Bird Survey.

name: China Academy of Space Technology
summary: Chinese space body listed by the Committee on Earth Observation Satellites as a member agency since 1993.

name: China Animal Thematic Database
summary: Collection of 22 zoology databases covering China's fauna, birds, bees, inland fishes, amphibians and reptiles, listed by the Institute of Zoology among its scientific databases.

name: China Biodiversity Conservation and Green Development Foundation
summary: Nationwide Chinese non-profit foundation that runs Community Conservation Areas and publishes species observation datasets on GBIF, including sighting records of marine mammals across China. Its own site could not be reached, so these facts come from GBIF and a partner page.

name: China Biodiversity Observation and Research Network
summary: Chinese Academy of Sciences monitoring network of 10 sub-networks covering animals, plants and microbes, with 30 main sites and 60 affiliated sites and a near-ground remote sensing network.

name: China Biodiversity Observing Network
summary: National biodiversity monitoring network organised through China's environment ministry. Its mammal sub-network uses camera traps at protected sites.

name: China Breeding Bird Survey
summary: Standardised volunteer breeding bird survey in six Chinese cities, begun in Chengdu in 2023. A Sun Yat-sen University team has designed its survey method.

name: China Center for Resources Satellite Data and Applications
summary: Chinese satellite data body listed by the Committee on Earth Observation Satellites as a member agency since 2007.

name: China Centre for Resources Satellite Data and Application
summary: A Chinese satellite data centre whose website records exchanges with the Ministry of Natural Resources and the environment ministry's satellite centres.

name: China Conservation and Research Center for the Giant Panda
summary: A panda conservation centre that supported and advised a student project on a panda behaviour recognition model.

name: China Deep Ocean Affairs Administration
summary: Chinese body that leads Digital DEPTH, a UN Ocean Decade programme on deep-sea habitats, according to the Second Institute of Oceanography.

name: China Felid Conservation Alliance
summary: Chinese organisation founded in 2013 to protect wild cats. It runs camera-trap monitoring of North China leopards in Shanxi and has identified nearly 100 adult leopards.

name: China Green Foundation
summary: A national foundation that with New H3C runs an ICT project for biodiversity protection in Shennongjia, and funds forest recovery, species protection and biodiversity monitoring at protected areas.

name: China Institute of Water Resources and Hydropower Research
summary: Beijing water research institute. Its authors are on a paper using a YOLOv5 model and an improved DeepSORT tracker to identify and count fish species passing through a fishway on a river in Tibet. Its own site could not be read.

name: China Land Cover Dataset
summary: A 30 metre annual land cover dataset for China from 1990 to 2019, published by Jie Yang and Xin Huang of Wuhan University.

name: China Mammal Diversity Observation Network
summary: Camera trap network under the China Biodiversity Observation Network, organised by the environment ministry and led by the Nanjing Institute of Environmental Sciences, working at 74 protected areas in 18 provinces.

name: China Mangrove Canopy Height dataset
summary: A 10 metre map of mangrove canopy height along China's coast, made with drone LiDAR, SDGSAT-1 and Sentinel images and an XGBoost regression model.

name: China Mobile Yunnan
summary: The Yunnan arm of China Mobile, which supported the building of the Xishuangbanna Asian elephant monitoring and warning system.

name: China National GeneBank
summary: Government-funded science infrastructure in Shenzhen that conserves bioresources and runs CNGBdb, a biological data platform.

name: China National GeneBank database
summary: Chinese platform for sharing and using biological data. It integrates data from the China National GeneBank and from international sequence databases, and is listed on re3data.

name: China National Space Administration
summary: China's national space agency, the office for its civil space programmes and international space cooperation.

name: China Nature Watch
summary: Initiative launched in 2014 by Shan Shui Conservation Center and other conservation bodies, which runs targeted biodiversity surveys across China and keeps a shared biodiversity database.

name: China Ocean Mineral Resources R&D Association
summary: A Chinese body that developed the demonstration website of the deep-ocean seamount digital system for the 2025 UN Ocean Conference.

name: China Soundscape
summary: A project to monitor, record and study natural soundscapes in China, building sensors, recognition models and a data platform, with monitoring sites in more than 50 areas.

name: China Three Gorges University
summary: University in Yichang whose College of Hydraulic and Environment Engineering is an affiliation on a paper using a YOLOv5 model and an improved DeepSORT tracker to identify and count fish in a fishway.

name: China University of Geosciences (Wuhan)
summary: A university named in the affiliation of the first author of a 2018 paper comparing Sentinel-2, Landsat 8 and Pléiades-1 for mapping mangrove extent and species.

name: China University of Mining and Technology
summary: University in Xuzhou, listed on CORDIS as a partner in BioClima, the EU-China project merging AI with ground and remote sensing data for biodiversity and climate monitoring.

name: China-ASEAN Artificial Intelligence Application Cooperation Center
summary: Centre that worked with Huawei and the Chongzuo reserve on an AI monitoring platform for white-headed langurs, according to paid content from Huawei.

name: China_Wetlands
summary: A 30 metre national dataset of wetland distribution in China, built by the Northeast Institute of Geography and Agroecology from more than 53,000 Landsat scenes.

name: ChinaFLUX
summary: China's observation network for terrestrial ecosystem fluxes, which runs regular training on flux observation.

name: Chinese Academy of Forestry
summary: National forestry research institution directly under the National Forestry and Grassland Administration, with 19 independent institutes and centres.

name: Chinese Academy of Sciences
summary: China's national science academy. It launched the Sino BON monitoring network and runs the institutes that hold many of China's biodiversity records and models.

name: Chinese Ecosystem Long-term Dynamic Monitoring Database
summary: A database of long-term water, soil, atmosphere and biological monitoring data from 42 stations across seven ecosystem types, run by the Chinese Ecosystem Research Network, which holds its copyright.

name: Chinese Ecosystem Research Network
summary: Chinese long-term ecosystem observation network, named by eLTER as a member network of the Global Ecosystem Research Infrastructure partnership.

name: Chinese Virtual Herbarium
summary: China's digital herbarium, with a paper on the running of it and of the plant specimen sub-platform. No page read says who runs it.

name: Chinese white dolphin feature recognition system
summary: AI system developed by the Third Institute of Oceanography and Huawei TECH4ALL that identifies individual Chinese white dolphins in Xiamen Bay from images.

name: Chuangshi Intelligent Technology
summary: Company that is a partner on the Yellow River Delta bird monitoring platform and has released a cloud bird identification service with Huawei.

name: Clean Parks Citizen Scientist Programme
summary: A citizen science programme built by NIO and the Shan Shui Conservation Center, whose first Shanghai camera trap site began operating on 21 April 2023 with five cameras.

name: CloudyTrack
summary: A Guangzhou company that builds AI recognition models, monitoring hardware and software for wildlife monitoring and protected-area management.

name: Dali City Erhai Protection and Management Bureau
summary: Bureau whose 2017 departmental accounts listed duties to plan Erhai protection, control the lake's outlet sluice, and exercise combined enforcement powers across several fields in the lake area and surrounding forest belt.

name: Dataset of common bird vocalisations in Hainan Tropical Rainforest National Park
summary: Dataset of calls of 46 common bird species recorded in Hainan Tropical Rainforest National Park in 2021 and 2022, built with AI recognition and manual review.

name: Deep-Ocean Seamount Digital Intelligent System
summary: A digital system for deep-sea seamounts released at the 2025 UN Ocean Conference, developed by the China Ocean Mineral Resources R&D Association with the Second Institute of Oceanography and Zhejiang Lab.

name: Department of Earth System Science, Tsinghua University
