summary: A Tsinghua University department whose groups build global land cover monitoring systems and study habitat change in protected areas.

name: DePTH-GPT
summary: A multimodal large model for deep-sea habitats, released at Xiamen Ocean Week, from the UN Ocean Decade Digital DEPTH programme.

name: DJI
summary: A drone maker whose enterprise business sells drones for wildlife monitoring with high-resolution zoom and thermal imaging cameras.

name: Dongshan coral AI monitoring
summary: Project at Dongshan in Fujian, reported by Huawei, in which an AI system analyses underwater video from Xiamen University to identify 60 coral and 74 fish species.

name: Dragon Programme
summary: Joint programme of the European Space Agency and China's Ministry of Science and Technology for using ESA and Chinese Earth observation data in China. The page read covers Dragon 2.

name: East China Normal University
summary: Shanghai university with authors, at its State Key Laboratory of Estuarine and Coastal Research and School of Geographic Sciences, on a semi-supervised method for aquatic species recognition.

name: Eastern black crested gibbon population monitoring and acoustic monitoring trial
summary: A project run by the Guangxi Biodiversity Research and Conservation Association to improve field monitoring of the gibbon on the China-Vietnam border and test acoustic monitoring.

name: Ecology and Nature Conservation Institute, Chinese Academy of Forestry
summary: Institute of the Chinese Academy of Forestry in Beijing, listed on CORDIS as a partner in BioClima, the EU-China project merging AI with ground and remote sensing data for biodiversity and climate monitoring.

name: Environmental Development Center of the Ministry of Ecology and Environment
summary: Centre of China's environment ministry in Beijing, listed on CORDIS as a partner in BioClima, the EU-China project merging AI with ground and remote sensing data for biodiversity and climate monitoring.

name: Feline Research Center of the National Forestry and Grassland Administration
summary: Research centre of China's forestry administration that co-developed an AI wildlife monitoring platform for tigers and leopards with Harbin Institute of Technology and HIT Big Data Group, according to China Daily in 2019.

name: Finless porpoise AI video monitoring system
summary: AI system in Wuhan, reported as the 'super AI babysitter', that identifies the daily activities and mother-calf interactions of Yangtze finless porpoises from video.

name: First Institute of Oceanography, Ministry of Natural Resources
summary: A marine institute that has built a third-generation underwater acoustic monitoring system for vocal aquatic animals and ships, placed in the Yangtze at Nantong.

name: Fish Intelligent Identification and Monitoring System
summary: A system from the Institute of Hydrobiology that identifies fish underwater from form and movement to measure species, biomass and diversity.

name: Flower Partner
summary: Plant identification app that recognises more than ten thousand wild and cultivated plants in China, built with deep learning on the Institute of Botany's image library.

name: FlowerMate
summary: Plant identification app led by the Institute of Botany. The professional version identifies up to 20,000 wild and cultivated plants, which it says covers 96% of common plants in China.

name: Foreign Environmental Cooperation Center (FECO), Ministry of Ecology and Environment
summary: Centre of China's environment ministry in Beijing, listed on CORDIS as a partner in BioClima, the EU-China project merging AI with ground and remote sensing data for biodiversity and climate monitoring.

name: Forest and Grassland Inventory and Planning Institute, National Forestry and Grassland Administration
summary: Institute under China's forestry administration, founded in 1954, that hosts national monitoring centres for forest resources, desertification, wetlands, terrestrial wildlife and carbon sinks, and a satellite forestry application centre.

name: Forest and Grassland Resource Precision Monitoring Large Model
summary: A large model under development that combines drone images, satellite images and LiDAR point clouds to identify tree species and monitor forest resources.

name: Forest Intelligent Monitoring and Assessment Innovation Team, Southwest Forestry University
summary: A research team at Southwest Forestry University that builds digital systems for forest sensing, risk warning and management.

name: FROM-GLC Plus
summary: A multi-scale land cover monitoring system proposed by Yu Le's group at Tsinghua University, built on the FROM-GLC system of Gong Peng's team.

name: FROM-GLC10
summary: Global 10 m land cover map for 2017, made from Sentinel-2 images by transferring a 30 m sample set collected in 2015.

name: Fudan University
summary: A university whose School of Life Sciences team, led by Professor Wang Fang, organises an urban bat survey with the Shanghai Natural History Museum using residents' recordings, locations and videos.

name: Fujian Administration of the Wuyi Mountain National Park

name: Giant Panda National Park Gansu Administration

name: Giant Panda National Park Sichuan Administration

name: Greenpeace East Asia

name: Guangdong Daya Bay Marine Ecosystem National Field Scientific Observation and Research Station

name: Guangdong University of Technology
summary: A university whose School of Information Engineering students built a giant panda behaviour recognition model.

name: Guangdong Zhanjiang Mangrove National Nature Reserve Administration

name: Guangming Laboratory
summary: A laboratory that lists a satellite remote sensing and AI platform for forest carbon credits among its results.

name: Guizhou Fanjingshan National Nature Reserve Administration

name: Guizhou Puding Karst Ecosystem Observation and Research Station
summary: A Guizhou karst ecosystem observation and research station, named as such on its own site and listed on the Chinese Ecosystem Research Network contact page.

name: Hainan gibbon acoustic monitoring

name: Hainan Jianfengling Forest Ecosystem National Field Scientific Observation and Research Station
summary: A Hainan forest field station whose own site gives its name as a field scientific observation and research station, and which is listed on the Chinese Ecosystem Research Network resource service contact page.

name: Hainan National Park Research Institute
summary: Institute that started the Hainan gibbon acoustic database with IUCN.

name: Hainan Sanya Coral Reef National Nature Reserve Administration
summary: Administration that carries out management duties for the Sanya coral reef national nature reserve under the city's coral reef protection measures.

name: Hainan Sanya Marine Ecosystem National Field Scientific Observation and Research Station
summary: A Hainan marine ecosystem field scientific observation and research station, named as such on its own site and listed on the Chinese Ecosystem Research Network contact page.

name: Hainan Tropical Rainforest National Park Administration
summary: Administration of the Hainan Tropical Rainforest National Park, whose Bawangling Branch staff worked on the Tech4Nature gibbon monitoring project.

name: Hangzhou City University
summary: University in Hangzhou, Zhejiang, listed on CORDIS as a partner in BioClima, the EU-China project merging AI with ground and remote sensing data for biodiversity and climate monitoring.

name: Huangshan District Lumanjianghuai Nature Conservation Centre

summary: An Inner Mongolia grassland field scientific observation and research station, named as such on its own site and listed on the Chinese Ecosystem Research Network contact page.

summary: A Chinese Academy of Sciences institute whose Zidong Taichu model centre developed the BotAI plant diversity agent with the Plant Science Data Center.

summary: Chinese Academy of Sciences institute that launched the iBirding bird recording and identification app.

summary: Chinese Academy of Sciences institute in Beijing, listed on CORDIS as a partner in BioClima, the EU-China project merging AI with ground and remote sensing data for biodiversity and climate monitoring.

summary: Chinese Academy of Sciences institute in Changsha, listed on CORDIS as a partner in BioClima, the EU-China project merging AI with ground and remote sensing data for biodiversity and climate monitoring.

name: National Marine Environmental Forecasting Center

summary: Chinese national research funder. It funded a 2026 study on bird call recognition.

summary: Online collection of potential other effective area-based conservation measures in China, with 84 cases covering 2,219 square kilometres by February 2026. It says it is not the official OECM reporting platform.

name: Poyang Lake Wetland Observation and Research Station
summary: A lake and wetland observation and research station at Poyang Lake, named as such on its own site and listed on the Chinese Ecosystem Research Network contact page.

name: Qianjiangyuan National Park Administration
summary: Administration of Qianjiangyuan National Park in Zhejiang, which built a park-wide camera trap platform with the Institute of Botany and Peking University.

name: Qianjiangyuan National Park camera-trapping monitoring platform
summary: Camera trap platform set up by the Qianjiangyuan National Park Administration with the Institute of Botany and Peking University, with 1,033 effective sites in 343 grid cells by May 2020.

name: Qilianshan National Park Administration
summary: Administration formed in October 2018 within the National Forestry and Grassland Administration's Xi'an commissioner's office for the Qilianshan national park area; Gansu and Qinghai forestry bureaux carry provincial administration names.

name: Qingdao University of Technology
summary: University in Qingdao, Shandong, listed on CORDIS as a partner in BioClima, the EU-China project merging AI with ground and remote sensing data for biodiversity and climate monitoring.

name: Qinghai Biodiversity
summary: Species data platform for Qinghai Province covering vertebrates, vascular plants and large fungi, linked from the Northwest Institute of Plateau Biology.

name: Qinghai Haibei Alpine Grassland Ecosystem National Field Scientific Observation and Research Station
summary: A Qinghai alpine grassland field station whose own site describes observation plots, facilities or monitoring data, and which is listed on the Chinese Ecosystem Research Network resource service contact page.

name: Qinghai Lake Scenic Area Protection and Utilisation Administration
summary: Administration that Qinghai province has, since December 2022, made fully responsible for creating the Qinghai Lake national park candidate area and for protecting and managing the existing protected areas.

name: Qinghai National Park Research, Monitoring and Evaluation Center
summary: A provincial centre that has started a voice-print biodiversity monitoring project in Qinghai protected areas with the Northwest Institute of Plateau Biology.

name: Qinghai protected area voice-print biodiversity monitoring project
summary: A two-year project with 120 planned monitoring points in six protected areas in Qinghai, using sound recognition to track biodiversity.

name: Qunan village committee (Qunan community nature conservation area)
summary: Village committee for a community conservation area approved by Fusui County forestry bureau in 2014; an August 2019 interview described it managing the area daily, with rules, patrols and a 14-person volunteer team.

name: Research Institute of Forest Ecology, Environment and Nature Conservation, Chinese Academy of Forestry
summary: A Chinese Academy of Forestry institute whose protected-area and biodiversity team works with IUCN and Huawei on AI cameras for human-bear conflict in Shennongjia.

name: Research Institute of Tropical Forestry, Chinese Academy of Forestry
summary: A Chinese Academy of Forestry institute whose urban forestry team uses passive acoustic monitoring and AI to study birdsong in Guangzhou's green spaces.

name: Rosefinch Center
summary: Chinese NGO of bird watchers that was given a three-year bird monitoring project by the Shennongjia park administration.

name: Sanjiangyuan camera-trap community monitoring platform
summary: Community camera-trap monitoring in the Sanjiangyuan headwaters, in which local herders carry out biodiversity monitoring. Set up in 2013 by Peking University's Center for Nature and Society, Shan Shui and local communities.

name: Sanjiangyuan Community-based Camera-trapping Monitoring Platform
summary: Camera trap monitoring run with local Tibetan herders, set up in October 2013 by Peking University's Center for Nature and Society and Shan Shui Conservation Center.

name: Sanjiangyuan National Park Administration
summary: Administration of Sanjiangyuan National Park, named by Shan Shui Conservation Center among its partners.

name: Satellite Application Center for Ecology and Environment
summary: A public institution under China's environment ministry, set up in 2009, that runs national environmental remote sensing and the platform that supervises ecological protection red lines.

name: School of Big Data and Intelligent Engineering, Southwest Forestry University
summary: A Yunnan university school whose researchers published on detecting the calls of the Gaoligong hoolock gibbon with passive acoustics and deep learning.

name: Science Data Center of the Kunming Institute of Botany
summary: Data centre of the Kunming Institute of Botany holding germplasm, DNA, specimen, image and species data.

name: SDG Big Data Platform
summary: Platform of the International Research Center of Big Data for Sustainable Development Goals that integrates Earth data for monitoring six goals, including life below water and life on land.

name: SDGSAT-1
summary: Chinese sustainable development science satellite launched in 2021, with data open to all. It carries thermal, night-light and multispectral imagers.

name: Second Institute of Oceanography, Ministry of Natural Resources
summary: Institute directly under China's Ministry of Natural Resources, established in 1966, whose programme on ocean remote sensing was endorsed under the UN Ocean Decade.

name: SEE Foundation
summary: Chinese public fundraising foundation set up in 2008 to fund environmental NGOs in China. It worked with Ant Finance on the Ant Forest platform.

name: Shaanxi Qinling Forest Ecosystem National Field Scientific Observation and Research Station
summary: A Shaanxi forest field scientific observation and research station, named as such on its own site and listed on the Chinese Ecosystem Research Network contact page.

name: Shandong Jiaozhou Bay Marine Ecosystem National Field Scientific Observation and Research Station
summary: A Shandong marine field station whose own site describes observation plots, facilities or monitoring data, and which is listed on the Chinese Ecosystem Research Network resource service contact page.

name: Shandong University of Science and Technology
summary: University whose researchers developed AI-guided drone flight paths for monitoring spotted seals in Liaodong Bay, reported by the IEEE Geoscience and Remote Sensing Society.

name: Shanghai Chongming Dongtan Bird National Nature Reserve Management Office
summary: Office that, under Shanghai's management measures, is responsible for the day-to-day management of the Chongming Dongtan bird nature reserve.

name: Shanghai Dongtan Ecological Digital Governance Center
summary: A monitoring and supervision centre at the Chongming Dongtan bird reserve that uses more than 200 video feeds, AI patrol drones and custom algorithms to detect intrusion and other risks.

name: Shanghai Jiao Tong University
summary: University with authors on ATRW, a benchmark dataset for re-identifying individual Amur tigers.

name: Shanghai Landscaping and City Appearance Administrative Bureau
summary: A Shanghai agency that with other departments built the Dongtan Ecological Digital Governance Center at the Chongming Dongtan bird reserve.

name: Shanghai Natural History Museum
summary: A museum that runs the My Nature Treasure Box public science programme with Yangtze River Delta institutions, whose 2026 round includes an urban bat survey.

name: Shanxi Provincial Forestry and Grassland Bureau
summary: A provincial forestry agency that has set up an AI species identification platform for camera-trap images, using a two-stage process and its own knowledge base to help write reports.

name: Shennongjia National Park Administration
summary: The park agency in the Shennongjia national park candidate area, where an AI camera system with 743 connected cameras and a model for 87 species has been deployed.

name: Shennongjia National Park Candidate Area Information Management Center
summary: Centre that runs the integrated monitoring system in the Shennongjia national park candidate area in Hubei.

name: Shennongjia sky-air-ground-ranger monitoring system
summary: Monitoring system in the Shennongjia national park candidate area using satellites, 31 drones, ground cameras and rangers. It identifies 119 animal species from camera traps and includes fire detection.

name: Si Lab, Zhejiang University
summary: A community ecology lab at Zhejiang University in Hangzhou working on island faunas, habitat fragmentation and wildlife monitoring with camera traps.

name: Sichuan Gonggashan Forest Ecosystem National Field Scientific Observation and Research Station
summary: A Sichuan forest field station whose own site gives its name as a field scientific observation and research station, and which is listed on the Chinese Ecosystem Research Network resource service contact page.

name: Sichuan Provincial Forestry and Grassland Administration
summary: A provincial administration that supervises protected areas; its 2024 final accounts report a snow leopard project collecting 38 scat samples and data from 210 camera traps in the Qionglai Mountains.

name: Sichuan Ruoergai Wetland National Nature Reserve Administration
summary: Deputy county-level public institution that sets wetland protection rules and manages the 166,570.6-hectare Ruoergai reserve, which protects alpine peat marsh and rare species including black-necked cranes.

name: Sichuan Tangjiahe National Nature Reserve Management Office
summary: Management office for the 40,000-hectare Tangjiahe reserve in the Giant Panda National Park, whose patrollers monitor 104 panda transects and service infrared cameras, with joint cross-boundary patrols planned in February 2023.

name: Sichuan University
summary: University whose College of Computer Science, with the Chengdu Research Base of Giant Panda Breeding, published a framework for identifying individual red pandas from face images.

name: Sihong Hongze Lake Wetland National Nature Reserve
summary: A wetland reserve in Jiangsu whose self-designed AI platform identifies more than 1,500 bird species and runs on domestic computing.

name: SkySense++
summary: Multi-modal remote sensing foundation model from Wuhan University and Ant Group, trained on 27 million images from 11 satellite payloads and published in Nature Machine Intelligence.

name: South China National Botanical Garden
summary: A national botanical garden that runs BioGrid, a species observation app with public and expert users, and has patented a method combining AI recognition with regional species lists.

name: South China Sea Institute of Oceanology, Chinese Academy of Sciences
summary: A Chinese Academy of Sciences institute whose coral reef team built Yaohua, a multimodal large model for coral images, and which released the Haijing regional ocean AI model.

name: Space Star Technology
summary: A China Aerospace Science and Technology company that has worked on satellite applications in Qinghai since 2016 and set up a laboratory branch with Sanjiangyuan National Park.

name: Species 2000 China Node
summary: Regional node of Species 2000, started in October 2006 and managed by the Biodiversity Committee of the Chinese Academy of Sciences, which keeps the Chinese species list.

name: Sun Yat-sen University
summary: University whose School of Ecology is an affiliation on a dataset of bird calls from Hainan Tropical Rainforest National Park, made with AI recognition and manual review.

name: Taihu Basin Authority of the Ministry of Water Resources
summary: Ministry of Water Resources basin body exercising water administration over the Taihu and Qiantang River basins, Zhejiang and Fujian (excluding the Han River basin), and guiding river and lake ecological restoration.

name: Tech4Nature Hainan gibbon acoustic monitoring
summary: A pilot from late 2021 by Huawei, IUCN and the Hainan National Park Research Institute that sends sound from Hainan rainforest to the cloud to detect Hainan gibbon calls, with stated accuracy of 89.2%.

name: Tech4Nature Shennongjia human-bear conflict solution
summary: A project in the Shennongjia national park candidate area that uses AI camera traps with live transmission and electric fences to warn of Asiatic black bears near beehives.

name: Tencent Charity Foundation
summary: Tencent's foundation, which developed the WeBirder bird identification mini programme with Chinese National Geography Magazine.

name: Third Institute of Oceanography, Ministry of Natural Resources
summary: Institute of China's Ministry of Natural Resources that has worked on Chinese white dolphin conservation in Xiamen Bay since the 1990s and built an AI dolphin recognition system with Huawei TECH4ALL.

name: Tibet Linzhi Alpine Forest Ecosystem National Field Scientific Observation and Research Station
summary: A Tibetan alpine forest field station whose own site describes its observation plots, facilities or monitoring data, and which is listed on the Chinese Ecosystem Research Network contact page.

name: Tiger-Leopard Observation Network
summary: Camera trap network on Amur tigers and leopards in north-east China built by Beijing Normal University, named in a 2020 overview among the country's larger networks.

name: Tongyu Xianghai Ecological Protection Centre
summary: Managing body of the 175-square-kilometre Xianghai public-interest protected area, whose protection a 30-year agreement entrusted to a foundation, within a 1,054-square-kilometre reserve.

name: Transformational wildlife conservation management in China
summary: A Global Environment Facility project with UNDP for 2022 to 2028 to protect threatened wildlife through cross-sector work, community participation and new management technologies.

name: Tri-AI
summary: Deep learning system for recognising individual primates, first used on golden snub-nosed monkeys in the Qinling Mountains and since extended to other species.

name: Tropicals Datasets
summary: Open snapshot of names and taxonomy for about 420,000 species under CC BY 4.0, published yearly with a DOI, with fuller fields sold through an API.

name: Tropicals-T1
summary: An open model from Tropicals.cn that aligns Chinese species names with Latin names and ranks across 419,950 taxa, with open weights, training data and benchmarks.

name: Tropicals.cn
summary: Wuhan-based platform of species data for research, nature education, zoos and gardens, and the plant, aquarium and pet trades. It publishes an open name and taxonomy dataset and an open model that matches Chinese names to scientific names.

name: Tsinghua Shenzhen International Graduate School
summary: A Tsinghua University graduate school in Shenzhen that led a national project on marine plankton monitoring sensors.

name: Tsinghua University
summary: Beijing university whose Department of Earth System Science produced FROM-GLC10, a global 10 m land cover map.

name: Underwater Video-Language Multimodal dataset
summary: Benchmark for video language models on underwater scenes, with 0.9 million frames and 419 biological categories.

name: Unitree Robotics
summary: A robotics company that worked with the Nanjing Institute of Environmental Sciences on a robot dog for biodiversity monitoring.

name: UOVision
summary: A Shenzhen maker of field infrared cameras, founded in 2011, with the stated mission of protecting ecology and wildlife with technology.

name: WeBirder
summary: Weixin mini programme that identifies birds through the camera, from a database of 1,500 species.

name: White-headed langur AI monitoring platform
summary: AI monitoring system in the Chongzuo white-headed langur reserve, developed with Huawei and the China-ASEAN Artificial Intelligence Application Cooperation Center, covering more than 20 monitoring stations.

name: Wild Friends Plan
summary: A Tencent digital platform released in April 2025 that combines AI species recognition, public participation and research support for wildlife protection.

name: Wildlife Diversity Monitoring Image Data Management System
summary: An open online system for storing, analysing and sharing camera-trap images of wildlife, developed under the Institute of Zoology for the Sino BON mammal network.

name: Wildlife Protection Monitoring Center, National Forestry and Grassland Administration
summary: Body directly under China's forestry administration, listed among its affiliated units, with wildlife protection monitoring in its name.

name: Wuhan Baiji Conservation Foundation
summary: Foundation chaired by Wang Ding of the Institute of Hydrobiology, named by Lenovo in its Yangtze finless porpoise adoption work.

name: Wuhan University
summary: Chinese university that released the SkySense++ Earth observation foundation model with Ant Group.

name: Wuhan University and Ant Group Intelligent Remote Sensing Joint Laboratory
summary: A joint laboratory of Wuhan University and Ant Group that produced the SkySense remote sensing foundation model.

name: Wuyi Mountain AI-assisted species identification
summary: AI models trained on infrared camera data from Wuyi Mountain National Park, built by Huawei TECH4ALL and partners, with results shown on the park's biodiversity monitoring platform.

name: Wuyi University
summary: University in Wuyishan, Fujian, listed on CORDIS as a partner in BioClima, the EU-China project merging AI with ground and remote sensing data for biodiversity and climate monitoring.

name: Wuyishan National Park Fujian Administration
summary: Fujian administration of Wuyishan National Park, which has worked with Huawei's TECH4ALL team on AI species recognition since 2025.

name: Xiamen University
summary: University whose researchers run long-term underwater camera monitoring of coral at Dongshan in Fujian, and worked with Huawei on an AI system to identify coral and fish.

name: Xinjiang Cele Desert Grassland Ecosystem National Field Scientific Observation and Research Station
summary: A Xinjiang desert grassland field station whose own site describes observation plots, facilities or monitoring data, and which is listed on the Chinese Ecosystem Research Network resource service contact page.

name: Xinjiang Fukang Desert Ecosystem National Field Scientific Observation and Research Station
summary: A Xinjiang desert field station whose own site describes observation plots, facilities or monitoring data, and which is listed on the Chinese Ecosystem Research Network resource service contact page.

name: Xinjiang Institute of Ecology and Geography, Chinese Academy of Sciences
summary: A Chinese Academy of Sciences institute whose State Key Laboratory of Desert and Oasis Ecology appears as the first author's affiliation on a 2024 paper using machine learning to monitor desertification in Turkmenistan.

name: Xishuangbanna Asian elephant early warning system
summary: Warning system launched in 2020 around the Xishuangbanna National Nature Reserve. It uses 600 camera traps, AI image recognition and loudspeakers to warn villages when wild elephants are near.

name: Xishuangbanna Asian elephant monitoring and early warning system
summary: A monitoring and warning system for wild Asian elephants in Xishuangbanna, built with Yunnan Mobile for the reserve's management bureau, with about 800 infrared cameras and nearly 200 smart loudspeakers.

name: Xishuangbanna National Nature Reserve
summary: National nature reserve in Yunnan whose scientific research institute has an Asian elephant monitoring centre.

name: Xishuangbanna National Nature Reserve Management Bureau
summary: The management bureau of a national nature reserve in Yunnan, for which Yunnan Mobile helped build an Asian elephant monitoring and warning system.

name: Xishuangbanna Tropical Botanical Garden
summary: Chinese Academy of Sciences botanical garden in Yunnan. Its researchers tested infrared drones for tracking wild Asian elephants.

name: Xizijiang Ecological Conservation Center
summary: Non-profit for monitoring, studying and protecting wildlife. Its director is quoted in a Hikvision press release on intelligent video monitoring of pangolins.

name: Yancheng Wetland and World Natural Heritage Protection and Management Centre
summary: City body responsible for Yancheng's wetlands and natural heritage sites, including World Heritage and Ramsar convention work and coordination of heritage protection and management.

name: Yancheng Wetland Rare Birds National Nature Reserve
summary: National nature reserve that in May 2026 held a captive red-crowned crane population of more than 300 and was recognised as a national crane research sub-centre.

name: Yangtze finless porpoise passive acoustic monitoring system
summary: Real-time passive acoustic monitoring of Yangtze finless porpoises with an automatic recognition algorithm. Its builders say it is the largest such system for small cetaceans, and AI and video are being added.

name: Yangtze River Basin Aquatic Resources Monitoring Center, Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs
summary: A ministry centre that convenes annual aquatic resource monitoring work across the Yangtze basin. Its 2026 meeting heard from research bodies on intelligent monitoring and eDNA.

name: Yanqing District Protected Area Management Office, Beijing
summary: A district protected-area office in Beijing that has installed AI video recognition and sound monitoring devices at the Yeyahu wetland.

name: Yaohua coral reef multimodal large model
summary: A large model for coral reef images built on Alibaba Cloud's Qwen2-VL, trained on more than 100,000 underwater images, with stated accuracy of 88% for coral genus and species identification.

name: Yellow River Basin Wetland Conservation Strategy and Priority Actions
summary: A Yellow River basin wetland project, funded by Lao Niu Foundation and run by IGSNRR, which at its September 2021 launch planned a database of waterbirds and habitats to assess and forecast wetland state.

name: Yellow River Delta biodiversity monitoring platform
summary: Monitoring network at the Yellow River Delta reserve built under Huawei's TECH4ALL, combining remote sensing, radar and drones, with AI that identifies species.

name: Yellow River Delta bird monitoring platform
summary: Bird monitoring platform at the Yellow River Delta Nature Reserve using Huawei cameras and 5G. Yicai reports bird identification accuracy rising from over 60 percent to more than 90 percent.

name: Yellow River Delta National Nature Reserve
summary: National nature reserve set up in Shandong Province in 1992 to protect the wetland ecosystem at the mouth of the Yellow River. It uses an AI bird monitoring platform built under Huawei's TECH4ALL.

name: Yellow River Delta Nature Reserve
summary: Wetland nature reserve in Shandong that uses AI, drones and radar to monitor birds.

name: Yunnan Ailaoshan Forest Ecosystem National Field Scientific Observation and Research Station
summary: A Yunnan field station whose own site describes observation plots, facilities or monitoring data, and which is listed on the Chinese Ecosystem Research Network resource service contact page.

name: Yunnan Key Laboratory of Biological Big Data
summary: A laboratory based at Yunnan University, approved in 2018, that uses big data and AI for genomics and ecological informatics on south-west China's biodiversity.

name: Yunnan Tongbiguan Provincial Nature Reserve Management Bureau
summary: A Yunnan reserve management body that, a June 2024 report says, had installed 242 camera traps since 2017 and was reported to have set up a wildlife sound monitoring system with the Institute of Zoology, Chinese Academy of Sciences.

name: Yunnan Xishuangbanna Forest Ecosystem National Field Scientific Observation and Research Station
summary: A forest ecosystem field observation station in Yunnan, listed among the stations and sub-centres of the Chinese Ecosystem Research Network, whose own site describes its observation plots, facilities or monitoring data.

name: Zhang Xiaowei's environmental DNA team, Yunnan University
summary: A Yunnan University group that develops environmental DNA monitoring for fresh water, including standards used in Yangtze monitoring pilots and applications in plateau lakes.

name: Zhao Qijun's group, College of Computer Science, Sichuan University
summary: A Sichuan University computing group working with the Chengdu Research Base of Giant Panda Breeding on AI to judge giant panda mating behaviour.

name: Zhejiang Dahua Technology
summary: Video technology company that joined the Hainan gibbon protection project in 2021 with smart video monitoring.

name: Zhejiang Lab
summary: Organisation named by the ITU's AI for Good report as behind GeoGPT, a use case for AI-driven marine ecosystem monitoring.

name: Zhejiang Tiantong Forest Ecosystem National Field Scientific Observation and Research Station
summary: A Zhejiang forest field station whose own site describes its observation plots, facilities or monitoring data, and which is listed on the Chinese Ecosystem Research Network contact page.

name: Zhejiang University
summary: University in Hangzhou, listed on CORDIS as a partner in BioClima, the EU-China project merging AI with ground and remote sensing data for biodiversity and climate monitoring.

name: Zhilan Foundation
summary: A Chinese foundation that gives grants to conservation projects, including monitoring of the eastern black crested gibbon and acoustic monitoring trials.

name: Zhuoyue Shuke
summary: A company that formed a wildlife AI recognition project team with the Institute of Zoology and China Mobile to develop wild animal and plant recognition models.

name: Zidong Taichu Large Model Center, Institute of Automation, Chinese Academy of Sciences
summary: Large model centre at the Institute of Automation of the Chinese Academy of Sciences, which co-developed the BotAI plant diversity agent.

name: Action for Forest
summary: Non-profit created in France in 2015 and in Colombia since late 2019, which trains public bodies to use drones for forest monitoring.

name: Agencia Espacial de Colombia
summary: Private foundation created in 2017 to bring together academia, government and business on space. It is not a state agency. It takes part in the design of the CAR environmental satellite.

name: Asociación Calidris
summary: Colombian civil society organisation working on birds since 1989. It led a 2023 aerial survey of waterbirds along the Colombian Caribbean coast.

name: Asociación Colombiana de Ornitología
summary: Colombian ornithological association. It refers to eBird Colombia as its portal and published an updated reference list of Colombian birds through SiB Colombia.

name: Asociación de Autoridades Tradicionales Indígenas de la Zona del Tiquié
summary: Indigenous association of traditional authorities in the Tiquié zone of Vaupés, whose jurisdiction covers about 117,000 hectares within the Gran Resguardo Indígena del Vaupés, according to its document.

name: Asociación de Capitanes y Autoridades Tradicionales Indígenas del río Pirá Paraná
summary: Indigenous association of traditional authorities on the Pirá Paraná river in Vaupés, whose representatives met two other associations in March 2019 to develop management agreements for a shared 1,112,810-hectare territory.

name: Asociación de comunidades Unidas del río Isana Surubí
summary: Indigenous association of communities on the Isana and Surubí rivers in Vaupés, whose representatives met two other associations in March 2019 to develop management agreements for a shared 1,112,810-hectare territory.

name: Asociación de Corporaciones Autónomas Regionales y de Desarrollo Sostenible
summary: Association representing Colombia's 33 regional environmental authorities. Those authorities are the members of the Red Otus camera-trap network with the Instituto Humboldt and Conservation International.

name: Asociación GAICA
summary: Colombian association whose projects page lists camera trap monitoring.

name: Asociación Nacional de Empresarios de Colombia
summary: Colombian business association whose National Centre for Water and Biodiversity works with SiB Colombia to bring company biodiversity data into the open.

name: Asociación para el Desarrollo Campesino
summary: Nariño association whose projects include participatory management of the La Cocha nature reserve network in Pasto (June 2023 to July 2026) and biodiversity conservation work with 12 community organisations.

name: Asociación Red Colombiana de Reservas Naturales de la Sociedad Civil
summary: National association of civil society nature reserves, described in a 2018 Humboldt Institute chapter as bringing together 160 reserves that protect about 55,000 hectares.

name: Autoridad Nacional de Licencias Ambientales
summary: Colombia's environmental licensing authority. It has a monitoring centre where professionals monitor and model data to respond to alerts.

name: Bauen Project
summary: Colombian foundation that restores páramos, forests and mangroves with Indigenous, Afro-Colombian and peasant communities, with projects at the Sumapaz páramo, Lebrija in Santander and Nuquí.

name: Biblioteca de la vida
summary: Open-access gene reference library of the fish fauna of the Magdalena basin, built by the Ichthyology group of the Universidad de Antioquia in agreement with Empresas Públicas de Medellín.

name: BioAurea
summary: Platform that estimates forest carbon, deforestation and EUDR compliance across Colombia from satellite data with AI models.

name: BioModelos
summary: Instituto Humboldt platform for species distribution models of Colombia's biodiversity, built with more than 500 experts.

name: BioTablero
summary: National biodiversity tool from the Instituto Humboldt that takes in species distribution outputs and has a community-based monitoring module.

name: bio·analytics
summary: Bogotá company offering biodiversity monitoring from bioacoustics, camera traps and satellite imagery with AI detection models, including for real estate projects and eco-hotels.

name: CaVFish Colombia
summary: Visual catalogue of freshwater fishes of Colombia, a project of the Visual Science Lab at the Universidad de Ibagué, with more than 15,000 scientific images.

name: CEIBA Catálogo de datos e información biológica
summary: Instituto Humboldt catalogue of biological and ecological data.

name: CinfonIA
summary: AI research centre of the Universidad de los Andes and a partner in Project Guacamaya.

name: Colombia Biodiversity Observation Network
summary: National biodiversity observation network implemented by the Instituto Humboldt.

name: Colombia Manglar
summary: Community organisation working to protect, conserve and restore mangroves on Colombia's Pacific coast, including reforestation of degraded mangrove and community biodiversity monitoring.

name: Comisión Colombiana del Espacio
summary: Colombian government space commission. IGAC acts as its technical secretariat, and it represented Colombia's space position at COPUOS in 2025 through IGAC's director.

name: Conexión Jaguar
summary: ISA's voluntary programme for conservation and restoration, which has recorded more than 187 fauna species through camera traps. South Pole and Panthera are its technical allies.

name: Confederación Indígena Tayrona
summary: Arhuaco political organisation created in 1976 whose stated mission is defending the ancestral territory of the Arhuaco people in the Sierra Nevada de Santa Marta.

name: Consejo Comunitario de la Comunidad Negra de La Plata Bahía Málaga
summary: Afro-Colombian community council with a collective territory at La Plata, Bahía Málaga, in which the Valle del Cauca regional authority lists a regional integrated management district.

name: Consejo Comunitario Mayor de la Asociación Campesina Integral del Atrato
summary: Afro-Colombian community council with ethnic territories in Chocó, covered by a collaboration agreement signed on 6 February 2024 by CODECHOCÓ, COCOMACIA and Terra Global Capital that aims to conserve 695,245 hectares.

name: Conservación Internacional Colombia
summary: Conservation organisation in Colombia that is one of the leads of the Red OTUS national camera-trap network.

name: Corazón de la Amazonía
summary: GEF project in the Colombian Amazon, started in 2015 and given another 18.4 million US dollars, which supports the Sistema de Monitoreo de Bosques y Carbono.

name: Corporación Autónoma Regional de Boyacá
summary: Regional environmental authority of Boyacá whose 2024–2027 action plan lists 13 protected areas covering 155,091.9 hectares, and which reports 7 páramo complexes covering 517,052 hectares in its jurisdiction.

name: Corporación Autónoma Regional de Caldas
summary: Regional environmental authority of Caldas whose biodiversity document lists protected areas and their sizes and says it declared Laguna de San Diego a district in 2011.

name: Corporación Autónoma Regional de la Frontera Nororiental
summary: Regional environmental authority of Norte de Santander whose board declared the Sisavita Regional Natural Park on 18 June 2008, according to its 2012 draft management plan, and which acquired land within it.

name: Corporación Autónoma Regional de La Guajira
summary: Regional environmental authority of La Guajira whose board approved, as reported in June 2024, a 2,605-hectare regional integrated management district at Caracolí Sabanas de Manuela to conserve dry forest, water sources and wildlife.

name: Corporación Autónoma Regional de la Orinoquia
summary: Regional environmental corporation of the Orinoquia that, with USAID's Riqueza Natural programme, started a route in 2018 to seek protected status for a morichal; its GBIF dataset holds 2017 and 2018 monitoring records.

name: Corporación Autónoma Regional de las Cuencas de los Ríos Negro y Nare
summary: Regional environmental authority in Antioquia. With the Universidad de Antioquia's G-LIMA group it installed 64 stations for the MARCO monitoring tool on air, water and risk.

name: Corporación Autónoma Regional de los Valles del Sinú y del San Jorge
summary: Regional environmental authority of Córdoba whose 2025 report says the 3,594-hectare Las Marías wetland became the department's twelfth regional protected area on 25 November 2025, bringing Córdoba to 300,726 hectares.

name: Corporación Autónoma Regional de Nariño
summary: Regional environmental authority of Nariño that co-manages the La Planada protected area with the Awá Pialapí Pueblo Viejo resguardo.

name: Corporación Autónoma Regional de Risaralda
summary: Regional environmental corporation in Risaralda; El Espectador reports 35 camera traps installed in Ucumarí Regional Park in late 2025 and early 2026 after an agreement with WCS Colombia.

name: Corporación Autónoma Regional del Alto Magdalena
summary: Red Prensa Verde reported in February 2019 that its community monitoring, begun in 2012, involved 209 people using mainly camera traps, with 7,000 records identifying 30 bears.

name: Corporación Autónoma Regional del Atlántico
summary: Regional environmental corporation whose director general said it convened an alliance because the department lacked an integrated, continuous system to measure mangrove biodiversity.

name: Corporación Autónoma Regional del Canal del Dique
summary: Regional environmental authority of the Canal del Dique in Bolívar, whose technical sheets cite Agreement 0004 of 2013 for El Ceibal and report 1,782.04 hectares of civil society nature reserves in its jurisdiction.

name: Corporación Autónoma Regional del Cauca
summary: Regional environmental authority of Cauca that, as reported on 12 June 2023, visited plots in the community councils of Guapi Abajo and El Cuerval for mangrove restoration and ecological assessment.

name: Corporación Autónoma Regional del Centro de Antioquia
summary: Regional environmental authority whose jurisdiction, in a December 2017 report, contained 213,337 hectares of protected areas, and which reportedly helped manage the El Sapo and Hoyo Grande wetland complex.

name: Corporación Autónoma Regional del Magdalena
summary: Has responsibility for regional parks and management districts in Magdalena, with a management plan covering the Zárate, Malibú and Veladero wetland district, designated in June 2007.

name: Corporación Autónoma Regional del Quindío
summary: Regional environmental authority of Quindío reported in December 2018 to administer about 9,000 hectares across 12 conservation and management areas, plus four regional protected areas.

name: Corporación Autónoma Regional del Tolima
summary: Regional environmental authority in Tolima. Its director spoke for the agreement at the launch of the OTUS camera trap network, according to El Espectador.

name: Corporación Autónoma Regional del Valle del Cauca
summary: Regional environmental authority in Valle del Cauca. El País says it leads the part of the OTUS camera trap network in the department, with 171 cameras.

name: Corporación Autónoma Regional para el Desarrollo Sostenible del Chocó
summary: Regional environmental authority of Chocó. It signed the agreement behind the Red OTUS camera-trap network.

name: Corporación Autónoma Regional para la Defensa de la Meseta de Bucaramanga
summary: Regional environmental corporation that, under an agreement with WWF, had installed 10 camera traps in El Rasgón Regional Natural Park, as Vanguardia reported in November 2021.

name: Corporación para el Desarrollo Sostenible del Archipiélago de San Andrés, Providencia y Santa Catalina
summary: Regional environmental corporation for San Andrés, Providencia and Santa Catalina that in 2023 presented WCS-donated satellite phones for GPS mapping and recording data on illegal fishing in protected areas.

name: Deforestation-free cocoa for the Amazon Piedmont
summary: UK PACT project in Caquetá, Guaviare and Putumayo on a deforestation-free cocoa chain, which implemented technology for traceability and biodiversity monitoring in cocoa associations.

name: Departamento Administrativo de Gestión del Medio Ambiente de Cali
summary: Cali's environment authority. Its forest guards and staff load photographs from the city's camera traps on to Wildlife Insights, as part of Red Otus.

name: Días de Cámara Trampa
summary: Citizen science project in Colombia for a rapid one-month survey of wildlife using camera traps, with data handled in Wildlife Insights.

name: EcoBat
summary: Reference acoustic library for identifying the bats of Colombia by echolocation, described as a project under construction and a personal project of its author.

name: Ecopetrol
summary: Company that worked with the Colombian Air Force on the launch of FACSAT-2, to monitor natural resources and greenhouse gases.

name: Empresas Públicas de Medellín
summary: Named by NCBI as being in agreement with the Universidad de Antioquia on a fish gene reference library for the Magdalena basin.

name: Escucha Aves
summary: AI acoustic bird monitoring network led by local communities, which began with 193 recorders at nine sites in Colombia and plans 600 recorders across Colombia, Peru and Bolivia. Led by the National Audubon Society.

name: FACSAT
summary: Colombian Air Force nanosatellite programme. FACSAT-2, launched in April 2023, takes optical images and measures greenhouse gases, and is meant to help detect deforestation and illegal mining.

name: Fondo para la Acción Ambiental y la Niñez
summary: Colombian national fund for the environment and children, accredited to the Green Climate Fund. It is the national partner of Conserva Aves, which is piloting passive acoustic monitoring in new reserves.

name: Fondo para la Vida y la Biodiversidad
summary: Colombian government fund for climate and environmental action, including restoration and containing deforestation.

name: Fuerza Aérea Colombiana
summary: Colombia's air force. It runs the FACSAT Earth observation satellites, and Colombia's statement to COPUOS in 2023 described software using deep neural networks on their images to detect open-pit illegal mining.

name: Fundación Alisos
summary: Named by UK PACT as the lead of a deforestation-free cocoa project in the Colombian Amazon.

name: Fundación Biodiversa Colombia
summary: Colombian non-profit working in the Magdalena Medio that says it promotes monitoring projects with AI alongside restoration and environmental education.

name: Fundación Centro de Investigaciones Marinas del Caribe
summary: Foundation dedicated to conserving and restoring marine ecosystems on Colombia's Caribbean coast, including the Inca Inca coral garden restoration project, reef restoration and seagrass conservation.

name: Fundación Colombia Azul
summary: Colombian foundation researching sharks and rays. It describes a Seaflower project using underwater cameras, tagging, telemetry and molecular tools for long-term monitoring.

name: Fundación Con Vida
summary: Colombian foundation listed as a partner in the SWIM surface water project.

name: Fundación Cuidar la Tierra
summary: Colombian non-profit protecting jaguars in the Magdalena Medio, funding camera traps and GPS monitoring.

name: Fundación Cunaguaro Biodiversidad y Cultura
summary: Protects 65 hectares of Andean and Llanos piedmont forest in Chameza, Casanare, and reportedly supported 39 civil society reserve registration processes from 2015 to June 2026.

name: Fundación Dos Aguas
summary: Foundation that has protected and restored 14 hectares of tropical dry forest at La Cumbre de Rincón del Mar, Sucre, since 2023.

name: Fundación Ecosistemas Secos de Colombia
summary: Foundation that has planned and carried out tropical dry forest restoration with partners over more than 1,200 hectares in Montes de María, Bolívar, and about 400 hectares in Piojó, Atlántico.

name: Fundación Estación Biológica Guayacanal
summary: Colombian foundation for ecological restoration, founded in Santander. It says its GuayaTech line uses sensors, machine learning and real-time data for ecosystem management, and it runs flora and fauna monitoring at the Topocoro reservoir.

name: Fundación Gaia Amazonas
summary: Colombian NGO that coordinates MapBiomas Colombia and works with Indigenous territorial governance in the Amazon.

name: Fundación Habitando Conservación
summary: Colombian foundation with a project training residents of the Colombian Amazon in community monitoring of primates. It took part in the national Camera Trap Days exercise in October 2022.

name: Fundación Magnolios
summary: Colombian foundation that protects the 850 hectare Los Magnolios Nature Reserve in the Central Andes. It mapped the reserve by drone and used Svarmi’s DATACT platform to make a digital twin.

name: Fundación Malpelo y Otros Ecosistemas Marinos
summary: Colombian marine NGO that has run expeditions around Malpelo since 2000 and tags hammerhead sharks with satellite and acoustic telemetry. It is a partner in the MigraMar network.

name: Fundación Natura Colombia
summary: Colombian foundation whose projects include training fishers in participatory fisheries monitoring, with results and analysis of that monitoring.

name: Fundación Omacha
summary: Colombian NGO that carries out scientific monitoring of river dolphins, manatees and armadillos with local communities.

name: Fundación Palmarito Casanare
summary: Foundation in Casanare that a December 2025 report describes as creator and coordinator of a network of civil society nature reserves in the Llanos, which the report says protects almost 80,000 hectares.

name: Fundación para la Conservación y el Desarrollo Sostenible
summary: Colombian NGO that monitors deforestation processes in strategic ecological areas of the Amazon, including with Fedepalma.

name: Fundación Pro-Sierra Nevada de Santa Marta
summary: Foundation working to protect and restore the Sierra Nevada de Santa Marta, with 70 hectares of research stations its website says have been under restoration for 30 years.

name: Fundación ProAves
summary: Colombian foundation with a network of biological stations that it describes as centres of constant monitoring.

name: Fundación Wild Colombia
summary: Colombian foundation with a camera-trap monitoring project on wildlife, especially the spectacled bear, at the El Palmar reserve.

name: GeCoVIDA
summary: Five-year German-Colombian alliance, 2025 to 2030, for integrative biodiversity research with molecular, imaging and data science methods, creating a research and training centre at the Universidad Nacional de Colombia with the Museum für Naturkunde Berlin.

name: Geosat
summary: Geospatial services company that builds monitoring, reporting and verification systems for carbon, biodiversity and nature projects. Its page says the platform does not certify credits.

name: Grupo Argos
summary: Company that, according to the environment ministry, is buying 30 new camera traps and supporting scientific studies for the Ciénaga de Mallorquín mangrove monitoring system.

name: Herencia Colombia
summary: Colombian protected-area financing initiative. KfW is co-financing a 2024 to 2028 project under it, which also receives funding from FAO, the EU, the GCF and the GEF.

name: I2D
summary: Instituto Humboldt data infrastructure that gives access to data and information on biodiversity.

name: Instituto Amazónico de Investigaciones Científicas SINCHI
summary: Public research corporation for the Colombian Amazon, linked to the environment ministry. It lists the SIAT-AC environmental information system among its services and is a partner in Project Guacamaya.

name: Instituto de Hidrología, Meteorología y Estudios Ambientales
summary: Colombia's hydrology, meteorology and environmental studies institute. With the environment ministry it set up the Sistema de Monitoreo de Bosques y Carbono.

name: Instituto de Investigaciones Ambientales del Pacífico John Von Neumann
summary: Research institute producing scientific and traditional knowledge on the natural, environmental and social base of Colombia's Chocó Biogeográfico. It worked on the Pacific part of the national natural vegetation map.

name: Instituto de Investigaciones Marinas y Costeras José Benito Vives de Andréis
summary: Public marine and coastal research corporation linked to the environment ministry. By decree it coordinates the environmental information system for marine and coastal matters.

name: Instituto Geográfico Agustín Codazzi
summary: Colombia's national mapping agency. It runs the Observatorio de la Tierra y el Territorio, says it has built AI software to detect illegal mining in protected areas, and is technical secretariat of the Colombian Space Commission.

name: ISA
summary: Company whose voluntary Conexión Jaguar programme funds conservation and restoration in Colombia, Brazil and Peru, with camera-trap monitoring.

name: Jardín Botánico de Bogotá José Celestino Mutis
summary: Botanic garden of Bogotá and research centre on urban and rural ecosystems. It publishes open data sets and holds the SIGAU urban tree information system.

name: Jardín Botánico de Cartagena
summary: Botanic garden in Cartagena with a portal for biodiversity records it publishes, aimed at biodiversity informatics.

name: Karvonus
summary: Climate-tech company that monitors territories by satellite and turns the evidence into income for those who conserve forests. Its team is in Colombia, Peru and Canada. Formerly Yahee Space.

name: Legado Green
summary: Organisation managing an area of 13 million acres in eastern Colombia. EOS Data Analytics made it land cover, biomass and deforestation maps using machine learning models.

name: Mapa de Vegetación Natural de Colombia
summary: First natural vegetation map of Colombia, delivered in 2022 by the environment ministry, the Universidad Nacional and research institutes. The ministry's article describes it as AI at the service of biodiversity, and the method uses Google Earth Engine.

name: MapBiomas Colombia
summary: Collaborative satellite monitoring network publishing open annual land cover and land use maps for Colombia from 1985 to 2024, coordinated by Fundación Gaia Amazonas.

name: Mineros S.A.
summary: Company that, with the Instituto Humboldt and Conservation International, deployed 80 camera traps in Red Otus to monitor fauna in Bajo Cauca.

name: Ministerio de Ambiente y Desarrollo Sostenible
summary: Colombia's environment ministry. It presented the country's Biodiversity Action Plan to 2030 under the Kunming-Montreal framework at COP16 in Cali.

name: Ministerio de Ciencia, Tecnología e Innovación
summary: Colombia's science ministry. It opened a call in 2026 of about 750,000 million pesos for 48 projects on biodiversity, bioeconomy and productive development.

name: Monitoreo Ciudadano a recursos hídricos
summary: Project, with unknown status, that aims to help communities use water probes to measure pH, dissolved oxygen, conductivity and temperature and detect heavy metals, with probes co-designed by scientists and users.

name: Monitoreo de biodiversidad con cámaras trampa en Cali
summary: Camera trap monitoring of wildlife in rural and protected areas of Cali, with about 100 of 120 planned cameras installed by November 2025 and images handled in Wildlife Insights.

name: Monitoreo de frailejones en el Páramo de Berlín
summary: Pilot combining drone flights with algorithms to identify frailejones one by one. It identified about 86,000 plants and assessed which were alive a year after a 2024 fire burned 317 hectares.

name: National wildfire detection pilot, Colombia
summary: National pilot using OroraTech's Wildfire Solution platform, which combines thermal satellite imagery and AI-driven analytics to detect wildfires, with the stated aim of protecting critical ecosystems.

name: Observatorio de Conflictos Socioambientales
summary: FCDS observatory with a map viewer and figures on deforestation and conflicts in the Colombian Amazon.

name: Observatorio de la Tierra y el Territorio
summary: IGAC's platform joining geospatial and cadastral data for continuous analysis of Colombian territory, using satellite data and AI to identify changes such as extractive activity.

name: Organización Gonawindúa Tayrona
summary: Indigenous organisation of the Kággaba people that acts as governing authority of the Kogui-Malayo-Arhuaco resguardo, which covers 412,871 hectares in the northern Sierra Nevada de Santa Marta.

name: Parques Nacionales Naturales de Colombia
summary: The body that manages Colombia's system of national natural parks. It uses SMART as a monitoring and spatial analysis tool in the parks.

name: Patrimonio Natural Fondo para la Biodiversidad y Áreas Protegidas
summary: Colombian non-profit foundation that manages conservation funds. It is executing agency of the Corazón de la Amazonía project and supports the execution of Herencia Colombia funds.

name: Paz y Flora
summary: Company offering technology services for monitoring and managing forests in Colombia with drones, high-resolution satellite images and software.

name: PlanT Reforestation
summary: Environmental arm of the Colombian cacao exporter Colcocoa. Orbify says it used its platform to validate 658 hectares of forest and agroforestry cover.

name: Prioritized Corridor for the Conservation and Management of the Jaguar in Guaviare
summary: WWF Colombia work with regional partners on a proposed jaguar corridor of about 75,000 hectares in Guaviare, using camera traps and Wildlife Insights.

name: Programa SAR Colombia
summary: Programme that IGAC says gives Colombia access to synthetic aperture radar data and builds processing skills for deforestation monitoring and territorial mapping, with NASA and others as partners.

name: Proyecto de Conservación de Aguas y Tierras
summary: Non-profit research and conservation organisation. Its project list includes one using machine learning tools to monitor endangered species and their main threats.

name: Proyecto Tití
summary: Organisation that says it advances knowledge of wild cotton-top tamarins through long-term field studies and leads their conservation in Colombia.

name: Proyecto Vida Silvestre
summary: Project that ran camera-trap monitoring in Magdalena Medio, Putumayo and the Orinoquía. WCS Colombia reports 256 cameras, 1,859,286 photos and 138 species identified with AI software.

name: Pteroset
summary: Open passive acoustic dataset of Neotropical bird sounds recorded in Colombia between 2023 and 2025, with 563 recordings and 15,372 bird-event annotations. Its authors are at Microsoft AI for Good, Instituto Humboldt, Louisiana State University and Universidad de Los Andes.

name: Red Colombiana de Fototrampeo
summary: Colombian camera trapping network that co-leads the Días de Cámara Trampa citizen science project with Instituto Humboldt.

name: Red de Colisión de Aves
summary: Citizen science network that gathers, georeferences and analyses data on birds hitting windows across Colombia, with the data also public on SiB Colombia.

name: Red de Vigilancia para la Conservación y Protección de las Aguas Marinas y Costeras de Colombia
summary: Colombia's network for monitoring marine and coastal surface water quality since 2001, coordinated by INVEMAR.

name: Red Ecoacústica Colombiana
summary: Interdisciplinary network of researchers working between acoustics and ecology in Colombia. It announced the third Colombian congress of bioacoustics and ecoacoustics in Bogotá in 2026.

name: Red Otus
summary: Colombia's national camera-trap network, made up of the 33 regional environmental authorities, the Instituto Humboldt and Conservation International. Images are classified on Wildlife Insights.

name: Registro Nacional de Zonas Deforestadas
summary: Register created by Article 31 of Law 2169 of 2021 as a module of the Forest and Carbon Monitoring System, run by IDEAM, with a semester report covering the second half of 2025.

name: Reporte BIO
summary: Instituto Humboldt web portal reporting the state and trends of continental biodiversity in Colombia.

name: Resguardo Indígena Awá Pialapí Pueblo Viejo
summary: Awá Indigenous resguardo that received La Planada from Fundación FES in 2010, committing to conserve biodiversity, and which manages the site jointly with Corponariño.

name: Resguardo Indígena Gran Tescual
summary: Indigenous reserve in Puerres, Nariño, and a local partner in Escucha Aves, whose members installed recorders in the Páramo de Zonquer.

name: Resguardo Indígena Palmar Imbi
summary: Indigenous reserve in Ricaurte, Nariño, and a partner in Escucha Aves that took part in installing recorders.

name: Secretaría Distrital de Ambiente de Bogotá
summary: Bogotá's environment authority. Its biodiversity monitoring group works in 19 protected areas with camera traps, and it publishes records to iNaturalist and SiB Colombia.

name: SELVA
summary: Colombian organisation running a community monitoring strategy for birds and primates in the Serranía de los Churumbelos.

name: SIAT-AC
summary: Network of institutions that agree common objectives for managing environmental information on the Colombian Amazon. A SINCHI procurement document sets out a planned chatbot and a geospatial AI agent for it.

name: Sistema de Información Ambiental de Colombia
summary: Colombia's national environmental information system, working through the bodies of the National Environmental System. Its environmental map viewer gives access to historic deforestation figures.

name: Sistema de Información Ambiental Marina
summary: Colombia's marine environmental information system, listed by the environment ministry alongside the national environmental information system.

name: Sistema de Información para la Gestión Territorial Indígena
summary: Territorial information system that supports decisions by Indigenous governments in the eastern Colombian Amazon, described on the Gaia Amazonas site.

name: Sistema de Información sobre Biodiversidad de Colombia
summary: Colombia's national biodiversity data system and GBIF node, with a collaborative network of data publishers.

name: Sistema de Monitoreo de Bosques y Carbono
summary: Colombia's official national forest monitoring system, run by IDEAM. It processes satellite images with eight algorithms to identify deforested areas and issues early deforestation alerts.

name: Sistema de Monitoreo de las Coberturas de la tierra de la Amazonia colombiana
summary: Monitoring system that tracks changes in land cover in the Colombian Amazon by interpreting remote-sensing images.

name: Sistema integrado de monitoreo de manglares de la Ciénaga de Mallorquín
summary: Proposed mangrove monitoring system that the environment ministry says will combine environmental DNA analysis with camera trapping, arising from a call by the Atlántico regional corporation.

name: SWIM (Surface Water Information Management)
summary: EU-funded Horizon Europe project to monitor water quality and quantity with satellites, IoT sensors and AI, piloted in reservoirs and streams in Colombia. Runs from November 2024 to November 2027.

name: Techo de Agua Corporación Ambiental
summary: Environmental corporation in Antioquia that runs monitoring of birds of prey, with the black-and-chestnut eagle as its emblem, and community camera trapping.

name: Terrasos
summary: Company running habitat banks in Colombia, which issue biodiversity credits. A published article describes monitoring tools as part of how the banks are assured.

name: Unidad Nacional para la Gestión del Riesgo de Desastres
summary: Colombia's national disaster risk unit, which partnered with OroraTech on a national satellite wildfire detection pilot.

name: Universidad de Antioquia
summary: Colombian university whose Ichthyology group is building a fish gene reference library for the Magdalena basin, and whose G-LIMA group built the stations for Cornare's MARCO tool.

name: Universidad de Ibagué
summary: Colombian university whose Visual Science Lab runs CaVFish Colombia, a visual catalogue of freshwater fishes.

name: Universidad del Cauca
summary: University whose Information Technology Research Group includes the first author of a 2018 paper on a genetic-programming vegetation index for detecting bare ground in the Amazon.

name: Universidad del Magdalena
summary: Colombian university with an institutional AI strategy, Aluna I.A., whose lines include monitoring ecosystems of the Caribbean. A public-algorithms register lists it as the body behind AI detection of coral reef fish in Tayrona National Park.

name: Universidad del Rosario
summary: Colombian university that collaborated on the WingSentry bird monitoring system and is a member of the MapBiomas Colombia network.

name: Universidad del Valle
summary: University whose Multimedia and Computer Vision Group includes the first author of a 2019 paper on automated identification and classification of diatoms from water resources.

name: Universidad Distrital Francisco José de Caldas
summary: University with an author who is first author of a 2019 paper generating vegetation cover change data for the Sabana de Bogotá from Landsat and MODIS-Landsat series, 2007 to 2013.

name: Universidad Industrial de Santander
summary: Colombian university whose researchers combined drone images and AI to identify, count and monitor frailejones in the Páramo de Berlín.

name: Universidad Nacional de Colombia
summary: Colombian university. It worked with the environment ministry on the first natural vegetation map of Colombia and is a member of the MapBiomas Colombia network.

name: Universidad Tecnológica de Bolívar
summary: University whose authors include the first author of a 2026 deep learning study of tree cover loss and gain in Cundinamarca and of a 2022 Landsat and GIS forest loss assessment.

name: Universidad Tecnológica de Pereira
summary: University whose Faculty of Engineering includes the first author of a 2026 paper on an open-source pipeline for multitemporal vegetation monitoring with Sentinel-2.

name: Visión Amazonía
summary: Colombian government programme for the Amazon, funded by Norway, Germany and the United Kingdom through the REDD Early Movers scheme run by KfW.

name: ACG sea turtle monitoring project (Nancite)
summary: Sea turtle monitoring project at Nancite led by Luis Fonseca López, studying ACG turtles for over a decade, partnered with the Guanacaste Dry Forest Conservation Fund and extended to jaguar predation on nesting turtles.

name: Aerial Robotixs
summary: San José-based organisation named in a 2018 AFP report, carried by Malay Mail, as a backer of the Deep Forest project, and listed as a partner of it.

name: Asociación ANAI
summary: Association that began work in Talamanca, Costa Rica, and says it has monitored stream fish and macroinvertebrates since 2000; UNDP says it was founded in 1983.

name: Asociación Costa Rica por Siempre
summary: Organisation that co-finances and administers the project strengthening the marine conservation area's Prevention, Protection and Control programme, and was credited by a MINAE official, with the French Development Agency, for supporting the SINIA platform.

name: BioAlfa
summary: Run by the International Barcode of Life Consortium, this regional species survey is listed by iBOL, which says its research supports Costa Rica’s goal of fully knowing its biodiversity.

name: BIODATACR
summary: A system run by the Comisión Nacional para la Gestión de la Biodiversidad to systematise, document and publish Costa Rica's biodiversity information, built on the Atlas of Living Australia API infrastructure and offering geospatial layers.

name: Bosque Vivo
summary: A project led by the national forest financing fund, paid for by private companies, that uses camera trapping to build a wildlife baseline; two traps were recording at a CORBANA subsidiary's forest in January 2026.

name: Centro Agronómico Tropical de Investigación y Enseñanza
summary: Regional research and teaching centre in Turrialba, Costa Rica, with 13 member countries, which runs the SERVIR Central America hub and is affiliated with a 2021 Landsat paper on tropical forest degradation.

name: Centro Científico Tropical
summary: Costa Rican conservation nonprofit with private reserves that leads the green macaw census and lists mammal and quetzal monitoring projects; El Financiero reports its scientists help install AudioMoth recorders.

name: Centro Nacional de Alta Tecnología
summary: Interuniversity research and innovation centre of five laboratories, including the Earth observation laboratory PRIAS, which runs MOCUPP and has researchers on a 2024 manatee call counting paper and a 2020 forest cover classification paper.

name: Centro Nacional de Información Geoambiental
summary: Body created by Decree 29540-MINAE to set up an integrated geographic information system, which runs SIMOCUTE and in 2025 consolidated it as the official land cover, land use and ecosystem information programme.

name: Cocos Island Monitoring And Research
summary: Project led by Turtle Island Restoration Network and PRETOMA, running expeditions since March 2009 that track sea turtles and sharks at Cocos Island with satellite transmitters.

name: Comisión de Electrificación Sostenible
summary: Commission whose GBIF record says it has compiled and analysed wildlife electrocution reports since a 2018 ministerial directive, with members including ICE, CONAGEBIO, SINAC and Humane Society International.

name: Comisión Nacional para la Gestión de la Biodiversidad
summary: San José body that, according to its GBIF record, develops and monitors the national biodiversity strategy and manages access requests to biodiversity resources, and which runs BIODATACR.

name: Conteo Nacional de Anfibios y Reptiles
summary: National survey of amphibians and reptiles; Delfino reports over 5,000 counted on the night of 31 May 2025 in its second edition, along routes in five regions.

name: Corcovado National Park
summary: Protected area established in 1975 covering over 45,000 hectares, where specialists have collected terrestrial mammal monitoring data since 2012 and developed a national monitoring protocol in 2022.

name: Costa Rica Biodiversity Facility
summary: Costa Rica's GBIF node, listed with voting status in GBIF's registry, with its node manager based at CONAGEBIO in the Ministry of Environment and Energy.

name: Costa Rica Bird Observatories
summary: Nationwide bird monitoring initiative, described by its news as an environmental NGO, created and managed through partnerships and based in Santo Domingo de Heredia.

name: Costa Rica es Biodiversidad 30x30
summary: EU-funded project through Euroclima, implemented by AECID with SINAC, that includes field monitoring equipment for rangers and a monitoring data platform announced in August 2025 for March 2026, which is unconfirmed.

name: Costa Rica Wildlife Foundation
summary: Organisation that says its work includes forest restoration, SMART patrols and biodiversity monitoring.

name: Costa Rican Alliance for Sea Turtle Conservation & Science
summary: Non-profit association working with the social enterprise Nāmaka Conservation Science Limitada, whose 2022 season report describes a sea turtle monitoring project and a satellite transmitter fitted to one nesting female.

name: Costa Rica–Estonia digital timber management pilot (Timbeter)
summary: Pilot begun in 2020 between Costa Rica and Estonia, funded by the Environmental Investment Centre, in which Timbeter's AI measurement was reported in 2022 as a way to fight illegal logging.

name: Deep Forest
summary: A drone project that, according to a 2018 AFP report, aimed to improve scientists' view of the forest canopy using high-definition LiDAR, with partners Fundecor, Intel and Aerial Robotixs.

name: Detección acústica automatizada del pájaro campana en el Corredor Biológico AmistOsa
summary: Project led and run by ICOMVIS that trains algorithms to recognise the bellbird's call from recorders; El Mundo reports 135 hours of recording a day across several sites.

name: Effects of Extreme Climate Events on the Circadian Pattern of Fruit Dropping and Seed Dispersal by Terrestrial Frugivorous Mammals (Rufford 42978-1)
summary: Rufford-listed project in the Guanacaste Conservation Area using 40 camera traps to monitor nance fruit fall and frugivores during July to September 2024, with further monitoring planned.

name: Estrategia Nacional REDD+ Costa Rica
summary: National REDD+ programme based at FONAFIFO in San Vicente de Moravia, with an emissions measurement and verification system, which says the Green Climate Fund recognised US$54.1 million for 2014 and 2015 reductions.

name: Fondo Azul Costa Rica
summary: Funding programme that pays for the protection and control project of the Cocos marine conservation area.

name: Fondo de Biodiversidad Sostenible
summary: Fund providing long-term financing for biodiversity conservation on private land, with landowner support including wildlife monitoring, which its GBIF record says it recorded on supported properties.

name: Fondo Nacional de Financiamiento Forestal
summary: Costa Rican forest financing fund whose PPSA pays for environmental services and which, in January 2026, led a camera-trap initiative planned for farms in the PPSA.

name: French–Costa Rican collaboration on biodiversity monitoring in Corcovado National Park
summary: French and Costa Rican collaboration, led by NatureXpairs with SINAC, in which an October 2025 mission shared GeoNature knowledge, with expected integration of Corcovado's mammal data into the national PRONAMEC platform.

name: Fundación Amigos de la Isla del Coco
summary: A foundation that, per La República (2018), monitored the waters around the island by satellite from January 2012 to June 2017, and per Delfino (2024) cooperates at about US$500,000 a year.

name: Fundación Saimiri
summary: Organisation that lists 16 years of primate monitoring in Costa Rica's South Pacific and applied research on wildlife crossings and habitat restoration among its programmes.

name: Great green macaw ecoacoustic monitoring
summary: Ecoacoustic project described in January 2024, with 113 AudioMoth recorders across almost 11,000 square kilometres and AI analysis, planned to run initially for two to three years.

name: Guanacaste Wildlife Monitoring
summary: Camera-trap project in Guanacaste, reported in 2020 as aiming to install 24 camera sets in five protected areas, with students planning, but not yet using, AI to build a jaguar database.

name: Innoceana
summary: Local marine conservation non-profit, per Earth.Org, that measures water quality at georeferenced points and makes seabed maps with BIIGLE software around Isla del Caño.

name: Instituto Geográfico Nacional
summary: Part of the Registro Nacional, it released the CR-PPP GNSS processing tool in 2026 via the SNIT geoportal and is one of three bodies making up SIMOCUTE.

name: Instituto Internacional de Conservación y Manejo de Vida Silvestre
summary: Part of the Universidad Nacional, it began fitting jaguars with satellite collars in Tortuguero National Park, according to Delfino in September 2025.

name: Instituto Nacional de Biodiversidad
summary: Heredia-based GBIF publisher of national datasets on Costa Rican insects, plants and fungi under a CC0 waiver; GBIF marks the insect dataset as orphaned, awaiting adoption.

name: Inventario Nacional Forestal (Costa Rica)
summary: SINAC-led national forest inventory begun in 2013, reported in 2016 as the first forest carbon stock calculation by this route and as input to REDD monitoring, with a second inventory planned for 2020.

name: Laboratorio PRIAS
summary: Laboratory within CeNAT that, according to an Ambientico article heading, leads from academia the development of the MOCUPP management tool, which it builds.

name: Macaw Recovery Network
summary: Organisation working on conservation of the great green and scarlet macaws, one of whose researchers El Financiero reports installing AudioMoth recorders high in almond trees.

name: Ministerio de Ambiente y Energía
summary: Costa Rica's environment ministry, with SINAC and CENIGA attached, which announced in August 2025 the design, through SINAC, of a platform to store, analyse and share biodiversity monitoring data.

name: Monitoreo de aves de los Corredores Biológicos Interurbanos
summary: Twice-yearly bird counts in the eight interurban biological corridors of the Greater Metropolitan Area, recorded in eBird; a TEVU biologist reported 11,976 birds in the April 2026 count.

name: Monitoreo de Cambio de Uso en Paisajes Productivos
summary: Land-use change monitoring project run by the Centro Nacional de Alta Tecnología; a 2020 UNDP report said it used free Landsat and Sentinel imagery and published data through SNIT.

name: Monitoreo Paso del Jaguar
