summary: An active programme run by the Information Technology Organization and the Forests, Range and Watershed Management Organization, whose subsystem uses satellite images and AI, with Tasnim reporting 39,064 violations identified so far.

name: Lar National Park
summary: National park whose head said it closes for part of each year to protect sensitive habitats, and that it reopened to visitors after the 2025 breeding season.

name: Lorestan Provincial Department of Environment
summary: Provincial environment office whose director general said patrols and round-the-clock monitoring had been stepped up, and a joint patrol with Sefidkuh Khorramabad protected area rangers arrested an illegal hunter.

name: Lorestan University
summary: A university in Iran whose authors OpenAlex lists on a 2020 deep learning paper on carp species identification and a 2026 paper on wetland land cover mapping with imbalanced training data.

name: Lut Desert World Heritage Base
summary: In August 2025, the former head said the base had set up three local bases and a national base in Tehran and asked visitors for GPS tracker data.

name: Marine Turtle Conservation Project
summary: A closed project run by Emirates Nature-WWF, the Marine Research Foundation and Iran's Department of Environment, using satellite telemetry from 2010 to 2013 to monitor 75 post-nesting hawksbills tagged in four countries.

name: Markazi Provincial Department of Environment
summary: Provincial environment office whose acting head reported that the national Department of Environment managed 13 areas in Markazi province, covering 306,998 hectares.

name: Mazandaran Crane Conservation Association
summary: Saving Cranes reports it formed in 1998 and about 200 duck trappers had joined through local trust funds by 2000, and the ICCA Consortium cited its literature in 2007.

name: Mazandaran Provincial Department of Environment
summary: Provincial environment office whose protection unit commander reported a wildfire in Miankaleh wildlife sanctuary in August 2020, and whose director said in September 2022 that over 90 percent of area approvals were implemented.

name: Monitoring the Urmia Lake using a spaceborne multisensor approach
summary: A project run by the University of Stuttgart's Institute of Geodesy that monitors Lake Urmia from space using altimetry, imagery and GRACE, and looks at the restoration programme after 2014.

name: National Biodiversity Monitoring Plan (Iran)
summary: Plan reportedly drafted by the Department of Environment in August 2019, covering forests and rangelands and aiming to monitor indicator wildlife with modern methods and technologies.

name: National Cartographic Center of Iran
summary: Iran's mapping organisation, which Asriran, citing ISNA in October 2024, associated with a Sentinel-1 subsidence map and spatial data archives dating to the 1950s.

name: National Cartographic Centre of Iran
summary: Listed by the UN SALB programme as Iran's national geospatial information authority, which Tasnim reports works with the Information Technology Organization's spatial content platform to standardise the country's maps.

name: National census of indicator wildlife species (Iran)
summary: Nationwide census of indicator wildlife announced in October 2025, run by the Department of Environment, with one pilot area per province to be counted using drones and night-vision cameras.

name: National Land Monitoring System (Iran)
summary: Subsystem of the Single Window for Land Management, whose image processing used AI according to Mehr News in September 2023, when officials still sought priority Khayyam images.

name: National Wetlands Geoportal of Iran
summary: A geoportal that a Geopack user guide says provides tools to manage and share descriptive, spatial and document data on wetlands under the Department of Environment.

name: Nayband Sustainable Development Organisation
summary: A general assembly of community organisations in Chah Mobarak village elected the organisation’s management board.

name: North Khorasan Provincial Department of Environment
summary: Provincial environment office whose director listed three national parks, four protected areas and the Miandasht wildlife refuge as areas it managed, as stated in May 2014.

name: Persian Gulf and Gulf of Oman Coastal and Offshore Monitoring
summary: Run by INIOAS for five years from 1400, with the National Environment Fund as employer, this project plans cruise-based data collection and results for the Department of Environment.

name: Persian leopard camera-trap monitoring in the Iranian Caucasus
summary: EcoIran reports 120 camera traps for Persian leopards and prey were handed to the Department of Environment in August–September 2025 under a joint 2017 WWF–department decision.

name: Persian Wildlife Heritage Foundation
summary: A non-profit started in 2008 that used camera traps to study Iranian cheetahs, which The World reports had members arrested by the Iranian government from early 2018.

name: Plan for the Land Society
summary: A non-profit NGO for wildlife conservation in Iran and the Middle East, reported by Mehr in December 2019 to have monitored marine mammal populations with the Department of Environment over five years.

name: Qazvin Provincial Department of Environment
summary: Provincial environment office whose director general said its staff recorded an Iranian hyena during night patrols in its protection jurisdiction in Abyek county.

name: Qeshm Free Zone Organization
summary: Community Conservation reports that about 25 km of Qeshm’s south coast at Shibderaz was declared a turtle breeding and hatchery area with this body and the village council.

name: Qeshm Island UNESCO Global Geopark
summary: The geopark’s website gives its Paris registration by the Global Network of Geoparks on 21 March 2006, its central office on Qeshm and postings for guards and rangers.

name: Razavi Khorasan Provincial Department of Environment
summary: Provincial environment office that, YJC reported in June 2019, formally took charge of integrated management of the four categories of protected area under a memorandum, described as a first in Iran.

name: Razi University
summary: A public university in Kermanshah, founded in 1971, whose researchers Koohestun reports are involved in an AI population estimate of the yellow-spotted mountain newt.

name: Research Institute of Forests and Rangelands
summary: An Iranian research institute whose authors OpenAlex lists on 2023 and 2025 machine learning papers on Hyrcanian forests, and whose site lists a herbarium and the Natural Resources Gene Bank.

name: Sahem
summary: An active platform built by Tiznegar and used by the Forests, Range and Watershed Management Organization, which Digiato reports offers fire risk prediction and burned-area mapping and monitored 140 million hectares in 2024.

name: Sari Agricultural Sciences and Natural Resources University
summary: A university in Iran whose authors OpenAlex lists on a 2021 paper on biodiversity index and a 2023 paper on tree species diversity, both using machine learning.

name: Semnan Provincial Department of Environment
summary: Provincial environment office that Tehran Times reported in November 2026 managed 2.8 million hectares, including national parks, wildlife refuges, protected areas and no-hunting zones.

name: Shahid Beheshti University
summary: A university in Iran whose authors OpenAlex lists on 2025 and 2026 machine learning papers on habitat suitability and species distribution models for medicinal plants.

name: Shiraz University
summary: Iranian university whose authors are listed by OpenAlex on 2023 and 2025 machine learning papers, on habitat suitability and the distribution of a tree species under climate change.

name: Sistan and Baluchestan Provincial Directorate of Environmental Protection
summary: A provincial directorate whose director-general said rangers in the Birak forest area recorded a leopard on camera traps, set at several points to gather data on indicator species.

name: Smart Environmental Monitoring Centre (Department of Environment, Iran)
summary: Centre run by the Department of Environment, reportedly opened in November 2025, where Omid Hajati said environmental data were centralised for intended AI decision support and warnings.

name: Soldouz NGO
summary: Non-governmental organisation whose representative is named as the contact in the ICCA Consortium database entry for the Soldouz (Sirangoli) wetland.

name: South Khorasan Provincial Department of Environment
summary: Provincial environment office whose director general said four of the province's 74 identified caves lie in areas under environment management, and that protecting them is the office's responsibility.

name: Status Assessment of Pallas’ cat Otocolobus manul (Pallas, 1776) in one of its westernmost distribution extents in Alborz Mountains, Iran
summary: A project awarded $6,905 by the Mohamed bin Zayed Species Conservation Fund in November 2015, using camera trapping to collect basic ecology and conservation data on Pallas's cat in Central Alborz reserves.

name: Taklé tribe of the Shahsevan tribal confederacy
summary: Tribe in the Shahsevan confederacy of 32 tribes, reported in 2015 to have 120 households and a Taklé ICCA for which it considered further conservation actions.

name: Tarbiat Modares University
summary: Iranian university with a natural resources and marine sciences faculty, whose authors OpenAlex lists on species and habitat papers from 2020, 2022 and 2026, two using machine learning.

name: Tehran Municipality
summary: City authority that, according to a speaker quoted by Hamihan in June 2024, was assigned to manage and regularly water forest parks owned by the Natural Resources organisation, including Chitgar park.

name: Tehran Provincial Directorate of Environmental Protection
summary: The 1404 (2025-26) census in most areas managed by the directorate counted 28,540 indicator herbivores, with results showing about a 6% rise on 1403.

name: Tiab Women’s Green Nursery
summary: A 2025 UNDP story describes Tiab’s first women-led mangrove nursery, with capacity for around 1,500 seedlings.

name: Tiznegar
summary: Company founded by Yaser Ashourzadeh and Farinaz Taghizadeh that runs and built Sahem, producing AI reports from satellite images and attracting investment in Mehr 1402, according to Digiato.

name: Touran National Park
summary: Camera traps recorded male and female Persian leopards at a water point; reported spot-pattern analysis across the park and protected complex identified at least 12 adults and one cub.

name: Toward Establishment of a Systematic Monitoring of the Persian Leopard in Bamou National Park, and Capacity Building Among the Park’s Rangers and Local Volunteers
summary: A project, as described in January 2018, planned to re-estimate Persian leopard abundance in Bamou after ten years, set a continuous monitoring plan, and train rangers and local people in camera trapping.

name: Union of Indigenous Camel Herders of Iran
summary: Organisation of camel herders (UniCamel) that the ICCA Consortium reported in 2019 would be helped by a Cenesta initiative to strengthen itself in the territories of life of mobile Indigenous peoples.

name: Union of Indigenous Nomadic Tribes of Iran
summary: The union described itself as a tribal federation and national platform for nomadic pastoralists’ councils and livelihood funds with a Tehran secretariat, and ICCA reported Cenesta’s plans to help.

name: University of Hormozgan
summary: Iranian university whose authors are listed by OpenAlex on 2023 and 2026 machine learning papers about mangrove forests, covering satellite image classification and habitat degradation in the Persian Gulf.

name: University of Mohaghegh Ardabili
summary: Iranian university whose authors are listed by OpenAlex on machine learning papers from 2022, 2025 and 2026, including plant distribution, bird call classification with neural networks and mangrove habitat.

name: University of Tabriz
summary: Iranian university whose authors are listed by OpenAlex on a 2023 and a 2022 paper classifying satellite images to monitor mangrove forests on Qeshm Island.

name: University of Tehran
summary: Iranian university whose authors are listed by OpenAlex on machine learning papers from 2020, 2023 and 2026, covering carp identification, rangeland species mapping and mangrove mapping.

name: Urmia Lake Restoration National Committee
summary: Set up by Iran’s government to oversee the three-phase Urmia Lake Restoration Program, the committee oversaw halophyte planting for dust control and carried out grazing control during restoration.

name: Waterbird Census of Fars Province
summary: Closed 2022 census of waterbirds in Fars Province, entrusted by the provincial Department of Environment to AvayeBoom, which recorded 20,027 birds of 76 species across 13 sites.

name: Waterbird Census of Hormozgan Province
summary: Closed waterbird census run by Hormozgan’s Department of Environment over 20 days in early 2023, recording 64,123 waterbirds of 97 species and monitoring 76% of covered regions.

name: Waterbird Census of Isfahan Province
summary: Closed census run by AvayeBoom in 2018 and 2019, funded by the Isfahan Department of Environment, which surveyed 14 wetlands and recorded 8,903 birds of 45 species in 2019.

name: West Azerbaijan Provincial Department of Environment
summary: Provincial environment office whose director general said water reservoirs were built for wildlife in Marakan protected area and Lake Urmia National Park islands, and in June 2026 listed Gadar and Dasht Sutav management as ongoing.

name: Winiapp
summary: Organisation that says its members designed IoT devices, long-range wireless networks and mobile apps for foresters, and that it has installed the system in the Mongasht mountains, Khuzestan.

name: Yazd Provincial Department of Environment
summary: Mehr News describes reserves protected with private-sector participation under the office’s supervision and quotes its deputy saying approved reserves cover about 193,000 hectares, nearly 2.5% of Yazd province.

name: Zanjan Provincial Department of Environment
summary: Provincial environment office whose deputy said 298,909 hectares, 13.7 percent of the province, were under its management, and in August 2026 that managed areas and no-hunting zones exceeded 492,000 hectares.

name: Agricultural University of Iceland
summary: University whose site describes a palsa mire project bringing together remote sensing, soil science and ecology experts to promote long-term monitoring, and which runs that project.

name: Arctic Fox Centre
summary: Non-profit research and exhibition centre on the Arctic fox, which says it has monitored wild foxes on Hornstrandir Nature Reserve since 1998 and mainly collects data from hunted carcasses donated by hunters.

name: Arctic fox population monitoring (Iceland)
summary: Monitoring project whose stated main goal is to estimate Iceland's Arctic fox population and track changes in its size and distribution, relying on carcasses sent in by fox hunters.

name: BioProtect
summary: EU-funded project coordinated by Matís with 18 partners from 8 countries and 8 million euros, planning an Area-Based Management Decision Support Framework to be demonstrated at five study sites.

name: BIOTOOL
summary: Project that, per a October 2022 Matís announcement, aimed to develop genetic methods using eDNA to monitor seabed ecosystems under and near fish farming sea cages; partners include Matís and the Technical University of Denmark.

name: Brent goose monitoring (Iceland)
summary: Monitoring project that counts brent geese passing through Iceland each autumn and spring, and has also tracked their migrations with satellite transmitters alongside partners in the UK and Ireland.

name: CORINE Land Cover Iceland
summary: Icelandic part of the pan-European CORINE land cover classification, run by the Natural Science Institute of Iceland, with classifications for 2000, 2006, 2012 and 2018 and change layers for 2006, 2012 and 2018.

name: Cormorant monitoring (Iceland)
summary: Annual estimate of great cormorant and shag breeding populations from nest counts on aerial photographs, run by the Natural Science Institute of Iceland, which took it over in 2016 from monitoring begun in 1975.

name: East Iceland Nature Research Centre
summary: Regional nature research centre in Neskaupstaður, established by regulation with state support, which reported GPS transmitters on more than 20 pink-footed geese in the East Iceland highlands.

name: Fuglavernd – BirdLife Iceland
summary: Membership bird conservation NGO, founded in 1963 by its own account, with 1,300 members in 2024 and a January 2024 Garden Bird Weekend recording 14,416 birds across 153 sites.

name: GBIF Iceland
summary: Country node of GBIF with voting status, listed in GBIF's directory at an address at the Natural Science Institute of Iceland, and partnering with the Global Biodiversity Information Facility.

name: Grey seal census (Iceland)
summary: Aerial census programme for grey seals in Iceland, carried out at regular intervals since 1982, which put the 2022 population at 6,697 animals.

name: Gyrfalcon monitoring in Northeast Iceland
summary: Research on gyrfalcon population ecology in a study area of about 5,300 square kilometres, carried out since 1981 and assessing territory occupancy as an index of breeding population size.

name: Harbour seal census (Iceland)
summary: Aerial census programme for harbour seals in Iceland, carried out at regular intervals since 1980, which gave an estimated population of 10,319 from the summer 2020 census.

name: Icelandic bird ringing scheme
summary: Bird ringing programme begun in 1921, run by the Natural Science Institute of Iceland since 1932, which has sole legal authority to ring wild birds, with ringing done by permitted volunteers.

name: Icelandic Mid-Winter Bird Count
summary: Volunteer-run annual winter bird count held since 1952 to record bird numbers and distribution, covering more species than any other monitoring programme in Iceland.

name: Icelandic National Forest Inventory
summary: Forest inventory described in the Forest Reference Level report, which says systematic sample plot inventory began in 2005 and the third cycle of cultivated forest finished in 2019.

name: Icelandic Orca Project
summary: Orca research project begun in 2008, described as the longest running in Icelandic waters, which has identified over 400 whales by photo-identification and catalogued the population's calls.

name: Icelandic Seal Center
summary: Seal centre that announced a July 2023 count on Vatnsnes and Heggstaðanes to support research and sustainable wildlife-watching tourism, and lists 2026 count results.

name: Icelandic Terrestrial habitat types (EUNIS classification) map
summary: Map of Icelandic habitat types under the EUNIS classification at 1:25,000, which the EEA catalogue says is downloadable through the National Land Survey's data portal, built by the Natural Science Institute.

name: Important Bird Areas in Iceland
summary: Map layer of 121 areas in Iceland defined as internationally important for 81 bird species, grouped into seabird colonies, rocky coast and shallow marine waters, and wetlands and other inland areas.

name: ISMN Catalog
summary: Catalogue of over 1,500 individual humpback whales from the 1980s to date, collected during MFRI surveys and by partners and contributors.

name: Land and Forest Iceland
summary: Icelandic agency based at Gunnarsholt that in May 2024 sought participants for its Landvöktun monitoring project, whose data feed the national evaluation of vegetation and soil resources.

name: Landvöktun - lykillinn að betra landi
summary: Monitoring project announced in May 2024 under Grólind, in which participants' measurements would help evaluate the state of vegetation and soil nationwide.

name: Marine and Freshwater Research Institute
summary: Government institute under the Ministry of Industries that advises on sustainable use and protection through marine and freshwater monitoring, lists seafloor and habitat mapping as a priority, and attempted minke whale tagging in 2024.

name: Matís
summary: Public limited company formed under a 2006 act from three state food research institutions, which says it is developing eDNA methods.

name: Monitoring lepidopteran species (Iceland)
summary: Light-trap monitoring of Iceland's Lepidoptera at 19 sites for 30 weeks a year, built by the Natural Science Institute of Iceland and begun in 1995 within the Nordic Moth Monitoring Scheme.

name: Monitoring of cliff-breeding birds (Iceland)
summary: Long-term study of Iceland's cliff-breeding seabirds, with monitoring reported at twelve locations nationwide and fixed-camera photographs at two Westfjords cliffs analysed for egg-laying dates and breeding success.

name: Multi-instrumental investigation of Icelandic palsa mires
summary: Project, run by the Agricultural University of Iceland, that brings together physical geography, remote sensing, soil science and ecology experts to promote long-term monitoring of palsa mires, which its page calls highly threatened by climate change.

name: Mývatn Nature Research Station
summary: Nature research station by Lake Mývatn whose 2021–2024 plan described long-term lake biota monitoring, and which carried out the 2024 aquatic vegetation measurements.

name: Natural Science Institute of Iceland
summary: Icelandic institute doing baseline nature research and monitoring, holding sole bird ringing authority, operating a Mývatn research station, with 11 datasets published on GBIF.

name: Nature Conservation Agency of Iceland
summary: Agency that began work on 1 January 2025, announced it would assume the former Environment Agency’s nature conservation duties, and runs Vatnajökull National Park.

name: Seal haul-outs (Iceland)
summary: Map layer showing 430 harbour seal haul-out sites in 93 survey areas and 86 grey seal haul-out sites in 19 survey areas, at a scale of 1:25,000.

name: South Iceland Nature Research Centre
summary: Nature research centre whose 2025 annual report says 70% of operations rest on state funding and that describes puffin monitoring, part-funded by the hunting card fund, with surveys at 13 or more colonies.

name: Southeast Iceland Nature Research Centre
summary: Natural science research and service institution under Act 54/2024, covering Hornafjörður and Skaftárhreppur, which reported surveying Skarðsfjörður mudflat invertebrates in 2026, following a comparable survey in 1979.

name: Surtsey research and monitoring expedition
summary: Annual research and monitoring expedition to Surtsey run by the Natural Science Institute of Iceland, with biologists on the island from 12 to 15 July in the 2025 report.

name: Umhverfis-, orku- og loftslagsráðuneytið
summary: Icelandic ministry that handles the largest share of environment and nature conservation policy, with an office covering conservation on land and at sea, protected areas, biodiversity and marine protection.

name: University of Iceland's Research Centre in Húsavík
summary: Research centre opened in December 2008 that keeps long-term whale photo-identification, sightings and behavioural records with students and whale-watching companies, and in 2015 measured blue whale call source levels.

name: Vöktun náttúruverndarsvæða
summary: Programme described in a research plan as the Natural Science Institute's, carried out with the nature research centres, including 2024 repeated moorland bird monitoring in Jökulsárgljúfur reported by the Northeast Iceland centre.

name: Vöktun rjúpnastofnsins
summary: Annual ptarmigan population monitoring run by the Natural Science Institute with the Westfjords Nature Research Centre, with organised counts since 1963 and 2,325 cock birds seen in spring 2025.

name: Vöktun Þingvallavatns
summary: Monitoring project on the biota and water quality of Þingvallavatn that began in 2007, which its summary report treats as an important tool for protecting the lake's ecosystem.

name: West Iceland Nature Research Centre
summary: Research centre owned by West Iceland municipalities with state support, focusing on alien and invasive species and bird and mammal ecology, which mapped shore and shallow-sea habitats.

name: Westfjords Nature Research Centre
summary: Nature research centre responsible to six municipalities under Act no. 60/1992, conducting cliff bird monitoring and assuming oversight of Látrabjarg cameras and beginning vegetation monitoring in 2022.

name: Westman Islands Research Centre, University of Iceland
summary: University of Iceland research centre named in the affiliation of the last author, Filipa I. P. Samarra, on a 2024 paper on killer whale occurrence in Icelandic waters using passive acoustic monitoring.

name: White-tailed eagle monitoring (Iceland)
summary: Icelandic white-tailed eagle survey, first made in 1920 and annual since 1963, which tracks the population's size, viability and distribution through spring pair surveys and midsummer breeding success checks.

name: 20tab
summary: Software company that says it developed the AUTOMA marine monitoring platform with EdgeLab, Superfici and Pelagosphera.

name: 3Bee
summary: Italian naturetech company that develops technology for monitoring and regenerating biodiversity. In 2025 it launched XNatura, an internal division combining AI, IoT sensors and satellite data.

name: A Multi-Modal Deep Learning Framework for High-Resolution Alpine Land Use/Land Cover
summary: A deep learning model for high-resolution Alpine land use and land cover maps, built by ARPA Valle d'Aosta, Politecnico di Torino and DigiSky, fusing several data types and reaching a mIoU of 0.777 across 14 classes.

name: A5 TECH
summary: Italian innovative SME combining Earth observation, marine robotics and AI to observe coastal ecosystems.

name: Acquario di Genova
summary: Aquarium in Genoa that, with its foundation, manages the Intercet platform for data on cetaceans and sea turtles.

name: AGRITECH-LEAF
summary: PNRR project from 2022 to 2025 on Italian mountain forests. ForestLab at the University of Milan built components including Biomass Analyst, which combines machine learning, satellite data, LiDAR and drones.

name: AgroBioMonitor
summary: Tuscan project monitoring biodiversity on cereal farms with camera traps, passive acoustic monitoring and AI, to give farmers evidence of environmental value.

name: AI4Nature
summary: Industrial research project with 17 partners and a budget of about 9 million euros, promoted by the NBFC Foundation with the FAIR Foundation, developing AI tools for environmental risk and biodiversity protection in southern Italy.

name: Aisma
summary: Italian company listed as a partner in the SeaSMA marine monitoring project.

name: ALIENA
summary: Thirty-month project with seven active partners building joint monitoring of marine non-indigenous species, with environmental DNA and forecast models.

name: ALP-AI
summary: Interreg project between Lombardy and Ticino on AI for environmental monitoring, biodiversity protection and biosecurity. Drone thermal images from Arpa Lombardia are to be used by Politecnico di Milano to train algorithms that recognise and count animals.

name: AlpsLife
summary: Project launched in September 2024 and led by Eurac Research's Institute for Alpine Environment, with 12 partners from six Alpine countries, gathering information on biodiversity monitoring methods and sampling locations across the Alps.

name: ANTPI
summary: Raspberry Pi based system for recognising ant species automatically in real time, using a deep learning model. It is at the testing stage.

name: ARCA
summary: Interreg IPA ADRION project from May 2024 to April 2027 developing an AI system for forest monitoring from machine learning, IoT sensors, video, drones and LiDAR.

name: ARPA FVG
summary: Environmental agency that took part in an OGS environmental DNA study of the Marano and Grado lagoon, including sampling in the lagoon.

name: Arpa Lombardia
summary: Environmental agency for Lombardy. Its Regional Earth Observation Centre flew night-time drone surveys of wildlife in the Campo dei Fiori park as part of the Interreg ALP-AI project.

name: ARPA Piemonte
summary: A regional environmental agency whose biodiversity monitoring is commissioned project by project, including field surveys of forest habitats, deadwood and saproxylic invertebrates in Natura 2000 sites.

name: ARPA Valle d'Aosta
summary: A regional environmental agency partnering with Politecnico di Torino, whose work includes multimodal Alpine land cover research and acoustic monitoring through “Cosa canta?”, started in March 2025.

name: AUTOMA
summary: Open-access platform combining underwater robotics and AI to identify marine species, especially invasive alien species, funded through the National Biodiversity Future Center.

name: Azienda Speciale Parco di Porto Conte
summary: Management body for the Porto Conte regional nature park and the Capo Caccia Isola Piana marine protected area, acting for the Sardinia region and the environment ministry.

name: Banche Dati Naturalistiche
summary: A database of Piedmont fauna and flora records from surveys, literature and collections, supplied by volunteers and institutions, built by IPLA and the Gruppo Piemontese Studi Ornitologici, with a tiered-access web platform.

name: BeeNet
summary: Italian monitoring network with over 300 bee stations, some with sensor hives, and a network of wild bee and honey flora sites, used to assess the agro-environment.

name: BIMM
summary: A project in the Sirente-Velino regional nature park that aims to develop drone protocols for optical and thermal data, and plans a software platform with a dashboard and WebGIS.

name: BIO-WATCH
summary: A project collecting animal species data in seven Natura 2000 sites with citizen volunteers, proposing apps and drones for collection and planning to develop the park's biodiversity database.

name: BIO.UP
summary: A project in Gran Paradiso National Park that plans to test automatic biodiversity monitoring sensors and aims to build a platform combining environmental and biological data in near real time.

name: Biodiversity Gateway
summary: Italian biodiversity portal, the virtual side of the Biodiversity Science Gateway created by the National Biodiversity Future Center, with physical sites in Palermo and Venice.

name: Biodiversity Monitoring South Tyrol
summary: Regional biodiversity monitoring programme set up by Eurac Research with the Museum for Nature South Tyrol and the provincial government. Its pilot studies test automated image and sound collection with AI.

name: BioGro
summary: A project that uses a neural network system called Flora, with ESA, to monitor the park's plants from satellite images, and the Spectrum IoT sensor to monitor its insects.

name: Biosurvey S.r.l.
summary: Company based in Palermo offering water body monitoring, seagrass seabed restoration with a patented anchoring module for Posidonia oceanica cuttings, acoustic surveys and photogrammetry, working with public research bodies.

name: Bioves-It
summary: A project aiming to estimate pollinator presence, richness and diversity in Vesuvius National Park, using a 3Bee method and a 3Bee bioacoustic sensor installed for bees and hoverflies.

name: BombHab
summary: A project in the Appennino Lucano Val d'Agri-Lagonegrese National Park that plans environmental DNA detection of the Apennine yellow-bellied toad, an online microclimate database and a studbook of sampled animals.

name: BramitAPP
summary: A project that aims to digitise the deer census, active since 2007, through an app and a web portal, with the Casentinesi Forests National Park and ISPRA as partners.

name: Care4Seal
summary: Project analysing seawater samples for environmental DNA of the Mediterranean monk seal in the north-west Mediterranean, using citizen science.

name: Carta della Natura
summary: Italian map system giving computerised knowledge of the territory at national, regional and local scales, listed among ISPRA's services.

name: Carta Forestale Italiana
summary: National forest map at 1:10,000 scale, made by CREA for the agriculture ministry's forests directorate and available through the national forest information system SINFor.

name: Centro di ricerca e coordinamento per il recupero della fauna selvatica
summary: Wildlife recovery research and coordination centre set up by the University of Udine and based at its department of agri-food, environmental and animal sciences. Its site publishes reports on data entered in the InfoFaunaFVG app.

name: Centro Euro-Mediterraneo sui Cambiamenti Climatici
summary: Italian climate research centre that coordinates ARCA, an AI platform for forest monitoring in the Adriatic-Ionian area.

name: Centro Interdisciplinare di Bioacustica, Università di Pavia
summary: Bioacoustics centre in the University of Pavia's Department of Earth and Environmental Sciences. It works with WWF Italia on using the Guardiani della natura recordings to study Mediterranean biodiversity.

name: Centro Italiano Studi Ornitologici
summary: Italian ornithological association that leads the mandate administering Ornitho.it and can release observations from it for research.

name: Centro Siciliano di Fisica Nucleare e di Struttura della Materia
summary: Sicilian physics research centre that coordinates the VONGOLA project and leads its work package on acoustics.

name: CIMA Research Foundation
summary: Italian research foundation that gives ISPRA technical and scientific support with drone surveys of natural habitats in Italy's 24 national parks, as part of DigitAP.

name: CINECA
summary: Italian inter-university consortium that CORDIS lists as a participant in Blue-Cloud and that NBFC lists among its partners.

name: CNR Dipartimento di Scienze Bio-AgroAlimentari
summary: CNR department that coordinates institutes holding research collections of organisms. Its GBIF record says these collections are part of the national BioMemory network and have been digitised and published.

name: CNR Dipartimento Scienze del Sistema Terra e Tecnologie per l'Ambiente
summary: Department of Italy's National Research Council working on the Earth system, climate, natural resources and biodiversity. It coordinates the Italian GBIF node.

name: CNR Istituto di Ricerca sugli Ecosistemi Terrestri
summary: Institute of Italy's National Research Council that led a study showing PRISMA hyperspectral data and LiDAR can monitor forest habitat diversity.

name: CNR Istituto di Scienze Marine
summary: CNR marine science institute. Its site reports a researcher in Lerici describing the use of AI in devices that observe and monitor the seabed.

name: CNR Istituto di Scienze Polari
summary: CNR polar sciences institute. Its Bologna branch manages two marine observatories, in Svalbard and the southern Adriatic, that measure biological as well as physical and biogeochemical parameters.

name: CNR Istituto per lo Studio Impatti Antropici e Sostenibilità in Ambiente Marino
summary: A marine research institute, run by the Consiglio Nazionale delle Ricerche, whose bioacoustics line studies marine and freshwater environments through sound, alongside seabed infrastructure management and in situ monitoring.

name: Co-wolf
summary: A closed project that aimed to extend monitoring of three large predators in Mont Avic nature park and integrate its wildlife sampling into the Aosta Valley regional database under FAIR principles.

name: COFAM
summary: Mapping, monitoring, reporting and verification system for forest CO2 sequestration, combining satellite data with field surveys, with credits that can go on Italy's National Forest Carbon Credit Registry.

name: Comando Unità Forestali, Ambientali e Agroalimentari dei Carabinieri
summary: Carabinieri forestry and environment command. With CREA Foreste e Legno it produces and publishes the official results of Italy's national forest inventory.

name: Compagnia Generale Ripreseaeree
summary: Company selected with Fugro by ISPRA to map coastal habitats for the Marine Ecosystem Restoration project.

name: Comunanza delle Regole d'Ampezzo
summary: Body entrusted by the Veneto region with managing the Dolomiti d'Ampezzo nature park, set up in 1990 on land the Regole d'Ampezzo own collectively.

name: Comune di Favignana (Area Marina Protetta Isole Egadi)
summary: Municipality that has managed the Egadi Islands marine protected area, set up in 1991, since 2001 on behalf of the environment ministry.

name: Comune di Villasimius (Area Marina Protetta Capo Carbonara)
summary: Municipality given sole management of the Capo Carbonara marine protected area, which was set up by ministerial decree in 1998.

name: Consiglio Nazionale delle Ricerche
summary: Italy's National Research Council. It is the leading entity for LifeWatch Italy and coordinates the ITINERIS network of environmental research infrastructures.

name: Consiglio per la ricerca in agricoltura e l'analisi dell'economia agraria
summary: Italian agricultural research body under the agriculture ministry. Its Forestry and Wood centre made the Forest Map of Italy, supports the national forest inventory and runs a forest geomatics laboratory.

name: Consorzio di Gestione Area Marina Protetta Tavolara Punta Coda Cavallo
summary: Management body of the Tavolara Punta Coda Cavallo marine protected area, with a statute and its legal seat in Olbia.

name: Consorzio di Gestione dell'Area Marina Protetta di Portofino
summary: Management consortium of five bodies for the Portofino marine protected area, which surrounds the Portofino promontory across the municipalities of Camogli, Portofino and Santa Margherita Ligure.

name: Consorzio di Gestione dell'Area Marina Protetta di Punta Campanella
summary: Consortium of six municipalities that leads the Punta Campanella marine park, located between the gulfs of Naples and Salerno.

name: Consorzio Isole dei Ciclopi
summary: Consortium of the Comune di Acicastello and the University of Catania that has managed the Isole Ciclopi marine protected area for the environment ministry since 2001.

name: COSMO-SkyMed
summary: Radar satellite constellation of the Italian Space Agency, which ASI lists among its Earth science missions for monitoring the state of the planet.

name: Costa Edutainment
summary: An organisation whose 2022 report describes the Delfini Metropolitani dolphin monitoring programme running since 2020, with data on the Intercet platform, and which reports over 20 years of Mediterranean cetacean research.

name: CREA Foreste e Legno
summary: Forest and wood research centre of Italy's agricultural research council CREA, responsible for the scientific and technical side of the national forest inventory.

name: CSMON-LIFE
summary: Italian citizen science project on biodiversity funded by the European Commission's LIFE+ programme, among the initiatives coordinated by the University of Trieste under Dryades.

name: D.R.E.Am. Italia
summary: Italian environmental services company commissioned to carry out bat, small mammal and larger mammal monitoring in the 24 national parks under DigitAP, with data analysed on the Wild.AI platform.

name: D4BLOND
summary: Project on a drone for biodiversity assessment with imaging, flow cytometry and eDNA, listed by its principal investigator at SZN with dates to 30 June 2025.

name: Department of Life Sciences, University of Trieste
summary: University department that created the Portal to the Flora of Italy through the Dryades Project and maintains ITALIC, the information system on Italian lichens.

name: DIGIMEDFOR
summary: Horizon Europe project coordinated by the University of Naples Federico II on digital tools for managing Mediterranean forest resources. CORDIS tags 40% of it to AI.

name: DigiSky
summary: An organisation that, according to ARPA Valle d'Aosta, worked with it on the Alpine land use and land cover deep learning framework.

name: DigitAP
summary: Recovery plan measure held by the environment ministry to digitise Italy's national parks and marine protected areas, including monitoring with drones and terrestrial laser scanners under ISPRA's technical and scientific coordination.

name: Dilupoli
summary: Project in Liguria, coordinated by Coldiretti Liguria, that uses AI camera traps able to tell species apart, with deterrents, to manage wolves around livestock farms.

name: DiSSCo Italy
summary: Italian national node of the European DiSSCo research infrastructure, promoting digitisation of natural science collections across Italy.

name: Dryades
summary: Project hosted at the Department of Life Sciences, University of Trieste, whose servers run the FlorItaly portal.

name: e-GEOS
summary: Satellite data services company that offers deforestation monitoring through its brAInt platform, according to a 2021 interview on Leonardo's site.

name: Eco4Alps
summary: Three-year ESA-funded project developing Earth observation services on Alpine ecosystems, led by Solenix with Eurac Research and BOKU.

name: Ecocanto
summary: Startup based in Treviglio whose Upupa sensors listen continuously and recognise species with bioacoustic deep learning.

name: EcoSense
summary: RUMA's platform based on Sentinel satellite imagery, for monitoring and certifying the effectiveness of reforestation projects.

name: EdgeLab
summary: Company that describes AUTOMA, a system for recognising Mediterranean marine taxa and alien species from AUV images, among its projects.

name: Eliante Onlus
summary: An organisation advising Regione Lombardia and coordinating wolf monitoring with Istituto Oikos, whose site describes farmers and volunteers collecting Co-Wolf images using camera traps and thermal viewers.

name: ENDOR
summary: CNR project on an integrated system with airborne imaging and AI algorithms to detect fires automatically and map the health of plants.

name: Ente di gestione delle Aree protette del Ticino e del Lago Maggiore
summary: Protected areas management body whose Regione Piemonte page lists reserves in its care, including Canneti di Dormelletto, Fondo Toce, the Baragge, Garzaia di Villarboit and Palude di Casalbeltrame.

name: Ente di Gestione delle Aree Protette dell'Appennino Piemontese
summary: A protected area management body whose site describes combining rules, research and field work, and which hosted more than 40 operators for the 2026/2027 wolf monitoring cycle.

name: Ente di Gestione delle Aree Protette dell'Ossola
summary: A protected area management body recognised by the Piedmont region as holder of the "Tipica fauna alpina" reference centre, publishing annual reports on its monitoring.

name: Ente di Gestione delle Aree Protette delle Alpi Marittime
summary: A Piedmont regional agency managing two parks and eight nature reserves in the province of Cuneo, which invites the public to take part in its rangers' monitoring work.

name: Ente Parco dei Nebrodi
summary: Authority for the Nebrodi park, set up on 4 August 1993, which extends over more than 86,000 hectares and is the largest of the Sicilian parks.

name: Ente Parco delle Madonie
summary: Authority for the Madonie regional park, which lists DARTA 1489 of 9 November 1989 as its founding measure.

name: Ente Parco Monte Barro
summary: Park authority whose identity page gives the area of the Monte Barro park as 665 hectares.

name: Ente Parco Naturale Mont Avic
summary: The body for Mont Avic nature park, an Aosta Valley protected area of over 5,747 hectares set up in 1989, which runs Co-wolf and is funded by the National Biodiversity Future Center.

name: Ente Parco Naturale Paneveggio Pale di San Martino
summary: Park body governed by provincial law 11 of 23 May 2007, represented by its president.

name: Ente Parco Nazionale dei Monti Sibillini
summary: Park body set up by presidential decree under Law 394/1991, whose activities include monitoring and protecting animal species.

name: Ente Parco Nazionale del Cilento, Vallo di Diano e Alburni
summary: Park body set up by presidential decree on 5 June 1995, seated at Vallo della Lucania, with governing bodies set by Law 394/1991.

name: Ente Parco Nazionale del Gargano
summary: Body for the 121,118-hectare Gargano national park, set up by presidential decree of 5 June 1995, which has also managed the Isole Tremiti marine nature reserve since 1991.

name: Ente Parco Nazionale del Pollino
summary: Managing body of the Pollino National Park, which covers 192,565 hectares across Calabria and Basilicata and has been protected since 1993.

name: Ente Parco Nazionale del Vesuvio
summary: Body for the Vesuvius National Park, established on 5 June 1995, whose area includes a nature reserve, a wilderness area, two Sites of Community Importance and a Special Protection Area.

name: Ente Parco Nazionale dell'Alta Murgia
summary: Body for the Alta Murgia National Park, which was set up by presidential decree of 10 March 2004.

name: Ente Parco Nazionale dell'Asinara
summary: Park authority whose page presents the Asinara national park together with the Isola dell'Asinara marine protected area.

name: Ente Parco Nazionale della Sila
summary: Managing body of the Sila national park, set up by presidential decree in 2002, which protects 73,695 hectares across Sila piccola, Sila grande and Sila greca.

name: Ente Parco Regionale dell'Appia Antica
summary: Management body of the Appia Antica regional park, set up by regional law 66 of 10 November 1988 and described as an instrument of the Lazio region.

name: Ente Parco Regionale Veneto del Delta del Po
summary: Body for the Po Delta regional park in Veneto, which was set up on 8 September 1997 by regional law 36.

name: Ente Regionale Parco dell'Etna
summary: Body for the Etna park, the first Sicilian park, set up by regional presidential decree in 1987, covering 59,000 hectares and tasked mainly with protecting the environment around the volcano.

name: Ente Regionale Parco di Veio
summary: Body for the Veio park, set up by regional law 29 of 6 October 1997, which extends over 14,984 hectares.

name: Epsilon Italia
summary: Company that CORDIS lists as a participant in FAIRiCUBE. No page of its own has been read.

name: ERSAF Lombardia
summary: A Lombardy regional body entrusted with managing six nature reserves of about 2,300 hectares, whose forests have held FSC and PEFC certification since December 2009.

name: EU Pollinator Hub
summary: Platform for data on pollinator health and beekeeping for the EU Bee Partnership, developed in a joint EFSA and BeeLife project.

name: Eurac Research
summary: Private research centre in Bolzano. It coordinates the science of a national acoustic bird monitoring programme in 22 Italian National Parks, runs an eLTER site, and worked on the ESA-funded Eco4Alps project.

name: EuroCaM
summary: Across-network platform of camera trapping observations built by EUROMAMMALS to answer its spatial ecology questions.

name: EUROMAMMALS
summary: Bottom-up network that pools tracking, bio-logging and camera trap data on European mammals. Data can be used by contributors or for a specific agreed question.

name: European Food Safety Authority
summary: EU agency in Parma that says it is financially assisting the move of the EU Bee Partnership's prototype data platform to the EU Pollinator Hub.

name: Farmland Bird Index (Italia)
summary: Italian bird monitoring project run by Lipu for the agriculture ministry since 2009, building on the Mito2000 census that began in 2000. It gives indices of farmland birds and mountain grassland species, published with the National Rural Network.

name: Faunis Srl
summary: University of Sassari spin-off in wildlife management and conservation, a member of the network behind the Dilupoli project.

name: Feelera
summary: A benefit company in Brescia whose EUDR software uses Sentinel-2 imagery every four months with GFC2020 and NDVI analysis, and covers geolocation, risk assessment and due diligence statements to TRACES.

name: FloraFaunaSüdtirol
summary: Internet portal to the distribution of plant and animal species in South Tyrol, giving an insight into the scientific database of the Museum of Nature South Tyrol.

name: FlorItaly
summary: Online portal to the checklist of native and alien vascular plants of Italy, running on servers of the Dryades project at the University of Trieste.

name: Fondazione Acquario di Genova
summary: Foundation linked to the Genoa aquarium. It manages the Intercet platform with the aquarium and, by Oceanomare Delphis's account, coordinated the INTERMED project on Risso's dolphins and sperm whales.

name: Fondazione Bruno Kessler
summary: Italian research foundation and an academic and research partner in WildDrone, a project on autonomous drones for wildlife monitoring, where it hosts a doctoral student.

name: Fondazione Capellino
summary: Italian foundation that says it was the first funder of LIFE WolfAlps EU after the European Union, with 600,000 euros going to activities including wolf monitoring.

name: Fondazione Centro Velico Caprera
summary: Foundation behind the M.A.R.E. project on Mediterranean marine monitoring, run in scientific collaboration with One Ocean Foundation.

name: Fondazione COISPA
summary: Foundation that CORDIS lists as a participant in DTO-BioFlow. No page of its own has been read.

name: Fondazione Compagnia di San Paolo
summary: Italian foundation whose Simbiosi 2026 call supports work on natural capital and restoring degraded ecosystems, and asks projects to include monitoring before and after the work.

name: Fondazione Dare Frutto
summary: A foundation given Tenuta San Marzano, set in a 54-hectare natural wood formerly reserved for private hunting, which dropped the hunting concession for a biodiversity protection project.

name: Fondazione Edmund Mach
summary: Italian research foundation in Trentino and a funded partner in BIG_PICTURE, a Biodiversa+ project pooling camera-trap data across Europe with AI image processing.

name: Fondazione Ethoikos
summary: Non-profit foundation in Radicondoli, Siena, that runs field studies of small mammals, including monitoring with radiotracking and camera traps, and a long-term snow vole monitoring project.

name: Fondazione Forestami
summary: A third-sector body set up to carry out the Forestami project, coordinating the planting, care and protection of urban and peri-urban green space.

name: Fondazione Giustiniani Bandini
summary: A foundation that the manual names as the managing body of the Abbadia di Fiastra nature reserve.

name: Fondazione Portus
summary: A foundation that the manual lists as running the Oasi di Porto, an area of 10 hectares.

name: Fondazione Zegna
summary: A foundation that the manual lists as running Oasi Zegna, an Italian private natural area of 1,700 hectares, which it owns and looks after.

name: Fondo per l'Ambiente Italiano
summary: A non-profit foundation founded in 1975, modelled on the National Trust, to protect Italy's historic, artistic and landscape heritage; it says it has saved 72 sites across Italy.

name: ForestInfo
summary: Pilot open-access platform on Italian forests that uses AI on Sentinel-2 images and Copernicus products to give private owners information on forest disturbance and carbon. Funded through the EU FPCUP action.

name: Forests from Space
summary: Feasibility study by Treedom and Planetek Italia under ESA's Business Applications programme, using Sentinel-2, PRISMA and commercial imagery to verify the growth and health of planted forests.

name: FORSAID
summary: Horizon Europe project coordinated by the University of Padova that develops digital technologies for early detection and monitoring of forest pests.

name: GBIF Italia
summary: Italy's national GBIF node, managed by the National Research Council on behalf of the Ministry of University and Research. Italy joined GBIF as a voting member in October 2025.

name: GeoCetus
summary: Georeferenced database of cetacean and sea turtle strandings in Italy. The site names Centro Studi Cetacei Onlus as the contact for registration.

name: Global Mammal Assessment
summary: Programme at Sapienza University of Rome assessing mammal extinction risk, developing distribution maps and forecasting biodiversity loss.

name: Gran Paradiso National Park
summary: National park whose Alpine Wildlife office in Turin is listed as a partner in SEPPI, which uses time-lapse cameras and deep learning to identify pollinators.

name: Greenpeace Italia
summary: Italian Greenpeace organisation, which runs Mare Caldo, a project monitoring climate impacts in Italian seas.

name: Gruppo Piemontese Studi Ornitologici "F.A. Bonelli" ETS
summary: A group that coordinates research on wild birds in Piedmont and the Aosta Valley and holds thirty years of bird records given by members and collaborators.

name: Guardiani della natura
summary: WWF Italia and Huawei project using audio devices, cloud and AI in reserves managed by WWF, on a model built with Rainforest Connection. Its first three months at Astroni, Burano and Orbetello gave over 300,000 recordings and over 1,000 alerts of possible illegal activity.

name: Imaging FlowCytobot in the Gulf of Naples
summary: SZN's installation of an Imaging FlowCytobot on its Meda B buoy, the first in the Mediterranean according to SZN. Machine learning identifies plankton from its images.

name: InfoFaunaFVG
summary: Progressive web app recording wildlife recovery interventions in Friuli Venezia Giulia, with periodic reports on the data entered.

name: Infordata Sistemi
summary: Italian benefit company that developed Karst Firewall 5.0, a public wildfire intelligence tool for the Italy-Slovenia Karst.

name: Intercet
summary: Regional platform for data on cetaceans and sea turtles in the Mediterranean, managed by Acquario di Genova and Fondazione Acquario di Genova, gathering data from about 50 research institutes.

name: Inventario Forestale Nazionale Italiano
summary: Italy's fourth national forest inventory, begun in 2025 and carried out by the Carabinieri forestry command with scientific and technical support from CREA.

name: Inventario Nazionale delle Foreste e dei serbatoi forestali di Carbonio
summary: Italy's national forest inventory. Its site gives access to statistics, plot-level data and project documents, and the basic data are free to use for any purpose except producing forest statistics at territorial level.

name: Inwit
summary: Italian tower company that, with Legambiente, is installing smart cameras with AI software on its towers in Abruzzo to detect forest fires.

name: IRIDE
summary: Italian Earth observation programme under the recovery plan, developed by ESA with support from the Italian Space Agency, serving public bodies on hazards including fires and coasts. ESA gave a budget of about 1.1 billion euros in 2023.

name: ISOLE RARE
summary: A project, run by the Tuscan Archipelago National Park, that plans to monitor marine biodiversity through eDNA metabarcoding, remote sensing and genetics.

name: Istituto Geografico Militare
summary: State mapping body of Italy, under the Ministry of Defence, with its main seat in Florence. Its own site did not respond, so these facts come from a 2022 press report.

name: Istituto Idrografico della Marina
summary: Italian Navy's hydrographic institute in Genoa, a state cartographic body.

name: Istituto Nazionale di Oceanografia e di Geofisica Sperimentale
summary: Italian oceanography and geophysics institute. A press release describes its study of fish in the Marano and Grado lagoon using environmental DNA with ARPA FVG and the Stazione Zoologica Anton Dohrn.

name: Istituto Oikos SRL
summary: Italian social enterprise working since 2008 on environmental research, conservation and monitoring. It carries out wildlife monitoring and worked with D.R.E.Am. Italia on DigitAP.

name: Istituto Superiore per la Protezione e la Ricerca Ambientale
summary: Italian public environmental research body under the supervision of the environment minister. It runs the Network Nazionale della Biodiversità and supports the ministry on biodiversity policy.

name: Italia Nostra
summary: An organisation that has managed the Monte Patalecchia regional nature reserve since August 2017, and was entrusted by Molise region with the Torrente Callora reserve that month.

name: Italian GBIF node
summary: Italy's national node of the Global Biodiversity Information Facility, set up after Italy joined in October 2025 and coordinated by the CNR department DSSTTA.

name: Italian Mammal Society
summary: Italian society that since 2014 has started or sponsored citizen science projects collecting mammal sightings, with records checked by expert members before entering its database.

name: ITALIC
summary: Information system on Italian lichens, maintained at the University of Trieste. Version 8.0 has been online since September 2024 and added a tool that generates identification keys.

name: ITINERIS
summary: Recovery plan project coordinated by CNR to build a network of Italian environmental research infrastructures and give access to them through the ITINERIS HUB. It started in November 2022.

name: Karst Firewall 5.0
summary: Public wildfire tool for the Karst plateau on the Italy-Slovenia border, with real-time risk maps and fire-weather data, built from satellites, sensors and AI.

name: Latitudo 40
summary: Naples Earth observation company whose AI algorithms turn satellite imagery into information on climate, infrastructure and the environment, and a member of the WI4EURECA consortium in PCP WISE.

name: Legambiente
summary: Italian environmental association in partnership with Inwit on forest fire monitoring with AI cameras in Abruzzo, and on air quality monitoring.

name: LIFE ADAPTS
summary: Five-year project in Italy, Greece and Cyprus on the climate resilience of loggerhead and green turtles and monk seals, using eDNA, drones, camera traps and underwater surveys.

name: LIFE CONCEPTU MARIS
summary: LIFE project on cetaceans and pelagic sea turtles in the Mediterranean that uses ferries as research vessels, with eDNA, stable isotopes, hull sensors and citizen science.

name: LIFE WolfAlps EU
summary: LIFE project on wolf-human coexistence across the Alps, led by the Alpi Marittime park with 20 other bodies in Italy, France, Austria and Slovenia, including wolf monitoring.

name: LifeWatch Italia
summary: Italy's distributed national biodiversity research institute within LifeWatch ERIC. Its portal offers data, semantic resources, ICT services, virtual research environments and a citizen science platform.

name: Lipu
summary: Italian bird conservation NGO and BirdLife International's Italian partner. Since 2009 the agriculture ministry has tasked it with calculating the Farmland Bird Index from a national bird survey.

name: LTER-Italia
summary: Italy's long-term ecological research network, with 61 sites across land, freshwater, marine and transitional waters and four more in Antarctica.

name: M.A.R.E.
summary: Fondazione Centro Velico Caprera project, scientifically coordinated by One Ocean Foundation, that monitors Mediterranean pollutants and marine species from a sailing boat. Its fourth edition ended in 2025 after mapping the whole basin.

name: MAIA
summary: Project aiming to build an updatable multi-taxa geodatabase, accessible to stakeholders, on the high-mountain communities of the Maiella, in Maiella National Park, with the Universities of Perugia and Teramo as partners.

name: Mare Caldo
summary: Greenpeace Italia project, started in 2019 with the University of Genoa and OGS, monitoring the impacts of climate change in Italian seas.

name: Marine Ecosystem Restoration
summary: Italian recovery plan project to restore marine habitats and map coastal habitats along the whole Italian coast, including Posidonia and Cymodocea meadows. ISPRA selected a Fugro-led consortium for the mapping.

name: Meteorological and Environmental Earth Observation
summary: Earth observation company that CORDIS lists as a participant in ILIAD, the digital twin of the ocean project. No page of its own has been read.

name: Ministero dell'Agricoltura, della Sovranità Alimentare e delle Foreste
summary: Italian agriculture and forests ministry. Its forests directorate commissioned the Carta Forestale Italiana from CREA, and it has tasked Lipu with calculating the Farmland Bird Index since 2009.

name: Ministero dell'Ambiente e della Sicurezza Energetica
summary: Italian environment ministry. Its minister adopted the national biodiversity strategy to 2030, and it holds the recovery plan measure for digitising national parks and marine protected areas.

name: Ministero dell'Università e della Ricerca
summary: Italian research ministry that funded the PANACEA project on Posidonia monitoring under its PRIN2022 programme. Its own site refused the fetcher.

name: MON-I-DRON
summary: Project monitoring invasive alien species in the Tepilora regional nature park with drones, field surveys and citizen science, funded by the National Biodiversity Future Center, with planned drone surveys of 3,000 to 5,000 images over 100 hectares.

name: MoVaFIsU
summary: Project in the Ustica Island marine protected area, funded by the National Biodiversity Future Center, which plans an open online database: a taxonomic and genetic archive with a dedicated herbarium.

name: MUSE, Museo delle Scienze
summary: Science museum in Trento that carries out research on climate change, biodiversity and landscape, runs citizen science projects, and is listed in the WildBotics consortium.

name: Museum of Nature South Tyrol
summary: Natural history museum in Bolzano that runs FloraFaunaSüdtirol, a public portal to its distribution data on plants and animals.

name: MustelaWatch
summary: Portal for polecat and weasel records in Italy, taking photographs and camera-trap footage from the public, with validated records mapped alongside the National Biodiversity Network.

name: Nadyr Byte
summary: Startup named as a partner in the VONGOLA marine monitoring project.

name: National Biodiversity Future Center
summary: Italy's first national research and innovation centre dedicated to biodiversity, funded by NextGenerationEU. It is organised as a hub and spokes, and has built a national digital platform that uses modelling and AI.

name: National Oceanographic Data Centre, Italy
summary: Italian reference centre in the IOC-UNESCO data exchange system, at OGS, which manages and freely redistributes marine data, with more than 300,000 water-column profiles.

name: Natural Intelligence for Robotic Monitoring of Habitats
summary: Horizon 2020 project listed by ISPRA, with a budget of about 3 million euros, developing AI-enhanced robots that install sensors and gather data for monitoring natural habitats.

name: Nauta
summary: Maker of autonomous acoustic monitoring stations for biodiversity and environmental impact work, recording audio and ultrasonic bands up to 190 kHz.

name: NBFC Digital Platform
summary: National Biodiversity Future Center's digital infrastructure, combining monitoring, Earth observation and genomic data with modelling, AI and high-performance computing to simulate ecosystems and support decisions.

name: Nemoris
summary: Benefit company and University of Milano-Bicocca spin-off founded in 2025, which monitors ecosystems with environmental DNA, sensors, camera traps and acoustic sensors. No page read mentions AI.

name: Network Nazionale della Biodiversità
summary: National biodiversity data network promoted by the environment ministry and managed by ISPRA. It shares data held by national and regional bodies, published as open data under CC-BY 4.0.

name: Newtec_Biodiv
summary: Eurac Research project on new technologies for biodiversity monitoring. It includes a national acoustic monitoring programme across 22 Italian National Parks, with thousands of recorders, and validation of automated species identifications.

name: Oceanomare Delphis
summary: Non-profit working on cetacean conservation in the Mediterranean. It collects data on behaviour and acoustics, runs the Ischia Dolphin Project and has uploaded photo-identification data to Intercet.

name: One Ocean Foundation
summary: Foundation that provides scientific coordination for the M.A.R.E. project, which combines visual surveys of the Mediterranean with environmental DNA sampling and acoustic recordings.

name: Ornitho.it
summary: Species recording platform used in Italy, with a section for mammals set up for the Italian Mammal Society in 2014.

name: Orto Botanico di Padova
summary: Botanic garden that partners with Flora Incognita, whose plant identification app visitors can test at the Risvegli flower festival, and a founding member of the RIBES germplasm bank network.

name: PANACEA
summary: Project by the Universities of Pisa and Florence using robots with onboard AI to monitor Posidonia oceanica meadows, funded by the Italian Ministry of University and Research. Results were presented after two and a half years of work.

name: Parco del Campo dei Fiori
summary: Regional park in the province of Varese and a partner in the ALP-AI project, whose staff supported Arpa Lombardia's night-time drone surveys of wildlife.

name: Parco Lombardo della Valle del Ticino
summary: A park set up under a regional law of 1974.

name: Parco Naturale Adamello Brenta
summary: A park whose protected territory covers the whole Brenta group and much of the Adamello-Presanella massifs, which still hold glaciers, with administrative headquarters at Strembo, in Trentino.

name: Parco Nazionale Arcipelago Toscano
summary: Italian national park that received two drones from the environment ministry through DigitAP to monitor species and habitats.

name: Parco Nazionale d'Abruzzo, Lazio e Molise
summary: Italian national park where the WADAS AI system for detecting wildlife was trialled. Its own site refused the fetcher, so these facts come from press coverage.

name: Parco Nazionale delle Foreste Casentinesi
summary: Italian national park where the University of Florence runs systematic camera trapping under a formal agreement, using a web platform with AI to sort images.

name: Parco Regionale della Maremma
summary: A regional park that a 1994 regional law turned from a consortium of municipalities into an autonomous non-economic public body with its own legal personality.

name: Parco Regionale delle Alpi Apuane
summary: A body set up by regional law 65 of 11 August 1997, responsible for managing the Alpi Apuane park and protecting its natural, landscape and environmental values.

name: Parco Regionale Gola della Rossa e di Frasassi
summary: A regional park covering 10,026 hectares, the largest protected area in the Marche.

name: Pelagos Consortium
summary: International project of 13 organisations to strengthen conservation and governance of the Pelagos Sanctuary, promoted by the Pelagos Initiative and coordinated by the Tethys Research Institute.

name: Piattaforma Oceanografica Acqua Alta
summary: Oceanographic platform installed in March 1970 and run by the CNR, serving as a fixed sampling point for biological and chemical water column parameters, with data in real time and archive via an app.

name: Planetek Italia
summary: Italian benefit company in geomatics, space solutions and Earth sciences. With Treedom it developed the Forests from Space feasibility study on satellite monitoring of planted forests.

name: Politecnico di Milano
summary: Italian technical university that takes part in the ALP-AI project, where it is to train AI to recognise and count animals in drone thermal images.

name: Politecnico di Torino
summary: A university partnering with ARPA Valle d'Aosta on Alpine land cover research, with a 2023 OpenAlex-listed paper by its authors on AI forecasting of FAPAR.

name: Polytechnic University of Marche
summary: Italian university that CORDIS lists as a participant in DiverSea, and that NBFC lists among its partners.

name: POSEIDON
summary: PNRR project using Sentinel-2 imagery with machine learning and deep learning to map Posidonia oceanica meadows, and drones to map banquettes. No page read says who leads it.

name: PRISMA
summary: Italian Space Agency hyperspectral Earth observation satellite launched on 22 March 2019, which ASI says contributes to monitoring pollution and environmental change and supports the management of natural resources.

name: Provincia Autonoma di Trento
summary: Italian autonomous province whose sustainable development and protected areas service promoted the Trentino Living Atlas portal for natural history data.

name: Raggruppamento Carabinieri Biodiversità
summary: A Carabinieri unit that manages 130,000 hectares of natural land through 28 departments.

name: Reef Check Italia
summary: Italian non-profit linked to the Reef Check Mediterranean protocol, under which trained volunteer divers have recorded 43 key marine species along Mediterranean coasts since 2001.

name: Repertorio Naturalistico Toscano
summary: Natural history archive for Tuscany covering habitats, plant communities, flora and fauna of conservation interest. A final report describes its update for 2005 to 2010, published in January 2012.

name: Rewilding Apennines
summary: Local partner of Rewilding Europe in the Central Apennines, working on ecological corridors between protected areas for the Marsican bear and other wildlife, with camera trap monitoring listed among its work.

name: Ripartizione Servizio forestale, Provincia autonoma di Bolzano
summary: South Tyrol forest service which said in a 4 March 2026 news release that about 200 new camera traps were being installed for wildlife monitoring, focused on large predators, after staff training in February 2026.

name: RUMA
summary: Startup accredited to the University of Trento that combines remote sensing and AI for natural capital monitoring. It developed the EcoSense platform and worked with FBK on LiDAR forest surveys.

name: Salviamo l'Orso
summary: Italian association that presented the WADAS AI trial with the Abruzzo, Lazio and Molise National Park and the University of L'Aquila, to reduce conflict between people and wildlife, in particular Marsican bears.

name: Sapienza University of Rome
summary: Italian university that CORDIS lists as a participant in NaturaConnect and ILIAD, and that NBFC lists among its partners.

name: Scubla S.r.l.
summary: Company that, according to ISPRA's DigitAP page, won the public tender to provide the camera traps the environment ministry supplied to all national parks.

name: SeaSMA
summary: Project within the National Biodiversity Future Center building a monitoring platform for marine protected areas from satellite data, surface and underwater drones, IoT sensors and AI. No page read says who leads it.

name: Sistema Informativo Centralizzato
summary: System that collects and shares monitoring data under the Marine Strategy Framework Directive, with data gathered by the regional environment agencies (ARPA) and ISPRA.

name: Sistema Informativo Nazionale delle Foreste e delle Filiere Forestali
summary: Italy's national forest information system, promoted by the agriculture ministry and built by CREA, gathering statistical, administrative, map and environmental forest information.

name: Sistema Nazionale a rete per la Protezione dell'Ambiente
summary: National environmental protection network of ISPRA and the regional agencies. With ISPRA it produces yearly mapping and indicators on land take, and a 2021 article says it developed land cover mapping from satellite data, machine learning and field data.

name: Smart Forest Environmental Monitoring
summary: Carabinieri forestry command project combining satellite monitoring and drones to watch forest areas, including urban forests, with automatic alerts. It was admitted for 30 million euros of funding.

name: Stazione Zoologica Anton Dohrn
summary: Italian marine research institute that took part in an OGS environmental DNA study of the Marano and Grado lagoon.

name: SuMo
summary: Parco Nord Milano project using AudioMoth recorders to study the soundscape, with recordings to be used to implement AI software for recognising singing animals such as birds and orthoptera.

name: Telespazio
summary: Joint venture of Leonardo and Thales for geospatial services. It signed a memorandum with the Pian di Spagna and Lake Mezzola Nature Reserve under which services for environmental and wildlife monitoring will be developed.

name: Terradue
summary: Company that CORDIS lists as a participant in ILIAD, the digital twin of the ocean project. No page of its own has been read.

name: Tethys Research Institute
summary: Italian marine research body working mainly in the Mediterranean. It runs two long-term cetacean monitoring projects, the Cetacean Sanctuary Research and the Ionian Dolphin Project.

name: Torre Guaceto marine biodiversity monitoring experiment
summary: Experiment at the Torre Guaceto marine protected area in which underwater cameras watch Posidonia meadows, and AI and deep learning recognise and classify the species.

name: Treedom
summary: Tree-planting company whose platform is to show satellite-based indicators of planted forests, following a feasibility study with Planetek Italia.

name: Trentino Living Atlas
summary: Open-source portal for sharing natural history data in Trentino, promoted by the Province of Trento's sustainable development and protected areas service with the main bodies that study biodiversity there.

name: Trust-IT Services
summary: Company that CORDIS names as coordinator of Blue-Cloud, and a participant in the BioDT and DTO-BioFlow projects. No page of its own has been read.

name: Trusty
summary: Italian benefit corporation offering supply chain traceability, including a compliance product for the EU deforestation regulation that uses geolocation and satellite monitoring.

name: University of Bari Aldo Moro
summary: University with partner link to Global Fishing Watch, whose authors have OpenAlex-listed papers on deep learning for dolphin photo-identification, bark beetle mapping in Sentinel-2 data, and coastal seagrass monitoring.

name: University of Bologna
summary: Italian university whose Department of Agricultural and Food Sciences is listed as a partner in FunDive, which combines citizen science, AI tools and eDNA monitoring of fungi.

name: University of Cagliari
summary: Italian university whose Department of Biomedical Sciences is listed as a partner in FunDive, which combines citizen science, AI tools and eDNA monitoring of fungi.

name: University of Genoa
summary: University with a partner link to Mare Caldo, whose authors have OpenAlex-listed papers on computer vision and deep learning for plankton and for tracking the brown algal parasite Eurychasma dicksonii.

name: University of Naples Federico II
summary: Italian university whose Department of Biology is listed as a partner in BioBoost+, which applies AI to digital imagery of marine species.

name: University of Turin
summary: A university named as a partner in the BioGro pollinator monitoring project.

name: University of Udine
summary: University that built a wildlife recovery research and coordination centre and is project partner 2 in the Interreg Italy-Austria BioBox project, which will test drone, sensor and monitoring methods at pilot sites.

name: Università Agraria di Manziana
summary: A body that the manual names as managing the Macchia Grande di Manziana, a wood of about 550 hectares that it describes as collective property of Manziana's residents.

name: Università degli Studi dell'Aquila
summary: Italian university that collaborates on the WADAS AI system for wildlife detection.

name: Università degli Studi di Firenze
summary: Italian university whose departments of information engineering and biology work on the Wild.AI camera-trap platform, and which carried out the PANACEA project on robots monitoring Posidonia with the University of Pisa.

name: Università degli Studi di Milano
summary: Italian university whose ForestLab built components of AGRITECH-LEAF, and a project partner in Newtech_Biodiv.

name: Università degli Studi di Padova
summary: Italian university that coordinates the FORSAID project on forest pest surveillance with AI and digital technologies.

name: Università degli Studi di Palermo
summary: University that leads Spoke 1 of the National Biodiversity Future Center and published a cascade call of EUR 2.2 million for projects applying technologies including big data, IoT and AI to biodiversity.

name: Università di Catania
summary: Italian university that develops AI algorithms to identify marine fauna in the VONGOLA project and is a partner in WatchEDGE.

name: Università di Parma
summary: University whose ethologists worked with AI specialists at the University of Perugia on ANTPI, a system that recognises ant species in real time. It also teaches a course on AI in biodiversity monitoring.

name: Università di Pavia
summary: Italian university whose bioacoustics and ecoacoustics group tests third-party software for signal analysis and automatic classification with AI techniques.

name: Università di Trento
summary: Italian university whose Sensing Technologies laboratory develops AI and machine learning methods for analysing remote sensing data for Earth observation and environmental monitoring.

name: Università di Trieste
summary: Italian university whose life sciences department coordinates the Dryades biodiversity informatics initiatives.

name: VONGOLA
summary: PNRR research project within the National Biodiversity Future Center that develops computer vision and acoustic monitoring to analyse the Mediterranean marine soundscape and biodiversity.

name: WADAS
summary: Open-source AI application trialled in the Abruzzo, Lazio and Molise National Park that detects and classifies wild animals in camera feeds and alerts operators in real time, to reduce conflict with people, with a focus on Marsican bears.

name: WatchEDGE
summary: Three-year, one million euro project testing AI camera traps, radar, multispectral drones and edge computing to monitor wild boar, fallow deer and wolves in San Rossore park.

name: Webgenesys
summary: Italian IT company developing COFAM, a monitoring and verification system for forest CO2 sequestration from Earth observation data and field surveys.

name: Whale Vision
summary: Neural network tool and application for identifying sperm whales and other cetaceans from photographs of flanks or flukes.

name: Wild.AI
summary: University of Florence project building a platform for camera-trap wildlife data that combines AI and computer vision with ecological tools. A Foreste Casentinesi report describes its use there to sort images.

name: WildBotics
summary: MSCA doctoral network coordinated by FBK's 3DOM unit that develops aerial and ground robots and AI processing for sampling and monitoring in nature conservation, with a pilot in the Trentino Dolomites.

name: Wildlife Technologies
summary: Maker of tracking and alarm devices for monitoring and researching wildlife and livestock, powered by Omega.

name: Witted Srl
summary: Italian marine robotics company that, according to a blog post by the software firm Onshape, wants to map seabeds along Italy's coast and study the decline of Posidonia oceanica with its robots.

name: WOLF-IT2000
summary: Project run by the Tuscan-Emilian Apennine National Park in which captured pure and hybrid wolves are released where caught and fitted with satellite collars for monitoring.

name: World Biodiversity Association
