summary: Grant-making foundation registered in January 1992, describing itself as the largest Philippine one outside government for the environment, with biodiversity assessment and monitoring among its grant strategies.

name: From Forest Floor to Treetops: Capturing Mammalian Diversity with Camera Traps
summary: Closed project in which William & Mary and Palawan State University students surveyed mammals in the proposed Sultan Peak Critical Habitat with camera traps, piloting an AI process for the data.

name: GBIF Philippines
summary: Programme listed in GBIF's registry as the Philippines' observer participant, with a partnership link to the Global Biodiversity Information Facility; its current status is unknown.

name: Gerry Roxas Foundation
summary: Foundation that Thinking Machines said in March 2022 was to administer USD 16 million in grants over five years to restore ecosystems in 30 key Philippine bioregions.

name: Haribon Foundation
summary: Conservation organisation whose publications page describes CAME as a system for monitoring Key Biodiversity Areas outside protected areas; it also lists a 2022 community monitoring primer and shared Buguey Wetlands data in 2016.

name: HerpWatch Pilipinas, Inc.
summary: Non-stock, non-profit professional organisation for Philippine amphibians and reptiles, based in Tondo, Manila, that publishes GBIF datasets of Palawan herpetofaunal surveys and invasive alien reptile records.

name: Katala Foundation, Inc.
summary: A conservation organisation working mainly in the Palawan archipelago, based in Puerto Princesa City, which runs the Philippine Cockatoo Conservation Program.

name: LAMAVE whale shark research and conservation programme
summary: A whale shark research programme run by the Large Marine Vertebrates Research Institute Philippines, using photo-identification, satellite telemetry, stereophotogrammetry and genetics, with satellite tags deployed at Tubbataha in 2015.

name: Large Marine Vertebrates Research Institute Philippines
summary: Organisation reporting a national photo-ID catalogue for mantas, sea turtles and whale sharks, using photo-ID in seven provinces, which used baited underwater video in Tubbataha for Global FinPrint.

name: Lawin Forest and Biodiversity Protection System
summary: Forest protection system combining planning, technology-aided patrolling and open-source data platforms; Chemonics reports over 3,000 patrollers monitoring over 6.2 million hectares, and it was built by the DENR and Chemonics.

name: Mabuwaya Foundation
summary: Organisation legally named Mabuwaya Foundation Inc., funded by the Critical Ecosystem Partnership Fund; its project begun in 2021 lists five Philippine crocodile surveys and two Isabela Oriole surveys.

name: MangroveLEAF
summary: Model introduced in a 2025 paper that OpenAlex lists, found in a query on remote sensing and machine learning; its status is unknown.

name: Marine Conservation Philippines
summary: Registered non-profit NGO in Negros Oriental whose teams monitor 15 reef sites, reporting around three million observations since September 2017 and sharing seasonal analyses with local government units.

name: Marine Environment and Resources Foundation, Inc.
summary: Foundation whose ClimateREEFS project, funded by RARE Philippines and running from January 2024 to November 2026, supports reef assessments and eDNA work in Eastern Samar and Southern Leyte to identify climate-adaptive reefs.

name: Marine Mammal Research and Conservation Laboratory
summary: Laboratory run by the University of the Philippines Diliman that monitors Philippine marine mammal and megafauna populations using distance sampling, photo-identification and visual and acoustic surveys.

name: Marine Science Department, College of Science and Mathematics, Mindanao State University - Iligan Institute of Technology
summary: Marine science department in Iligan City, listed as an affiliation by the first author of a 2026 paper on eDNA metabarcoding of marine fish biodiversity in Tawi-Tawi.

name: Marine Wildlife Watch of the Philippines
summary: Non-profit conservation organisation incorporated in 2010, with projects on wedgefish fisheries and a published Red List status of Philippine marine mammals, funded by Pew and GIZ and working with several partners.

name: Mindanao State University at Naawan
summary: University campus that runs the Philippine node of the eDNA Indo-Pacific mangroves project, and which DOST-PCAARRD says it supported as a future centre of eDNA research in the Philippines.

name: Mindoro Biodiversity Conservation Foundation, Inc.
summary: Non-stock, non-profit foundation registered in 2008, with research and monitoring programmes; records from a 1999 island-wide survey underpinned the Mindoro Biodiversity Information System species database.

name: National Copernicus Capacity Support Action Programme for the Philippines
summary: A programme launched on 24 April 2023 to strengthen use of Copernicus data in the Philippines through a CopPhil Centre, with services co-developed with PhilSA and partners who will continue them after the pilot.

name: National Fisheries Research and Development Institute
summary: Attached agency of the Department of Agriculture tasked with fisheries research and development, which runs and implements the National Stock Assessment Program providing baseline data on aquatic resources and fish stocks.

name: National Mapping and Resource Information Authority
summary: DENR agency that PhilSA describes as mandated to act as the central mapping agency and depository for natural resources data, with a partnership link to the Philippine Space Agency.

name: National Stock Assessment Program
summary: Fisheries programme, run by the National Fisheries Research and Development Institute, that collects data from 742 landing sites, analyses stock status over time per fishing ground, and uses an ecosystem approach.

name: Nationwide Mangrove Map
summary: Map of 2023 mangroves produced by PhilSA with the DENR from Sentinel-2 and ALOS PALSAR-2 images, launched on 28 February 2024 with validation still to come.

name: Nationwide Mangrove Map 2023
summary: Mangrove map built by the Philippine Space Agency from Sentinel-2 and ALOS PALSAR2 images; in March 2024 PhilSA said it would be validated, with ground data from local offices, NGOs and academics.

name: Palawan Council for Sustainable Development
summary: A body established in 1992 by Republic Act 7611 to govern the Strategic Environmental Plan for Palawan, which under a February 2026 agreement is to receive land use, land cover and benthic maps from PhilSA.

name: Palawan Rainforest Guardian project
summary: Project initiated, Huawei says, by the DENR, Smart Communications, Rainforest Connection and Huawei; Huawei reports a monitoring system in five pilot protected areas in Palawan, rolled out in January 2020.

name: Philippine Association for Intercultural Development
summary: Quezon City organisation reporting partnerships with over 250 Indigenous communities over 50 years, training communities in mapping and GIS, with a Rainforest Trust-supported Maragusan project spanning 2022 to 2026.

name: Philippine Biodiversity Conservation Foundation
summary: Non-profit, non-government organisation based in Bacolod City that led a biodiversity survey of five Dinagat Island watersheds with KAISAHAN Foundation, with over 30 field days between May and July 2024.

name: Philippine Clearing House Mechanism
summary: Biodiversity information programme run by the Biodiversity Management Bureau, listing material on aligning the national strategy with the Kunming-Montreal framework and an open data section on protected and key biodiversity areas.

name: Philippine Cockatoo Conservation Program
summary: A Katala Foundation programme whose measures can include nest monitoring and protection involving former poachers, with the foundation reporting that cockatoo populations are recovering at all project sites.

name: Philippine Coral Reef and Mangrove Remote Sensing
summary: A joint University of the Philippines and DENR project aiming to produce regional and provincial coral reef and mangrove maps using Landsat imagery and field validation.

name: Philippine Council for Agriculture, Aquatic and Natural Resources Research and Development
summary: A DOST-run research council that supported a 2023 benchmarking trip through its Foreign Travel Fund and whose division monitored and evaluated the Siargao eDNA project in August 2023.

name: Philippine Eagle Foundation
summary: Organisation that reported in February 2023 having fitted miniature GPS trackers to nesting eagles since 2008, and announced a paper whose species distribution model predicted 2,862,400 hectares of suitable habitat.

name: Philippine Initiative for Conservation of the Environment and Empowerment of People Inc.
summary: Organisation founded in 1995 that monitors wildlife in Northwest Panay Peninsula Natural Park; it says monitoring cut poached hornbill nests from 50% to 5% since 2001.

name: Philippine National Forest Monitoring System
summary: National system setting methods and institutional arrangements for producing and sharing Philippine forest information, with DAO 2021-32 giving guidelines for putting it into operation for the REDD+ Strategy.

name: Philippine Space Agency
summary: Central government space agency created in August 2019 under Republic Act No. 11363, which says it supports DENR monitoring with satellite data and AI, and signed a satellite data agreement with NAMRIA in February 2025.

name: Philippine Sustainable Interventions for Biodiversity, Oceans, and Landscapes (SIBOL) Activity
summary: A closed five-year USAID-funded biodiversity project launched in 2020, described in January 2024 as developing monitoring and decision-making tools, with CCIPH expected to contribute species distribution modelling.

name: PhilSA and Tubbataha Management Office benthic and bathymetry mapping
summary: A proposed benthic habitat and bathymetry mapping project for Tubbataha Reefs Natural Park, agreed by PhilSA and the Tubbataha Management Office in a five-year memorandum signed on 13 February 2026.

name: PhilSA Integrated Network for Space-Enabled Actions
summary: A PhilSA-run network launched in October 2022 of local government units, institutions and individuals using space data for sustainability, with drone and underwater mapping activities in Balabac, Palawan in February 2026.

name: Predictions for the Environment and Application of Remote Sensing (PEARS) Laboratory
summary: A University of the Philippines Diliman remote sensing laboratory whose research interests include forest loss and gain and the impacts on coral reefs, mangroves and seagrass.

name: Protected Area Information System
summary: The official online central database of designated protected areas in the Philippines, run by the Biodiversity Management Bureau, which trained protected area staff to update their data in regional workshops in 2026.

name: Quantitative Aquatics, Inc.
summary: Philippine non-profit established in February 2017 to support assembling and sharing data on living aquatic resources, operating under the scientific guidance of the FishBase Consortium.

name: Ridge to Reefs Modelling and Monitoring for Decision Support System (R2M2DS2) in Pujada and Mayo Bay
summary: A PCAARRD-funded project in Pujada and Mayo Bay, run by Davao Oriental State University and listed as ongoing in February 2024.

name: Sat4Blue
summary: Project that won first prize in the EU-Copernicus Youth Challenge in Cebu in November 2025, with a demo machine learning model assessing mangrove health in uploaded images, still at an early stage.

name: Silliman University
summary: University in Dumaguete City whose Institute of Environmental and Marine Sciences continued post-spill monitoring with a field survey at Capiñahan Marine Sanctuary in April 2026.

name: Silliman University Institute of Environmental and Marine Sciences
summary: Institute run by Silliman University that used manta tow methods to assess the coral reef at Capiñahan Marine Sanctuary on 13 April 2026, continuing post-spill monitoring.

name: Smart Communications
summary: Described by Huawei as PLDT's wireless and mobile operator and Rainforest Connection's first Filipino telco partner, linked to the Palawan Rainforest Guardian project.

name: Strengthening Marine Protected Areas to Conserve Marine Key Biodiversity Areas in the Philippines
summary: A closed five-year, 8 million dollar project from 2014 to 2019, run by UNDP and the Biodiversity Management Bureau, that included site connectivity studies and a 2018 Davao Gulf cetacean survey with 17 sightings.

name: Sulubaaï Environmental Foundation
summary: Philippine non-profit created in 2012, working around Pangatalan, monitoring marine protected areas and restoration sites with eDNA, developing Project CORaiL, with partner Chorus planning acoustic monitoring.

name: Tañon Strait Protected Seascape
summary: Protected area under the 2018 Expanded NIPAS Act; a July 2024 report says its management office conducts a bi-annual cetacean survey, with twenty transect lines covering 450 kilometres in June 2024.

name: Thinking Machines Data Science
summary: Data science organisation that announced work in March 2022 with the Gerry Roxas Foundation using Earth observation data and machine learning to map deforestation drivers in the Philippines.

name: Tubbataha Management Office
summary: Collaborated with LAMAVE on diver-based surveys of shark and ray abundance in Tubbataha Reefs Natural Park.

name: Tubbataha seabird monitoring
summary: A Tubbataha Management Office programme running since 2004, according to the park site, with monthly, quarterly and annual May surveys described in its 2016 account.

name: University of Santo Tomas
summary: University whose herbarium was turned over to its Research Center for the Natural Sciences in 1989.

name: University of Santo Tomas Herbarium
summary: Herbarium in the Thomas Aquinas Research Complex, Manila, whose collections hold plant specimens from provinces across the country.

name: University of Southern Mindanao
summary: University whose Department of Biological Sciences houses the Ecology and Conservation Research Laboratory and the Biodiversity Synthesis+ Centre.

name: University of the Philippines
summary: A university that runs PhilCoMaRS jointly with DENR to map coral reefs and mangroves, and whose Diliman campus houses the College of Science and its Institute of Environmental Science and Meteorology.

name: University of the Philippines Diliman
summary: Quezon City campus with 15 OpenAlex works since 2020 on remote sensing and machine learning, the most of any Philippine institution in that query, and an AI Program chaired by a Fish-i developer.

name: University of the Philippines Los Baños
summary: University whose Museum of Natural History, per GBIF's record, sits in the Forestry Quadrangle of the campus.

name: University of the Philippines Los Baños Museum of Natural History
summary: University museum in the Philippines holding over 500,000 preserved animals, plants and microorganism cultures, and publishing GBIF datasets on bats from expeditions across the islands and on bat pathogens and hosts collected 2008 to 2011.

name: University of the Philippines Marine Science Institute
summary: Constituent institute of the UP College of Science studying marine ecosystems from Diliman and Bolinao, whose MBRIS lists a marine biodiversity data analytics platform among its aims and whose director Newsbytes names as a Fish-i developer.

name: Use of Satellite Imagery in the Creation of the National ENR Geospatial Database and other related Programs of the DENR
summary: A DENR-funded effort under a February 2023 PhilSA agreement that planned a geospatial database of natural resources, with forest monitoring using remote sensing, machine learning and AI, and annual mangrove extent maps.

name: UST Research Center for the Natural and Applied Sciences
summary: Research centre that held a PHP 1,978,964 Forest Foundation Philippines grant, from August 2018 to August 2020, to establish a long-term ecological monitoring plot in Angat Watershed.

name: Wild Bird Club of the Philippines
summary: Nationwide birdwatchers' club that aims to be the main non-profit resource for birdwatchers' records in the Philippines, and builds and runs the Checklist of Philippine Birds.

name: Wildlife, Forestry and Fisheries Indicator Spatial Hub – Management Information System
summary: Operational prototype management information system for local patrollers and data managers in Tayabas, Pagbilao and Sariaya, combining SMART and CyberTracker, pilot tested in 2017.

name: World Wide Fund for Nature Philippines
summary: A national organisation of the WWF network since 1997, which runs the Donsol whale shark survey, identified 58 individual whale sharks in 2021, and helped operate a tourist citizen science effort.

name: Wovoka
summary: Self-described natural capital operator in the Philippines and Uganda, reporting Ghost Dance is designed for GCash payments per approved land photo and no credits issued for Mindoro Arawatan.

name: ZSL community-led camera trapping in Taytay, Palawan
summary: Zoological Society of London project working with a Taytay community in Palawan to develop community-led camera trapping for endemic species, using Wildlife Insights to filter blank images and remove images of people.

name: AI camera traps for snow leopard early warning, Gilgit-Baltistan
summary: Five WWF-Pakistan AI camera traps, installed with LUMS, detect snow leopards and alert communities; Dawn reported WWF-Pakistan called them crucial for safeguarding wildlife and communities in 2024.

name: AI-Based Tree Cutting Detection
summary: Active project run by the Punjab Forestry GIS Lab that aims to use AI with sensors, satellite imagery and drones to detect illegal logging, with pilots in three forest zones.

name: AI-ForestWatch
summary: A semantic segmentation framework for forest estimation and change detection from multispectral imagery, recorded in OpenAlex as the subject of a paper and built by Annus Zulfiqar.

name: Azad Jammu & Kashmir Forest Monitoring System
summary: Forest monitoring platform for Azad Jammu and Kashmir, described as built on the National Forest Monitoring System's architecture, with multi-year forest cover and deforestation layers and 184 sample plots plus 23 inventory sub-plots.

name: Azad Jammu and Kashmir Forest Department
summary: Forest authority for Azad Jammu and Kashmir whose Chief Conservator reported, in December 2024, about 1.4 million acres of forest, including 0.75 million acres of degraded potential forests being restored.

name: Azad Jammu and Kashmir Wildlife and Fisheries Department
summary: Wildlife department whose 2024–25 development plan intended to establish a protected-area network and reported 21 declared protected areas covering 9% of the territory.

name: Balochistan Forest and Wildlife Department
summary: Provincial department whose work covers forests, wildlife and protected areas including Hingol National Park, where in April 2026 it reportedly announced a thermal camera record of a Persian leopard.

name: Balochistan Forest Management Information System
summary: Dashboard linked to Ziarat forest cover, tree, biomass and carbon assessments, cited in December 2024 as recording 264,925 hectares of notified state forests in Ziarat.

name: Baltistan Wildlife Conservation and Development Organization
summary: A non-profit, formerly Project Snow Leopard, that works on snow leopard conservation and human-snow leopard conflict in Gilgit-Baltistan, with camera-trap population monitoring among its initiatives.

name: BUITEMS
summary: Institution listed first among the five in the DePWiSeN consortium, and home of the project's Pakistan principal investigator.

name: Capital Development Authority
summary: Its Environment Directorate (Regional) says it manages Margalla Hills National Park and Simly Dam’s catchment, while its Forests Division tackles illegal logging, fires and encroachment in the park.

name: Cholistan Development Authority
summary: Regional authority that, under its 1976 Act, is responsible for preserving forests, vegetation and wildlife in Cholistan, with its regional master plan still in development when the park plan was written.

name: Community-managed protected areas for threatened species in Gilgit-Baltistan
summary: A WCS Pakistan project, funded by Van Tienhoven Foundation, to monitor mountain ungulates and deploy Community Wildlife Rangers; joint surveys in 2018–2019 counted 594 markhor and 68 urial in December 2018.

name: Cooperative development of an innovative Auto-ID platform for the beetles from China and Pakistan
summary: Pakistan Museum of Natural History project, funded by the Pakistan Science Foundation and listed as ongoing, to develop an automatic identification platform for beetles from China and Pakistan, dated October 2019 to September 2024.

name: DePWiSeN
summary: Project building a low-cost sensor and early-warning system for illegal logging, fire and tree health in Balochistan's juniper and pine nut forests, with Ziarat and Sherani monitored and a Khyber Pakhtunkhwa extension planned.

name: Directorate of Central Karakoram National Park
summary: Directorate run by the Gilgit-Baltistan forest department, whose December 2015 winter surveys counted 2,252 Himalayan ibex across the park's valleys, using survey formats it developed.

name: Establishment of a DNA Barcode Reference Bank for the Marine and Freshwater Fishes in Pakistan
summary: Pakistan Museum of Natural History project, funded by the Pakistan Science Foundation and listed as ongoing for 2024 to 2025, to establish a DNA barcode reference bank for marine and freshwater fishes.

name: Forest, Wildlife & Environment Department Gilgit-Baltistan
summary: An independent department created in 2010 that holds the wildlife and habitat conservation mandate in Gilgit-Baltistan, manages protected areas, and lists a REDD+ coordinator and a GIS specialist.

name: ForresOn
summary: Reported by ProPakistani in 2020 as an Islamabad company building forestry and agricultural drones, using AI to monitor trees and surveying Margalla Hills before planting with SAARC.

name: GBIF Pakistan
summary: Pakistan's observer participant node in GBIF, listed in the registry at the Zoological Sciences Division, Shakarparian, Islamabad, with a home page on the Pakistan Museum of Natural History site.

name: Gilgit-Baltistan Forest Monitoring and Information System
summary: A proposed system for which the Gilgit-Baltistan forest department invited firms in January 2025 to run a feasibility study, aiming at real-time forest monitoring, including AI-based forest inventories.

name: GIS Lab, Punjab Forestry and Wildlife Department
summary: Lahore GIS laboratory of the Punjab Forestry and Wildlife Department, which is conducting pilot studies of AI-based tree cutting detection in three forest zones.

name: Herbarium of Pakistan (ISL), Quaid-i-Azam University
summary: Quaid-i-Azam University's herbarium, described in GBIF as Pakistan's largest with over 180,000 specimens; by October 2020, 36,208 records were online, 24,368 of them georeferenced, under a CC0 waiver.

name: Higher Education Commission Pakistan
summary: Funder that supported DePWiSeN jointly with the British Council under its Pak-UK research grant on climate change, a scheme of up to Rs. 50 million per grant that is now closed to intake.

name: Himalayan Brown Bear Survey 2022 in Deosai National Park and its Buffer Valleys
summary: A closed 2022 survey by Deosai National Park field staff, covering 4,000 square kilometres in 49 blocks with a double observer method, which estimated 66 Himalayan brown bears.

name: Indus Delta Capital
summary: Private carbon developer that partnered with Sindh’s government in 2015 and leads Delta Blue Carbon mangrove restoration, with IUCN named for community engagement and Inverto for digital monitoring.

name: Indus Fishing Cat Project
summary: An active wildlife conservation group, described by Dawn as working in the region for over four years and headed by Zafeer Ahmad Shaikh, whose camera trap recorded a caracal in Kirthar National Park.

name: Information Technology University
summary: A Government of Punjab university whose BiSMiL Lab researched Indus river dolphin acoustics, and which signed a 2017–2020 agreement with WWF-Pakistan envisaging joint biodiversity studies with bio-acoustics, imaging and mobile technologies.

name: Islamabad Wildlife Management Board
summary: Constituted under the Islamabad Wildlife Ordinance 1979, it enforces wildlife law, recorded leopards with 20 camera traps according to Dawn, and lists AI early warning research.

name: IUCN Pakistan
summary: Reportedly launched Punjab’s wildlife survey with the provincial wildlife department, plans a Red Data Book according to its project manager, and reportedly joined 2019 Red Data List data collection.

name: Khunjerab Village Organization
summary: Community organisation of seven villages in the Khunjerab National Park buffer zone, reported in 2004 to receive 80% of park entrance fees, and listed as a 650 square kilometre conservation area.

name: Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Forest Department
summary: In July 2026, officials reported action against illegal logging with community participation, and a senior official reported 42 working plans across the province as of October 2025.

name: Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Forest Monitoring System
summary: An active provincial forest monitoring platform for Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, built on the national system's architecture, which holds deforestation hotspot layers and multi-year forest mask analysis.

name: Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Wildlife Department
summary: According to APP, its February 2026 GIS dolphin census recorded 135 dolphins along 154 km; the ministry names it as a provincial snow leopard programme coordinating agency from 2018.

name: Lahore University of Management Sciences
summary: A university whose AI camera trap collaboration with WWF-Pakistan and NCRA-ARL reportedly detects predators and alerts authorities within a minute, with five units installed according to Dawn.

name: Mangrove Cover Dataset of Pakistan on 5-Year Interval (1990-2020)
summary: A dataset covering all five mangrove areas in Pakistan at five-year intervals from 1990 to 2020, built by Hammad Gilani using a random forest classifier on Landsat images in Google Earth Engine.

name: Mangrove Forest Monitoring in Indus Delta near Karachi, Pakistan
summary: A closed project, run by Pakistan Flying Labs, that used drones to map mangroves along the Sindh coast, covering 44 hectares and identifying areas needing reforestation.

name: Mangrove Watch from Space Project
summary: A project built by SUPARCO that mapped Indus Delta mangroves from Landsat and GF-2 imagery for 2000 to 2021, classifying them with a Random Forest technique at 88% overall accuracy.

name: Ministry of Climate Change and Environmental Coordination
summary: A Pakistani federal ministry covering forestry, wildlife, biodiversity and climate policy, building the Pakistan Red List Initiative, whose 2019 survey launch was reported by Dawn.

name: National Forest Monitoring System of Pakistan
summary: Programme reported by Gulf News as launched in 2021 as Pakistan's first national forest monitoring system, using satellite land monitoring and a web portal that includes a REDD+ registry.

name: National University of Sciences and Technology
summary: An Islamabad university whose Deep Learning Lab began in 2016 under Faisal Shafait, listing forestry AI models and a fish biodiversity project using video sampling.

name: Pakistan Climate Sentinel
summary: Active tool led by Muhammad Hashir Suleman that retrieves Google Earth Engine imagery for a chosen area and runs flood or deforestation models, saying outputs are not official warnings.

name: Pakistan Flying Labs
summary: Active organisation that used drones to map 44 hectares of mangrove forest in the Indus Delta and identify areas needing reforestation.

name: Pakistan Forest Institute
summary: Established in 1947, it reportedly published over 2,100 studies by 2012 and became attached to Khyber Pakhtunkhwa’s Environment Department after devolution in 2011, according to Dawn.

name: Pakistan Museum of Natural History
summary: Museum that Pakistan's 2014 fifth national report to the CBD named as the only GBIF focal point in Pakistan, with GBIF listing the Pakistan node as an observer.

name: Pakistan Red List Initiative
summary: Survey launched in 2019 by the climate change ministry, led by Mohammad Suleman Khan Warraich, to compile Pakistan's first Red Data List of threatened wildlife species, as reported by Dawn.

name: Pakistan Snow Leopard and Ecosystem Protection Program
summary: Closed five-year project from September 2018, run by the Snow Leopard Foundation with the ministry and UNDP, funded with US$4.64 million from the GEF, including surveys and genetic sampling in 40 valleys.

name: Pakistan Space and Upper Atmosphere Research Commission
summary: Pakistan's national space agency, established in 1961 and based in Islamabad, which lists remote sensing for forest and biodiversity monitoring, runs Space4Climate and built a mangrove mapping product.

name: Pakistan Wolf Project
summary: An active project documenting wolf presence with remote cameras and community work, which plans to expand camera traps and staff after two pilot sites and to collect scat for genetic identification.

name: Predator Early Warning System (Gilgit-Baltistan)
summary: Active project, built by WWF-Pakistan and LUMS, using solar-powered Raspberry Pi camera traps since 2022 with AI to detect snow leopards and alert communities; LUMS recorded five deployed in 2024.

name: Protected Areas Management Project (Pakistan)
summary: A project approved in 1998 and closed in 2012, supported by a US$10,160,000 GEF grant to improve management and biodiversity monitoring in three national parks.

name: Punjab Digital Forest Inventory
summary: Plan, reported by CW Pakistan in March 2026, for the Punjab forest department to digitise old records into a forest inventory, with AI reported for tree counting and over 200 drones monitoring forests.

name: Punjab Forest Department
summary: Provincial forest department whose website describes AI-based wildlife conservation using drones and satellites to map habitats and track animal movements, and credits its GIS Lab.

name: Punjab Forest Monitoring System
summary: Provincial forest monitoring platform for Punjab, described as built on the National Forest Monitoring System's architecture, with forest and land-cover layers for 2004 to 2020 and data from 332 plots measured in 2022.

name: Punjab forest thermal imaging and satellite monitoring system
summary: Active system that Dunya News reported in April 2025 as launched on the Chief Minister's instruction, starting with thermal imaging monitoring in Murree and Rawalpindi forests, with AI experts to carry out the project.

name: Punjab Wildlife and Parks Department
summary: Provincial department that lists wildlife population monitoring and protected areas among its work and, with IUCN Pakistan, launched Punjab's first comprehensive wildlife survey in April 2025, as reported by the Express Tribune.

name: Punjab wildlife survey
summary: Active survey inaugurated in Lahore in April 2025 at an estimated Rs530 million, built by IUCN Pakistan, using GPS, camera traps, drones and GIS, with a second phase being prepared as of August 2026.

name: Quaid-i-Azam University
summary: Islamabad university whose Herbarium of Pakistan dataset on GBIF, about 36,000 occurrence records, describes it as the largest herbarium in Pakistan, with specimens from throughout the country.

name: Shimshal Nature Trust
summary: Community trust set up by educated young people of Shimshal, which started the area's community-based hunting programme, and which a 2020 report says contributed members to Khunjerab National Park's management group.

name: Sindh Forest Department
summary: Sindh Climate reported 1.125 million hectares (8% of Sindh) under departmental control in 2022, and the 2015 60-year Indus Delta Capital partnership aimed to restore 225,000 hectares of mangroves.

name: Sindh Forest Monitoring System
summary: Provincial forest monitoring platform for Sindh, described as built on the National Forest Monitoring System's architecture, with forest cover and deforestation layers and data from 151 sample plots and 40 sub-plots measured in 2017.

name: Sindh Wildlife Department
summary: Active provincial wildlife department in Karachi whose stated mission is to conserve, restore and enhance wildlife on public lands and manage the resource.

name: Snow Leopard Foundation
summary: A non-profit conservation organisation founded in 2008 that works on carnivores across Pakistan, and built a Karakoram and Himalaya bio-monitoring framework; its 2010 to 2019 study estimated 167 snow leopards, as reported by Dawn.

name: Snow Leopard Foundation bio-monitoring framework, Karakoram–Himalaya
summary: A bio-monitoring framework built by the Snow Leopard Foundation, combining double-observer surveys, eDNA, non-invasive genetics and camera trapping, which aims to address ecological data gaps across northern Pakistan's mountain ecosystems.

name: Society for Torghar Environment Protection
summary: A 2002 case study says the Torghar Conservation Project team registered the NGO in 1994 and its markhor and urial programme, begun around 1995, appointed 62 local guards.

name: Space4Climate Initiative
summary: A SUPARCO-built programme launched in March 2026, as reported by CW Pakistan, centred on a GeoAI-enabled Climate Observatory that combines satellite data and geospatial analytics to track forests, glaciers, coasts, rivers and land use.

name: Survey of Pakistan
summary: Pakistan's self-described mapping authority, which set up a Directorate of Cartography and GIS in 2023, began drone-based large-scale mapping in 2024, and says it is moving towards AI and a National Spatial Data Infrastructure.

name: Third-party monitoring of the Ten Billion Tree Tsunami Programme
summary: An independent third-party monitoring effort for the Ten Billion Tree Tsunami Programme, which a government coordinator said in November 2024 was led by IUCN, with WWF-Pakistan and FAO also contributing.

name: University of the Punjab
summary: A university established in 1882 at Lahore, whose Institute of Geography is the affiliation of a 2026 canopy height paper's lead author, and which had the most works (39) in a saved OpenAlex search of Pakistan-affiliated AI and nature studies since 2020.

name: Wall-to-Wall 30 m Above-Ground Biomass Density (AGBD) Dataset for Pakistan's Forests (2020)
summary: Openly licensed dataset described as the first baseline wall-to-wall 30 m above-ground biomass map of Pakistan's forests for 2020, built by Hammad Gilani, with a Classification and Regression Tree model performing best.

name: WCS Pakistan
summary: A Wildlife Conservation Society programme that in 2012 said it had trained Gilgit-Baltistan rangers and helped seed over 50 community conservation committees, and took part in data collection for the 2019 Pakistan Red Data List survey, as reported by Dawn.

name: WCS Pakistan Program
summary: A programme built by the Wildlife Conservation Society, which says it began formally in 1997 and involves over 100 community rangers monitoring snow leopards and other wildlife, plus 22 community-managed protected areas.

name: WHiCH (Western Himalaya Canopy Height) Map 2020, Pakistan
summary: A 10 m western Himalayan canopy height map for 2020, built by Adeel Ahmad using U-Net, GEDI and Sentinel-2, reportedly outperforming global models regionally according to its authors.

name: Wildlife smart monitoring system, Margalla Hills
summary: A collaboration between the Islamabad Wildlife Management Board and SZABIST University on a wildlife smart monitoring system in Margalla Hills, using camera traps and an AI tool for a leopard early warning system.

name: WWF-Pakistan
summary: A conservation organisation established in 1970 with its head office in Lahore, which built AI snow leopard camera traps with LUMS and also developed a wildlife crime reporting app, as reported by Arab News.

name: WWF-Pakistan SMART Project
summary: Project built by WWF-Pakistan with WWF-Italy, launched in 2018 in Khunjerab National Park, which WWF-Pakistan says brought SMART into two provincial wildlife departments' management systems.

name: Zoological Survey of Pakistan
summary: A federal agency under the climate change ministry monitoring wildlife status, distribution and threats, which contributed data to the 2019 Red Data List survey, according to Dawn.

name: A large-area wildlife monitoring system using camera traps and artificial intelligence
summary: An active project run by TAXUS UL with the Museum and Institute of Zoology PAS, aiming to develop a camera-trap wildlife monitoring system supported by AI, covering large predators and ungulates.

name: A Large-Scale Wildlife Monitoring System Using Camera Traps and Artificial Intelligence
summary: A proposed collaboration between TAXUS UL, the Museum and Institute of Zoology PAS and the Open Science Conservation Fund, which says TRAPPER will exchange data for AI analysis.

name: Adam Mickiewicz University in Poznań
summary: University that runs ecoserv-pol; its Faculty of Biology presented the AMUNATCOLL assumptions in December 2016, and a 2026 paper with one author there used deep learning on Bangwa Warbler acoustic patterns.

name: African penguin recognition from chest spots
summary: Proposed project to monitor wild penguin colonies by using AI to analyse chest spot patterns, with the team hoping, per Paweł Borecki, that it will learn to recognise individuals.

name: AGH University of Krakow
summary: A university named as the affiliation of the first author of a 2020 paper on deep learning for acoustic monitoring of night-migrating birds, according to OpenAlex.

name: AI Model for Poland
summary: Proposed collective aiming at an open, democratic AI model for animal detection and species classification, with plans for national camera-trap data sharing using Camtrap DP.

name: Akces NCBR
summary: Company that, according to the IDEAS NCBR site, took over all IDEAS NCBR assets when the companies merged on 12 December 2025.

name: ALSGator
summary: Programme built by the Forest Research Institute, developed within REMBIOFOR by a team from the IBL Geomatics Department.

name: AMUNATCOLL
summary: Dataset with over 2 million records of plants, animals and fungi from 54 collections plus 12 specialist ones, proposed in December 2016 and kept consistent with GBIF standards by its partner.

name: Ansee Consulting
summary: Consultancy whose team helps manage biodiversity, according to the BioVerify site, which also says the BioVerify Tool automates site assessment.

name: Aquila
summary: Organisation describing its solar-powered loggers as made for research on habitat use, territories and animal movement.

name: Argo Polska
summary: Programme run by the Institute of Oceanology, described as Poland's component of the global Argo float network for in situ ocean observation.

name: ASIR
summary: Active project led by Warsaw University of Technology, aiming at an autonomous IoT system for continuous water quality monitoring, including a planned national map of river pollution risk.

name: Association for Nature Wolf
summary: Non-profit founded in 1996 for mammal conservation, particularly carnivores, which has studied wolves in Western Poland since 2001 and publishes wolf monitoring standards.

name: Atlas płazów i gadów Polski
summary: Dataset run by the Institute of Nature Conservation, which says a new atlas is being made.

name: Atlas ssaków Polski
summary: Dataset run by the Institute of Nature Conservation, which says a new atlas is being made.

name: Automatic monitoring pilot on the Oder
summary: A pilot begun in 2025 by the Chief Inspectorate of Environmental Protection with the National Fund, providing for ten measuring points for automatic monitoring on the Oder.

name: Babia Góra National Park
summary: National park that has researched with the university in the Euro Snapshot consortium since 2021 and uses AI with it to identify lynx.

name: Baltic Biodiversity Grant
summary: Grant programme run by the Orlen Foundation for Pomerania, whose second-edition applications opened on 1 September 2026, supporting themes including monitoring and scientific research.

name: Baltic Sense
summary: Proposed programme, led by Koszalin University of Technology, placed on the Polish roadmap of strategic research infrastructures, with a concept covering threats including to marine environment safety.

name: Białowieża acoustic monitoring
summary: Closed study run from 27 March to 9 June 2023 with recorders at 61 locations, which identified 56 animal species using acoustic species-identification algorithms.

name: Białowieża National Park
summary: Park that deployed forest acoustic monitoring with RFCx and Huawei and is listed by Rainforest Connection as a partner in the March to June 2023 work.

name: Białystok University of Technology
summary: University whose faculty announced a 26 March 2025 event on AI and GIS in nature monitoring, describes the BioLoc citizen science app, and partners with E-Puszcza.

name: Biebrza National Park
summary: A national park that says its monitoring tracks ecosystem change and conservation effects, done by outside institutions and its own staff, and lists monitored species including black grouse, cranes, wolf, lynx and otter.

name: Bieszczady National Park
summary: A national park whose notice of 14 July 2015 says it used camera traps to monitor fauna, and that the area is monitored.

name: Bioseco
summary: Company that monitors bird movement at wind farms and airports using IoT and machine learning; its chief executive said the system was installed in over 160 places.

name: Bird Migration Research Station, University of Gdańsk
summary: Research station at the University of Gdańsk where, it is stated, thousands of volunteers have collected data under the guidance of its scientists.

name: Bocian Nature Society
summary: Society that carried out the 2015 to 2017 curlew monitoring project, started an online record system in 2007, and has partnered with ornitho.pl since December 2018.

name: Bureau for Forest Management and Geodesy
summary: State enterprise working since 1956 that runs the Forest Data Bank and Poland's national forest inventory, and is the main contractor for forest management plans.

name: BZB UAS
summary: Organisation that says it offers solutions for monitoring and managing forest ecosystems and uses AI analyses.

name: Carpathian Brown Bear Project
summary: Research project on brown bear ecology in the Carpathians, as the institute describes it, whose site carries an item on camera trapping for bear monitoring.

name: CE-ReDiFor
summary: Project run by the Forest Research Institute and funded by the European Commission, aiming at an open reference database of forest disturbances in Poland with a planned 660 plots.

name: Centrala Obrączkowania Ptaków
summary: Bird ringing programme run by the Museum and Institute of Zoology, Polish Academy of Sciences, set up in 1931 and now located at the Ornithological Station in Gdańsk.

name: Centrum Koordynacji Projektów Środowiskowych
summary: Body named on the State Forests project page as main beneficiary of the Natura 2000 management and monitoring system project planned for 2025–2028.

name: Chief Inspectorate of Environmental Protection (Poland)
roles: governs supplies-data funds builds-ai unknown uses-ai
summary: Body coordinating State Environmental Monitoring, which Poland’s national report calls the most important pillar of its biodiversity monitoring.

name: CloudFerro
summary: Polish company that EGI says delivers cloud platforms for space, climate research and science, and that runs and builds the Copernicus Data Space Ecosystem.

name: DIVERSE_GENE_WATCH
summary: Project aiming at a genetic monitoring system to identify falling genetic diversity in selected forest tree species in the Baltic Sea region, with a budget of 1,915,039.66 euros.

name: Drawa National Park
summary: A national park named by the climate ministry as beneficiary of a project on its aquatic ecosystems, January 2017 to end 2021, which included monitoring of habitats, fish and non-native species.

name: Dzikie Pogranicze
summary: Closed project that Radio Kraków reported in January 2025 as planning to count lynx, wolves and bears from February, using AI for an initial selection of photographs.

name: E-Puszcza
summary: Project led by the Mammal Research Institute of the Polish Academy of Sciences, worth almost 8 million zloty, with the OpenForestData.pl platform as its main product.

name: Eagle Conservation Committee
summary: Organisation that set up 48 protection zones with Biebrza National Park and the Rajgród forest district.

name: ECOSERV-POL
summary: Closed project run by Adam Mickiewicz University Poznań, covering services from the main ecosystem types in Poland, with initial cost about PLN 7.6 million, later funding PLN 7.7 million.

name: eCUDO.pl
summary: Programme led by the Institute of Oceanology of the Polish Academy of Sciences, giving free public access to digitalised oceanographic data and recognised as the Polish NODC in IODE.

name: European Bison Pedigree Book
summary: A pedigree database for European bison, described in a 2012 paper as kept by the editorial office, mainly covering 1968 to 2012, with authors affiliated with Białowieża National Park.

name: Forest Data Bank
summary: A portal gathering and sharing information on forests of all ownership types in Poland, with an interactive map and report builder, run by the Bureau for Forest Management and Geodesy and funded by Polish State Forests.

name: Forest inventory robot project
summary: A project of unknown status to build a machine that checks the type and state of trees and the presence of animals, led by Space System Solutions with two Poznań university partners.

name: Forest Research Institute (Poland)
summary: A Polish institute founded in 1930 and supervised by the climate and environment minister, whose Department of Geomatics develops remote sensing methods, and which runs LIFE+ ForBioSensing and MoniFun-PL and builds ALSGator.

name: Foundation for Climate and Biodiversity
summary: Foundation set up in 2023 whose founders secured Rewilding Europe funding to buy nearly 26 ha of the Rożnowo Plain, reported in February 2025 as being rewetted.

name: Fundacja Bycie w Lesie
summary: Foundation that signed a Gorce forest ownership transfer on 22 April 2024 and whose board placed the land under passive protection, leaving natural processes free from human interference.

name: Fundacja Las na Zawsze
summary: Foundation that acquires ownership of mature forest land in Poland to protect it from logging, and says it has protected and planted over 250 hectares.

name: Fundacja Natura International Polska
summary: Foundation whose purchase of an Eliaszuki peatland meadow on the Narew WWF Polska reported supporting in January 2024, with the partners planning management for feeding great snipe.

name: Fundacja Przyroda i Nauka
summary: A foundation that says it runs nature monitoring of large carnivores and names its methods.

name: Gatunki obce w Polsce
summary: Database run and built by the Institute of Nature Conservation, described as the largest on biological invasions in Poland, now covering over 2,000 alien and cryptogenic species.

name: Gdynia Maritime University
summary: A university whose laboratory develops machine learning and deep learning methods for classifying benthic habitats, and which carried out the Polish marine benthic habitat mapping project.

name: General Directorate for Environmental Protection (Poland)
summary: An expert nature protection body in Warsaw, coordinating Poland’s Natura 2000 network of 871 habitat and 145 bird sites and running Geoserwis and the nature protection register.

name: Geoserwis GDOŚ
summary: A spatial data service presenting forms of nature protection in Poland, which also shares biodiversity data from the Natural Resources Data Bank and is run by the General Directorate for Environmental Protection.

name: Gispro Technologies
summary: An organisation whose presentation on INFOSTRATEG experience with AI algorithms for automatically detecting land use changes was reported by a university.

name: Gorce National Park
summary: A Polish national park that began joint large mammal research with a university institute in 2000, is an Interreg partner, and uses AI with the university to identify lynx.

name: GreenEvo
summary: A programme the climate and environment ministry says it has run since 2009, which it says brings together 51 entrepreneurs and 65 technologies.

name: HAB Risk
summary: A project of unknown status that provides information on blooms based on satellite data, with a forecast for over 100 bathing sites.

name: HabitARS
summary: A closed project, led by Barbara Tokarska-Guzik and funded by the National Centre for Research and Development, that aimed to build a multi-sensor platform and remote sensing methods for identifying non-forest Natura 2000 habitats on farmland.

name: Head Office of Geodesy and Cartography (Poland)
summary: The Warsaw office serving Poland's Surveyor General, who keeps the central geodetic and cartographic resource, and which runs and builds the Geoportal and runs the national geoportal.

name: Hel Marine Station
summary: A field station of the University of Gdańsk Institute of Oceanography, established in 1992, offering sampling and monitoring including hydro-acoustic monitoring, passive porpoise detectors, and satellite transmitters on released seals when funding permits.

name: IMBIO
summary: A project of unknown status, led by the University of Warsaw with a PLN 18,763,954 budget, whose main aim is opening access to eukaryote biodiversity data held by partner institutions, with a planned link to GBIF.

name: Institute of Fundamental Technological Research, Polish Academy of Sciences
summary: A Polish Academy of Sciences institute whose staff page lists a 2025 review of AI and terrestrial point clouds for forest monitoring, covering deep learning with ground-based LiDAR.

name: Institute of Geodesy and Cartography (Poland)
summary: A Warsaw institute whose Remote Sensing Centre uses aerial and satellite images, including Sentinel-2, for work such as Biebrza peatlands, grassland management, Natura 2000 land cover change and forest mapping with machine learning.

name: Institute of Meteorology and Water Management
summary: A Polish institute that was the beneficiary of Sat4Envi, whose main task was making satellite data available.

name: Institute of Nature Conservation, Polish Academy of Sciences
summary: A Kraków institute leading WildINTEL, surveying wolf and lynx distribution in 2023/2024, running Poland’s alien species database, with authors on camera-trap image processing and goldenrod machine learning papers.

name: Institute of Oceanology, Polish Academy of Sciences
summary: A Polish Academy of Sciences institute in Sopot, set up in 1983, researching the Baltic Sea and European Arctic, with expertise in satellite remote sensing and SatBałtyk, and a partner in IMBIO.

name: Intuition-1
summary: A satellite mission built by KP Labs, aiming to show AI on-board data processing and enable environmental monitoring, and testing on-board deep-learning processing.

name: inVentia
summary: A company whose GPS modules are stated to be for monitoring vehicles, machines and wild animals, and whose devices a press report says run a logger system sending data to researchers over T-Mobile's network.

name: Jagiellonian Center for Artificial Intelligence
summary: A centre at the university whose media page lists its director speaking about using AI to identify lynx and protect their population.

name: Jagiellonian University
summary: A university that builds an AI lynx identification system from camera-trap images with Gorce and Babia Góra national parks, with analysis of a recording reported to take one to two minutes.

name: Jagiellonian University lynx identification AI
summary: An AI system built by Jagiellonian University with two national parks that returns the five most similar lynx for a new image; Prof. Zieliński says the right animal is among them in 95 per cent of cases.

name: John Paul II Catholic University of Lublin
summary: A university named as the first-author affiliation on a 2022 paper, listed by OpenAlex, combining field observations, remote sensing and deep learning to detect spatial avoidance between sousliks and moles.

name: Kampinos National Park
summary: A national park where Kurier Kampinoski reports the SmokeD early fire detection system is being set up.

name: Karkonosze National Park
summary: A national park named by the ministry as project beneficiary, which uses TRAPPER and Trapper AI, the latter reported implemented in a March 2023 sponsor's note.

name: Koszalin University of Technology
summary: A university that says it led the scientific consortium which prepared Baltic Sense, and is the first-author affiliation on a 2019 paper, listed by OpenAlex, on classifying airborne LiDAR bathymetry data with random forest.

name: KP Labs
summary: A company that says it developed Intuition-1 and is linked to it as its builder.

name: Krajowy System Informacji o Pożarach Lasów
summary: Database of fires in forests of all ownership types and other natural areas, drawing on State Forests, the State Fire Service and national parks, and run by the Forest Research Institute.

name: Laboratorium eDNA PBiAP
summary: Self-described research unit for environmental genetic analysis, which gives an address.

name: Lasy Miejskie-Warszawa
summary: Warsaw city forest body that the regional directorate reported in March 2023 was carrying out active protection in the Las Bielański reserve, alongside education and information work.

name: LIFE+ ForBioSensing
summary: A closed project, run by the Forest Research Institute and led by Krzysztof Stereńczak, to develop a forest monitoring system for Białowieża Forest, with sources giving different end dates, June 2021 and April 2022.

name: Magura National Park
summary: A national park listed as a partner on the Interreg page, with an address at Krempna.

name: Mammal Research Institute, Polish Academy of Sciences
summary: An independent Polish Academy of Sciences research unit founded in 1952 in Białowieża, which builds TRAPPER and led e-Puszcza.

name: Map of wetlands in Poland for urgent restoration and protection
summary: Dataset mapping wetlands in Poland for urgent restoration and protection, covering over 1.7 million hectares, about 30 per cent of natural and transformed wetlands, built by the Wetland Conservation Centre and funded by WWF Poland.

name: Mapping of benthic habitats of Polish marine areas 2021-2023
summary: Closed 2021-2023 project run by Gdynia Maritime University and MEWO S.A. for the inspectorate, whose geophysical surveys covered over 7,000 square kilometres.

name: Mazurski Park Krajobrazowy
summary: Landscape park created in 1977 covering over 562 square kilometres, more than 90 per cent overlapping the Jeziora Mazurskie biosphere reserve, which manages the Rezerwat Krutynia nature trail.

name: MGGP Aero
summary: Company that describes the data it acquires, says it surveys the natural environment by remote sensing, and says it is registered with a seat in Tarnów.

name: Ministry of Climate and Environment (Poland)
summary: Polish government office serving the Minister of Climate and Environment, which on 18 February 2026 put the draft seventh Convention on Biological Diversity report, covering 2019 to 2025, out to consultation.

name: Misja: Zapylacze
summary: Project, funded by the National Fund for Environmental Protection and Water Management, to pilot pollinator monitoring at 70 points across Poland, with a planned PLN 21.8 million cost, running 2026 to 2029.

name: Mobile Monitoring
summary: Organisation for which ESA BIC Poland describes an autonomous water monitoring platform.

name: MoniFun-PL
summary: Ongoing project led by the Forest Research Institute, running 19 June 2026 to 18 June 2027 on 60,000 euros from the European Forest Institute, to test mapping forest multifunctionality using federated learning.

name: Monitoring of the Eurasian curlew in Poland 2015-2017
summary: Closed project run by Bocian Nature Society and funded by the national environmental fund, covering Eurasian curlew monitoring in Poland in 2015 to 2017.

name: Monitoring Pospolitych Ptaków Lęgowych
summary: Ongoing breeding bird monitoring scheme started in 2000, run by the Chief Inspectorate, with PECBMS giving 500 fieldworkers and 110 species.

name: MoPA
summary: A project, running 1 April 2024 to 31 March 2027 with 773,158.80 euros of Interreg funding, that aims to improve and standardise monitoring methods in protected areas of the Pomerania Euroregion.

name: MS.MONINA
summary: Project of unknown status, listed by the institute on its wetlands and meadows page.

name: Museum and Institute of Zoology, Polish Academy of Sciences
summary: Warsaw institute holding a zoological collection of almost 8 million specimens, which also houses the bird ringing centre set up in 1931 and now at its Gdańsk station.

name: Nadleśnictwo Baligród
summary: Forest district containing 95.46 ha of the 444.50 ha Sine Wiry landscape reserve, with the rest falling to the Cisna district.

name: Nadleśnictwo Brodnica
summary: Forest district whose managed land contains 14 of the 15 nature reserves in its territory, totalling 422.62 ha, including 304.09 ha of forest.

name: Nadleśnictwo Browsk
summary: Forest district that belongs to the Leśny Kompleks Promocyjny Lasy Puszczy Białowieskiej and has four nature reserves within it.

name: Nadleśnictwo Dębica
summary: Forest district managing about 1,382.13 ha, or 96 per cent, of the 1,440.17 ha Las nad Braciejową habitat area.

name: Nadleśnictwo Ełk
summary: Forest district whose managed land includes parts of four protected landscape areas.

name: Nadleśnictwo Giżycko
summary: Forest district whose managed land includes nature reserves, a landscape park, Natura 2000 areas and natural monuments, and which as of 1 January 2017 managed 14 islands covering 160 ha on Lake Kisajno.

name: Nadleśnictwo Gostynin
summary: Forest district with seven nature reserves totalling 470.37 ha on its land, and nine reserves totalling 637.34 ha within its territory.

name: Nadleśnictwo Komańcza
summary: Forest district whose page gives 312.78 ha of the 1,585.01 ha Źródliska Jasiołki reserve as its land under the 1993 designation, and 314.03 ha under the 2016–2025 plan.

name: Nadleśnictwo Koniecpol
summary: Forest district whose land includes parts of three nature reserves, Kępina, Borek and Góra Zborów, with only 0.15 ha of Góra Zborów on its land.

name: Nadleśnictwo Lubsko
summary: Forest district whose managed land contains an entire 194.63 ha reserve and 2,199.83 ha of a landscape park within the Bory Lubuskie promotional forest complex.

name: Nadleśnictwo Lądek Zdrój
summary: Forest district that publishes lists of each form of nature protection found on land under its management.

name: Nadleśnictwo Oleśnica Śląska
summary: Forest district whose nature protection programme lists the forms of nature protection found on the land it manages.

name: Nadleśnictwo Pisz
summary: Forest district managing 205.18 ha of Jezioro Nidzkie reserve, set at 2,950.87 ha by a 2016 regional directorate order and spanning two districts and land outside State Forests management.

name: Nadleśnictwo Płytnica
summary: Forest district with 340.20 ha of its land in a 554.68 ha nature reserve.

name: Nadleśnictwo Rymanów
summary: Forest district managing 1,252.47 ha of the 1,571.90 ha Źródliska Jasiołki reserve, under the regional directorate's 2 November 2017 order.

name: Nadleśnictwo Siedlce
summary: Forest district managing 31.79 ha of the 65.88 ha Gołobórz floristic nature reserve.

name: Nadleśnictwo Skierniewice
summary: Forest district with 26.74 ha of its land in the Rawka river reserve, which crosses several districts and owners.

name: Nadleśnictwo Szczebra
summary: Forest district managing 600.44 ha, over 78.6 per cent, of a nature reserve in the district, as State Treasury land.

name: Nadleśnictwo Szubin
summary: Forest district publishing a list of forms of nature protection on its managed land under Article 6(1), points 2–9, of the Nature Conservation Act.

name: Nadleśnictwo Trzciel
summary: Forest district listing the forms of nature protection, including reserves, on State Treasury land under its management.

name: Nadleśnictwo Wałcz
summary: Forest district with three nature reserves, managing 270.01 ha of the 1,940.57 ha Wielki Bytyń reserve.

name: Nadleśnictwo Włoszczowa
summary: Forest district with three nature reserves on its managed land, covering 365.89 ha or 2.5 per cent, two under active and one under strict protection.

name: Nadleśnictwo Zagnańsk
summary: Forest district with a 258.70 ha nature reserve on its land.

name: National Centre for Research and Development (Poland)
summary: Executive agency supervised by the science minister that finances applied research, and is linked as funder to HabitARS, SILVA NYMPHA and a large-scale wildlife monitoring system.

name: National Fund for Environmental Protection and Water Management
summary: State legal entity financing environmental protection and water management, which OTOP and PECBMS say funds national bird surveys, and which paid for the 2023/2024 wolf and lynx survey.

name: National Marine Fisheries Research Institute
summary: Organisation that reports on BIAS acoustic research cruises, the autumn surveys of an ICES programme, and is named by IODE in the consortium.

name: National Satellite Information System
summary: Programme run and built by the Polish Space Agency, with a Geoportal, a marketplace and a knowledge base, and 8 satellite products prepared when Eurisy reported.

name: National Science Centre (Poland)
summary: Organisation that, according to the science ministry, opened the BiodivFuture call with Biodiversa+, with a budget of one million euros for Polish teams.

name: Natura 2000 management and monitoring system in State Forests and military land
summary: Active project, with the Forest Research Institute as partner, to build a system on remote sensing data, analyses and spatial models, costing about 9.4 million zloty in total.

name: Naturalists' Club
summary: Organisation whose 2024 bulletin says it continued monitoring habitats and the butterfly in the Polish Sudetes and coordinated work in Czechia and Austria.

name: Nicolaus Copernicus University
summary: A university named as the affiliation of the first author of 2025 and 2024 works, listed by OpenAlex, on vegetation indices for monitoring the Tuchola Forest ecosystem.

name: Ochrona ssaków i ptaków morskich – kontynuacja
summary: Project run by WWF Poland that ended on 31 October 2023, having studied seasonal and spatial variation in porpoises in the coastal zone.

name: Ojcowski Park Narodowy
summary: National park covering 2,145.62 ha under a 1997 Council of Ministers regulation, with 1,387.48 ha of the state land inside it under the park's management.

name: OpenForestData.pl
summary: A forest data platform built by e-puszcza, through which published data can be searched and viewed.

name: Operation Baltic
summary: Programme led by Jaroslaw Nowakowski, with almost 2 million birds ringed since 1960 by December 2025; a University of Gdańsk article calls it Poland's longest-running citizen science project.

name: Orbitesense
summary: Project aiming at faster mapping and monitoring of crops, forests, water and other areas from balloon data, for which ORBITESENSE TECH P.S.A. received EU funding.

name: ORLEN Foundation for Pomerania
summary: Foundation that runs the Baltic biodiversity grant and will give 4 million zloty in the grant's second edition.

name: Ornitho.pl
summary: Animal observation platform covering Poland, run by the Polish Society for the Protection of Birds, launched on 6 May 2015 on Swiss Biolovision software and replacing Awibaza.

name: Park Narodowy Bory Tucholskie
summary: National park covering 4,613.04 ha, with its administration address in Charzykowy and a website listing entry fees, visiting rules and an ePUAP mailbox.

name: Park Narodowy Gór Stołowych
summary: National park managing 6,221.33 ha within its boundary as of 31 December 2022, with a further 132.70 ha inside the park outside its management.

name: Państwowe zasoby cyfrowych map waloryzacji przyrodniczej Polski
summary: Project led by the Forest Research Institute, aiming at a state digital store of evaluated nature information, with a first stage reviewing resources and conditions for 2024 to 2027.

name: Pieniny National Park
summary: Organisation listed as a partner on an Interreg page, with an address at Krościenko nad Dunajcem.

name: Polesie National Park
summary: A national park that says its staff run hydrological monitoring points and monitor selected fauna and threatened plants, with some monitoring by scientific institutions, and that a hydrological monitoring plan was created in 1991.

name: Polish Academy of Sciences Botanical Garden in Powsin
summary: Botanical garden whose seed bank holds more than 730 samples of 220 species, stored in liquid nitrogen.

name: Polish Barcode of Life
summary: DNA barcoding programme partnered with the University of Łódź; its representatives ran 24-hour DNA barcoding workshops in 2026, and its site invites people to a COST action.

name: Polish Biodiversity Information Network
summary: Poland's GBIF node, run by the University of Warsaw; a March 2025 article says Polish institutions' GBIF records rose from under two million in 2022 to nearly 16 million.

name: Polish Bird Ringing Database
summary: Dataset holding over 4.2 million birds marked in Poland since 1931 and over 720,000 re-encounters.

name: Polish Bird Survey
summary: Programme within State Environmental Monitoring, coordinated by OTOP on commission from the Chief Inspector; OTOP says it still runs in a limited way from its own funds.

name: Polish Mycological Society
summary: Society that Biodiversa+ lists as a partner in FunDive.

name: Polish National Forest Inventory
summary: Dataset whose 2016 to 2025 cycle data MoniFun-PL will harmonise.

name: Polish Partnership for Earth Observation
summary: Programme joined by ten institutions and seven companies, including the AGH Space Technology Centre, CloudFerro, Creotech Instruments and KP Labs, with crop and ecosystem assessment among listed uses.

name: Polish Society for Nature Conservation Salamandra
summary: Society that a report names among NGOs running their own monitoring programmes.

name: Polish Society for the Protection of Birds
summary: Public benefit NGO founded in 1991, monitoring and conserving nature, running Ornitho.pl and the Polish Bird Survey, for which it reports no public contract money in 2026.

name: Polish Space Agency
summary: Executive agency set up in 2014 that built and runs the National Satellite Information System platform and released free national satellite products for monitoring forest and wooded areas.

name: Polish Waters
summary: Organisation that jointly carries out a microplastics monitoring project with Techsy, Wrocław University of Science and Technology and the Wrocław water company.

name: POLSA Land Cover Map (MPT)
summary: Land cover dataset run by the Polish Space Agency, whose newest edition has 10 classes, two of them forest, and whose Geoportal map was made from Sentinel-2 images recorded in 2024.

name: Polska Kartoteka Przyrodnicza
summary: Dataset built by the Bocian Nature Society, which says it started the system in 2007; its current status is unknown.

name: Pomorski Zespół Parków Krajobrazowych
summary: Complex of landscape parks formed on 1 July 2010 by merging seven landscape parks, which still make it up.

name: Poprawa stanu łączności ekologicznej w Karkonoskim Parku Narodowym i jego otulinie
summary: A project on ecological connectivity in Karkonosze National Park and its buffer zone, with a ministry-reported cost of over 5 million złoty and a planned end in March 2024; a cooperative open AI model for Poland is described as still ahead.

name: Poznań University of Life Sciences
summary: University that a press article says takes part in the forest inventory robot project, and which reports a 16 June 2026 event on AI in environmental monitoring and forestry.

name: Precision Forestry research team at IDEAS NCBR
summary: A research team led by Krzysztof Stereńczak, automating recognition of individual trees’ species, shape and size, reported in July 2023 as aiming to create an AI measurement tool.

name: Predatory Borderland
summary: Interreg Poland-Slovakia co-financed project involving 19 institutions, aiming to standardise cross-border lynx, wolf and bear counts using AI; July 2025 reporting scheduled completion for August 2026.

name: PUT Vision Lab
summary: Organisation that in February 2025 met foresters to investigate drone monitoring of mistletoe spread and reported mapping over a dozen hectares with a drone-mounted multispectral camera.

name: Regionalna Dyrekcja Ochrony Środowiska w Białymstoku
summary: A regional directorate for environmental protection in Białystok, listed by the General Directorate, whose main tasks include managing Natura 2000 sites and other nature protection.

name: Regionalna Dyrekcja Ochrony Środowiska w Bydgoszczy
summary: A regional directorate for environmental protection in Bydgoszcz, listed by the General Directorate, whose main tasks include managing Natura 2000 sites and other nature protection.

name: Regionalna Dyrekcja Ochrony Środowiska w Gdańsku
summary: A regional directorate for environmental protection in Gdańsk that lists recognising areas as nature reserves among its department's basic duties.

name: Regionalna Dyrekcja Ochrony Środowiska w Gorzowie Wielkopolskim
summary: A regional directorate for environmental protection in Gorzów Wielkopolski, listed by the General Directorate, whose main tasks include managing Natura 2000 sites and other nature protection.

name: Regionalna Dyrekcja Ochrony Środowiska w Katowicach
summary: A regional directorate for environmental protection in Katowice, listed by the General Directorate, whose main tasks include managing Natura 2000 sites and other nature protection.

name: Regionalna Dyrekcja Ochrony Środowiska w Kielcach
summary: A regional directorate for environmental protection in Kielce, listed by the General Directorate, whose main tasks include managing Natura 2000 sites and other nature protection.

name: Regionalna Dyrekcja Ochrony Środowiska w Krakowie
summary: A regional directorate for environmental protection in Kraków that says its nature protection department coordinates Natura 2000 sites in Małopolska province and that it manages nature reserves.

name: Regionalna Dyrekcja Ochrony Środowiska w Lublinie
summary: A regional directorate for environmental protection in Lublin, listed by the General Directorate, whose main tasks include managing Natura 2000 sites and other nature protection.

name: Regionalna Dyrekcja Ochrony Środowiska w Olsztynie
summary: A regional directorate for environmental protection in Olsztyn, listed by the General Directorate, whose main tasks include managing Natura 2000 sites and other nature protection.

name: Regionalna Dyrekcja Ochrony Środowiska w Opolu
summary: A regional directorate for environmental protection in Opole, listed by the General Directorate, whose main tasks include managing Natura 2000 sites and other nature protection.

name: Regionalna Dyrekcja Ochrony Środowiska w Poznaniu
summary: A regional directorate for environmental protection in Poznań, listed by the General Directorate, whose main tasks include managing Natura 2000 sites and other nature protection.

name: Regionalna Dyrekcja Ochrony Środowiska w Rzeszowie
summary: A regional directorate for environmental protection in Rzeszów, listed by the General Directorate, whose main tasks include managing Natura 2000 sites and other nature protection.

name: Regionalna Dyrekcja Ochrony Środowiska w Szczecinie
summary: A regional directorate that says it implements Natura 2000 tasks, creates and abolishes nature reserves, and monitored nine reserves over four years, including bats in 2025.

name: Regionalna Dyrekcja Ochrony Środowiska w Warszawie
summary: Regional directorate for environmental protection in Warsaw, listed by the General Directorate for Environmental Protection, which names managing Natura 2000 sites and other nature protection as a main task of such directorates.

name: Regionalna Dyrekcja Ochrony Środowiska w Łodzi
summary: A regional directorate for environmental protection in Łódź, listed by the General Directorate, whose main tasks include managing Natura 2000 sites and other nature protection.

name: Regionalna Dyrekcja Ochrony Środowiska we Wrocławiu
summary: Regional directorate for environmental protection in Wrocław, listed by the General Directorate for Environmental Protection, which names managing Natura 2000 sites and other nature protection as a main task of such directorates.

name: Rogów GPS tracking of protected birds
summary: Project run by the Forest Nature Education Centre Rogów with T-Mobile Polska; June 2023 reporting described planned protected-bird GPS loggers and online tracking of young white-tailed eagles.

name: Roztocze National Park
summary: National park that says it has carried out nature monitoring since its creation, coordinated by the Roztocze Centre for Monitoring and Science, which includes its internal ZMŚP base station ROZTOCZE.

name: S2GLC land cover maps
summary: Land cover maps built by the Space Research Centre PAN from Sentinel-2 data using a Random Forest classifier, including a 2017 map of Europe made by automated machine learning processing.

name: Sat4Envi
summary: Completed project led by the Institute of Meteorology and Water Management with Polish partners, creating Sentinel data infrastructure to support access to Copernicus and other satellite data.

name: SAT4EST
summary: ESA-funded project, built with the Institute of Geodesy and Cartography, describing a pre-operational satellite service tested in three Polish pilot districts using Sentinel-2 and Sentinel-1 time series for forest cover and change.

name: SatBałtyk
summary: Project led by the Institute of Oceanology PAS that, per a 2015 brochure, ran from 2010 to 2015 and produced an operational satellite monitoring system for the Baltic environment.

name: SAVE Wildlife Conservation Fund
summary: Organisation that says it has worked on wolves in Poland since 2011 and names its monitoring methods.

name: SILVA NYMPHA
summary: Closed project run by the Forest Research Institute that sought a prototype combining sensor data with drone and satellite images, forming a digital twin, and an AI-based analysis system for forest management.

name: Slavic AI
summary: Organisation named as a co-designer of Trapper AI, which it builds.

name: SmokeD
summary: Organisation using AI camera detectors that says it surveys over 3 million hectares with 190 cameras; a press report notes its PLN 11 million State Forests contract.

name: Space Research Centre of the Polish Academy of Sciences
summary: Research institute established in 1977 that builds S2GLC maps, processes satellite images and classifies land cover using Random Forest, while also working on land use classification.

name: Spruce Forest Damage Assessment in the Tatra Mountains
summary: Closed University of Warsaw project funded by the National Science Centre, running 12 January 2024–11 January 2026, aiming to assess bark beetle damage in Tatra stands using satellite data.

name: Stacja Bazowa ZMŚP Roztocze
summary: Base station run by Roztocze National Park, which says it was appointed in October 2010 as Poland's ninth and measures the Świerszcz stream catchment, and which partners with the ZMŚP programme.

name: State Forests National Forest Holding
summary: Organisation managing almost 7.6 million hectares of forest, which a 2025 press report says signed a PLN 11 million contract with SmokeD for monitoring forest land.

name: Stelleo
summary: Organisation describing itself as a Polish Earth observation startup, which says its ForeSat product is in development and describes a forest offer.

name: System for real-time collection and processing of data on microplastics and oil substances in water
summary: Active project aiming at a first complete set of devices for continuous monitoring of microplastics in water, with Polish Waters and Techsy, funded by the National Centre for Research and Development.

name: System zarządzania i monitoringu obszarów Natura 2000 w lasach państwowych oraz na terenach wojskowych
summary: Active project to build a monitoring system from remote sensing data and spatial models, covering over 3.1 million hectares, costing 9.39 million złoty, with 7.98 million from FEnIKS.

name: T-Mobile Polska
summary: Telecoms company which, according to a June 2023 report, had supported species monitoring initiatives since 2011, and which partners with the Rogów GPS bird tracking project.

name: Tatra National Park
summary: Protected area whose staff collect wolf signs for international research on three large predators, and whose camera traps form part of WildINTEL.

name: Tatra National Park remote sensing monitoring
summary: Proposed remote sensing monitoring project for Tatra National Park, planned to cover more than 21,000 hectares, with a high-mountain drone also planned.

name: TAXUS SI
summary: Organisation whose current work centres on camera traps, and which says it has monitored forest ecosystems for many years.

name: TAXUS UL Sp. z o.o.
summary: Company named as a partner by the Open Science Conservation Fund, which signed an agreement with NCBR on 14 January 2025, received EU funding, and leads a large-area wildlife monitoring system project.

name: Taxus.IT
summary: Company that says its analysts produce stand health analyses from drone and Sentinel-2 data, and which is linked as a builder of the SAT4EST service with IGIK.

name: Towarzystwo Przyrodnicze Alauda
summary: Society grazing koniks on bought and leased Błota Rakutowskie meadows and monitoring and tending a gull and tern colony on four restored Żwirownia Skoki islands of about 1.7 ha.

name: TrapperAI
summary: Model described as detecting 18 European mammal species, fine-tuned from YOLOv8-m, trained and evaluated on 401,458 camera-trap images from five countries, building on TRAPPER and MegaDetector.

name: TreeScanPL10K
summary: Dataset published in 2026 of annotated terrestrial laser scanning point clouds of Central European tree species.

name: University of Agriculture in Krakow
summary: University whose authors published a 2018 paper estimating defoliation of Scots pine stands using machine learning methods and Sentinel-2 vegetation indices.

name: University of Białystok
summary: University whose researcher is first author of a 2026 two-author paper reproducing a year-round expert survey with deep learning.

name: University of Gdańsk
